articles.title: Dan Lanning gives Ohio State coach Ryan Day props after Oregon’s lopsided win
articles.summary: Coach Ryan Day’s Ohio State Buckeyes started off on the right foot against the Oregon Ducks in Columbus, Ohio in Week 10 action, but wound up falling by a score of 41-28. Buckeyes superstar Jeremiah Smith’s career with the Buckeyes got a grim prognostication as fans wondered whether t
articles._body: Coach Ryan Day’s Ohio State Buckeyes started off on the right foot against the Oregon Ducks in Columbus, Ohio in Week 10 action, but wound up falling by a score of 41-28. Buckeyes superstar Jeremiah Smith’s career with the Buckeyes got a grim prognostication as fans wondered whether their team’s College Football Playoff hopes were over. Oregon coach Dan Lanning was interviewed after the game and gave words of respect to Day and his program following the huge Ducks win. “Coach Day is an outstanding coach…That was me, that was me two weeks ago (losing), like you guys felt that in our building, and it’s hard, really to overcome…You just try harder and harder to fix things and you can’t fix everything. “His teams are really hard to beat, we were on the other end of a butt-whooping like this in the Rose Bowl…We had some learning pains…And figured out, how to we become the kinda team we want to be, and we saw glimpses of that tonight.” Lanning’s comments won’t be much consolation to an Ohio State team that has watched its season disintegrate after the loss of Sayin and the insertion of maligned freshman Luke Fahey at quarterback. Fahey passed for 360 yards, two touchdowns and an interception, but it wasn’t enough as Oregon pulled out all the stops including a direct snap to Jamari Johnson , the team’s star tight end, that resulted in a touchdown. Day and his supporters are going through hard times right now, but there’s plenty to like as Ohio State continues moving forward. Smith, Fahey and the Buckeyes will be a tough game for anyone the rest of the way, but their championship dreams seem to be on life support. With the Rebels trailing No. 2 Georgia 21-0 midway through the second quarter, the Ole Miss student section started heaving trash onto the field inside Vaught-Hemingway Stadium. Since then, however, Pete Golding ‘s team has lost two of its last five games. $39.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage If Saturday night’s result holds, Ole Miss will have lost three of its past six games as the season turns to Week 11. (via @MattDeBary ) pic.twitter.com/tkMjtWiiC7 — On3 (@On3) November 8, 2026 “I think this Georgia defense is too good. At halftime Saturday night, he was held to just 69 yards passing with no touchdowns and one interception. “Obviously, they’ve got probably the best quarterback in the country,” Smart said Monday . “He is extremely hard to defend and a great player. The wow plays are what you guys love and what America loves. “And he had some wow plays against us last year, really in both games, but especially the second. But it’s the down-in, down-out decision-making that he’s really elite at. The accuracy that he’s elite at. The release, the decision — I mean, he’s just pinpoint accurate.”

articles.title: Jordan Ott’s 4-word response to Kevin Durant, Mat Ishbia, Dillon Brooks saga
articles.summary: PHOENIX– The Kevin Durant, Mat Ishbia, Dillon Brooks saga was an interesting one and makes Saturday’s game between the Phoenix Suns and Houston Rockets all the more interesting. Jordan Ott feels this is just another game. When asked about it pregame, he let out a comical four-word res
articles._body: PHOENIX– The Kevin Durant, Mat Ishbia, Dillon Brooks saga was an interesting one and makes Saturday’s game between the Phoenix Suns and Houston Rockets all the more interesting. Jordan Ott feels this is just another game. When asked about it pregame, he let out a comical four-word response. “Don’t use social media,” Ott said jokingly. “You’re in the heart of the season. You’re super focused on the game. Every single day. There’s a new challenge out there, and every single day we’re trying to get better. “This is early-season stuff where we got to settle into a routine, settle into a process, fine-tune our process, adjust some things that we haven’t found success with. Just stay in it day to day.” Jordan Ott shared a laugh when I asked him how he's not letting himself or his team be distracted after the Kevin Durant, Mat Ishbia, and Dillon Brooks social media incident last week. "Don't use social media." Continued: "You're in the heart of the season. You're super focused… pic.twitter.com/gweg5uBmqq — Hayden Cilley (@HaydenCilley) November 8, 2026 During this social media frenzy, it was quite the circus. It began with Ishbia making comments about Durant’s tenure with the Suns. Originally, it arose the topic of the underwhelming Phoenix teams he was a part of. Following that, Durant responded to Ishbia , saying that he brought the culture that the Suns now have. Lastly, Brooks chimed in, thanking Ishbia for getting rid of Durant. Although Ott isn’t on social media, having the majority team owner participate in this back and forth is noteworthy. Granted, the latter isn’t afraid to speak his mind but this could add more rocket fuel to Houston, and Durant specifically. He thrives off trash talk , and expect there to be plenty of it once the game tips off. If Ishbia is there, there might be some more chatter between those three. Even if the Suns head coach doesn’t think it’ll be a distraction, that distraction could be present, whether he likes it or not. Safe to say that Saturday’s game will be a treat. articles.title: Norfolk State’s Michael Vick gives explanation for failed victory formation in 29-28 loss
articles.summary: It looked like Michael Vick and his Norfolk State Spartans were closing in on a huge in-conference win against a surging North Carolina Central Eagles team, but the unthinkable happened with 1:34 left. North Carolina Central had no timeouts, and Norfolk State had the ball and could have run out t
articles._body: It looked like Michael Vick and his Norfolk State Spartans were closing in on a huge in-conference win against a surging North Carolina Central Eagles team , but the unthinkable happened with 1:34 left. North Carolina Central had no timeouts, and Norfolk State had the ball and could have run out the clock to secure the victory. But instead, the Spartans ran another play and ultimately fumbled, leading North Carolina Central to recover and ultimately score a touchdown to surge ahead 29-28. Michael Vick on the crucial fumble that opened the door for Norfolk State's stunning defeat to North Carolina Central. @WTKR3 pic.twitter.com/rJBWUCF9Dx — Marc Davis (@marcdavissports) November 7, 2026 In postgame comments, Vick tried to explain what happened. “I don’t know what happened at the end of the game. I put my headset down, I called victory formation. All we had to do was just take a knee and nail the clock out. That’s just situational football. I don’t know what happened in regards to that. I looked up and we was running the ball, and then I seen the fumble. But my final instructions was victory formation. That’s when you kneel it out, and they had, I think, zero timeouts left, and the game was over practically.” When a reporter asked him to clarify, Vick repeated that he called victory and said he doesn’t know why a run play was called. “I put my headset down, and I took my headset off ’cause all we had to do was just run it three times, or two times, or kneel it out. I just called victory. I don’t know what happened. A run play was called. I looked up, I seen us running the ball. I don’t know what happened. I really don’t. I don’t know what the play call was. I don’t know why we even ran that play.” Vick said the play will be used as a teaching example across the country and stressed once more that he called victory formation. “People will look at that and that’ll go on as a teaching tape for a lot of teams across the country for years to come. I hate it had to be us, but I called victory formation. I’m just letting everybody know that.” The post Norfolk State’s Michael Vick gives explanation for failed victory formation in 29-28 loss appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Ryan Day after Ohio State's loss to Oregon: 'There needs to be accountability'
articles.summary: No. 12 Ohio State jumped out to a 14-0 lead over No. 23 Oregon on Saturday. Still, the Buckeyes lost 41-28. After the game, head coach Ryan Day acknowledged that the team is coming up short. Day went on to say that there needs to be accountability with what’s going wrong, and it starts with […
articles._body: No. 12 Ohio State jumped out to a 14-0 lead over No. 23 Oregon on Saturday. Still, the Buckeyes lost 41-28. After the game, head coach Ryan Day acknowledged that the team is coming up short. Day went on to say that there needs to be accountability with what’s going wrong, and it starts with the staff. The loss is the Buckeyes’ second in a row and third of the season. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage “I’ve got to evaluate everything and try to come in tomorrow and figure out, with the staff, the things we’re coming up short on and figure out how to adjust those things,” Day said in his postgame press conference. “It all starts with the staff, and then it goes to the players. There needs to be accountability for all of it, and then we go from there.” Day went on to say that the team didn’t expect any of this to happen. But once Oregon took the momentum in the second quarter, there was no getting it back. Ohio State led 14-0 in the first quarter, but Oregon answered with a 17-0 second quarter to make it 17-14 at halftime. The Ducks then won the third quarter 14-0, and that proved to be too much for the Buckeyes to come back from. Watch on Fubo (Try for Free) “We didn’t expect any of this to happen,” said Day. “I thought the way that we came out was how we thought we would play in this game. Once the momentum swung, we just weren’t able to stop that and then swing it.” Still, even after the disappointing loss that likely pushes Ohio State out of the College Football Playoff and Big Ten Championship races, Day isn’t pointing fingers. But he knows something needs to change. “I’m not going to sit here and point fingers at one group of guys that are coming up short, because we’re all coming up short,” Day added. “You always have to look yourself in the mirror and figure out what is going wrong here. Two weeks in a row, to get this kind of result, there’s something that needs to change and needs to get fixed. So we’ve got to look at all those things and figure out what that is.” Ohio State is now 6-3 on the season and 4-2 against Big Ten opponents. They have three games left in the season. The Buckeyes host Northwestern next Saturday, then go to Nebraska , then host Michigan to end the regular season. Of course, the struggles come directly after the loss of Julian Sayin to a likely season-ending injury. Luke Fahey has filled in, and while he’s shown glimpses of potential, the struggles have been apparent. Jeremiah Smith went more than two full quarters of play without a reception in the loss. And the defense hasn’t performed well either. So, what’s going to change for Ohio State? We’re not sure. But if one thing is certain after today’s performance, it’s that things aren’t going to stay the same.

articles._body: Manager Don Mattingly’s Philadelphia Phillies failed to win the World Series after a solid regular season and have been urged to pursue two MLB stars in free agency . Mattingly’s team’s possible pursuit of Milwaukee Brewers closer Trevor Megill got a big update as fans began daydreaming about what President of Baseball Operations Dave Dombrowski and Vice President/General Manager Preston Mattingly might cook up this offseason. The Yankees legend and Phillies manager Mattingly had choice words for an MLB Network host as he shared his thoughts on working under his son. “Not really…I think I’m just tired of him being my boss,” Don Mattingly said when asked if he was tired of being asked questions about his son. “When you don’t take that pitcher out in the sixth, and then it doesn’t go good, and then afterwards, you gotta listen to the questions from him and Dave, and I can just tell from the questions on his face, you should (have) taken him. “It’s really been a lot of fun, actually, working with Preston, Preston’s sharp, I feel like I’ve learned a lot from him, the way he looks at things is sometimes different from the way I would look at it. But it’s been interesting…It’s been a lot of fun for me.” The Phillies have big changes in store with MLB labor talks and Bryce Harper’s playing status up in the air for 2027. The Mattingly family will almost certainly be along for the ride as they seek to level up following an 88-win campaign in 2026. articles._body: I am not sure how many here have tried Duolingo for French, but I actually had a hard time speaking in the real world. For me, it is definitely a huge issue. I have level 60, travelled to Paris, and couldn't speak except a few words. I am Georgian, and nobody taught me how to speak English. I only learned it by watching Game of Thrones multiple times, just using English subtitles and audio for many years, switching between Georgian and English. Watching the same episodes again really helped. Dual subtitles are what I really needed. So right now, I am using Netflix and watching my favorite TV show using French audio and French subtitles + English, where I remember most of the dialogues, and I highly recommend everyone to do it! I tried the LanguageReactor Chrome extension, but it wasn't good enough. So I decided to build a new one to actually help me roleplay scenes and practice my speaking, not just save some words. articles.title: LSU’s Lane Kiffin explains risky play-calling in loss to Alabama
articles.summary: Lane Kiffin and his LSU football team had a weird first half in their 31-13 loss to Alabama. The Tigers’ second quarter was particularly rough as they missed a field goal, turned the ball over on downs in the red zone, and threw an costly interception on their three drives. Kiffin’s c
articles._body: Lane Kiffin and his LSU football team had a weird first half in their 31-13 loss to Alabama. The Tigers’ second quarter was particularly rough as they missed a field goal, turned the ball over on downs in the red zone, and threw an costly interception on their three drives. Kiffin’s call to go for it on fourth down inside the 10 was one of a couple the LSU coach made relatively early in the game as he got aggressive with his play-calling. As he explained post-game, the sense he got on the sideline was that the Tigers couldn’t settle for field goals if they were going to win the game. “It kind of felt the start of the game, both teams moving the ball. We got the field goal. It kind of felt down there like it was probably going to be more high-scoring than it ended up being through three quarters. And so it just kind of felt like there was a time there where field goals weren’t going to win the game,” Kiffin said. Kiffin also went for it on fourth down during a third-quarter drive that ended up paying off. Alabama was called for a pass interference penalty, and LSU went on to score a touchdown in that drive to take a 13-10 lead. However, the Tigers were unable to convert on any of their three fourth-down attempts in the fourth quarter as the Crimson Tide eventually pulled away for a 31-13 win. At 6-3, LSU’s already faint College Football Playoff hopes in Lane Kiffin’s first year look all but over. articles._body: The Philadelphia 76ers are looking to get back in the win column on Sunday as they visit the Chicago Bulls, but it appears as if they will have their regular starting lineup intact. Joel Embiid, who has missed two of the 76ers’ games so far this season, was listed as probable on the team’s injury report against the Bulls. Joel Embiid was officially listed on the 76ers’ report as dealing with right foot plantar fascia injury management. It’s not a new injury, it’s from last season and the 76ers are likely taking a precautious approaching to managing their star big man’s health. Amid the team’s roster revamp in the offseason, adding stars LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, Embiid remains a very important piece to the 76ers’ potential success. The seven-time All-Star and 2023 league MVP is still among the very best centers in the NBA. This season, he’s playing a little over 32 minutes per game across the eight games he’s appeared in. He’s averaging 17.9 points, 9.6 rebounds and 4.0 assists with splits of 38.1 percent shooting from the field, 10.7 percent shooting from the 3-point line and 89.3 percent shooting from the free-throw line. While Embiid’s shooting percentages might be cause for alarm , conventional wisdom suggests he gets closer to his career averages as the season progresses. The No. 3 overall pick in the 2014 NBA Draft, Embiid was thought to be a franchise cornerstone for the 76ers. In a manner of speaking, he has been, he’s only been dashed with bad injury luck. Last year, amid being limited to only 38 games, Embiid was able to return for the playoffs and help lead the 76ers to an opening round upset against the Boston Celtics. articles._body: North Carolina Central secured a come-from-behind victory over Michael Vick’s Norfolk State Spartans , 29-28. Norfolk State appeared to be taking control when a Jalyn Daniels touchdown to open the fourth quarter put the Spartans up 28-17. North Carolina Central answered right away. The Eagles put together a seven-play, 75-yard drive that Jones finished with a 7-yard keeper, cutting the deficit to 28-23 with more than 11 minutes left to play. The ending turned on two late fumbles and a missed kick. Gino Addison, who ran for a game-high 174 yards on 18 carries, fumbled, and Norfolk State recovered with 1:27 remaining. Quarterback Deljay Bailey then ran for 13 yards but fumbled it right back to Central. Jones found Wall for the 26-yard touchdown that put the Eagles ahead 29-28 with 27 seconds left. Norfolk State still had a chance. After an unsportsmanlike conduct penalty on North Carolina Central, the Spartans moved into range, and Marco Peery lined up for a 37-yard field goal attempt with four seconds left that missed. Now, Michael Vick continues to look for his first win in the MEAC after losing against DeSean Jackson’s Delaware State Hornets in the Battle Of The Legends last week. Meanwhile, North Carolina Central, after starting out slowly early in the season, now finds itself in the running for another appearance in the Celebration Bowl and the MEAC Championship. They now prepare to face South Carolina State . The Eagles have yet to beat South Carolina State since Chennis Berry took over the program for a departing Buddy Pough in the 2024 season. articles._body: Coach Bill Belichick coached 24 seasons with the New England Patriots ( now coached by Mike Vrabel ) as he led his team to five Super Bowls, four of which came with Rob Gronkowski as his star tight end. The modern-day Patriots are reeling in the injury department , particularly at wide receiver with AJ Brown out, and don’t have a bona fide star to pair with Drake Maye, like Gronkowski was during his time with the team. Former teammates including Brady, linebacker Niko Koutouvides, wide receiver Troy Brown, Julian Edelman, and former offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels were also on the ceremony’s guest list. The party maven Gronkowski’s praise of the straight-laced Belichick shows that the respect runs deep. articles._body: Jeremiah Smith was not happy with the lack of attention during a stretch of the No. 12 Ohio State Buckeyes’ 41-28 loss to the No. 23 Oregon Ducks on Saturday evening. Smith is going through the junior campaign of his collegiate career with the Buckeyes. He shines as one of the best wide receivers in the country, making a solid case for the Heisman Trophy. Ohio State also looks to be in CFP contention, seeking a return to the national championship throne. However, they seemed to have met their match with Oregon this weekend. The Ducks did an excellent job limiting Smith’s production for most of the game. Smith only four receptions for 46 yards through three quarters. He also hasn’t gotten a target since the first quarter going into the third. Finally getting a catch near the end of the period, Smith expressed his verbal frustration on the field. Jeremiah Smith expressing his frustration. This was his first catch since the 1st quarter. pic.twitter.com/Se64KiZuMA — CBS Sports College Football (@CBSSportsCFB) November 7, 2026 How Jeremiah Smith, Ohio State played against Oregon It was a frustrating night for Jeremiah Smith and Ohio State, suffering another damaging loss to Oregon at home. It took some time for Oregon to get going, trailing 14-0 after the first quarter. They roared back with a remarkable response, torching Ohio State 31-0 in the second and third periods. The Buckeyes never recovered from that stretch, attempting a rally that ended up being unsuccessful. Luke Fahey started in Julian Sayin’s place due to injury, being active with his throws in the air. He completed 36 out of 50 passes for 360 yards and two touchdowns and one interception. Bo Jackson was active on the ground, racking up 11 carries for 48 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven passes for 42 yards. Smith led receivers with seven catches for 133 yards and a touchdown. Devin McQuin came next with nine receptions for 84 yards, while Nate Roberts caught three passes for 26 yards and a touchdown. The No. 12 Buckeyes will look to bounce back in their next matchup, remaining at home. They host the Northwestern Wildcats in Week 11 as kickoff commences on Nov. 14 at 12 p.m. ET. Jamal Murray turned in a well-rounded stat line himself, posting 16 points (6-of-13), eight dimes and six rebounds. The Pacers, who are still without star point guard Tyrese Haliburton , fought valiantly in the high altitude despite falling short. Pascal Siakam scored a game-high 23 points on 10-of-18 shooting, Ivica Zubac notched a double-double and Larry Nance Jr, matched a career high with five made 3-pointers off the bench. articles._body: The Ohio State football season is turning out to be a full-fledged disaster. After suffering painful losses to Texas and USC, the Buckeyes (6-3) were hoping to get their season back in gear when they returned home for a game against struggling Oregon (6-3). JEREMIAH SMITH FRUSTRATED Smith was seen screaming toward the sideline as Ohio State trailed Oregon 31-14 late in the third quarter. pic.twitter.com/U15XEpkhDJ — SportsCenter (@SportsCenter) November 7, 2026 The Ducks came into the game having lost 2 of their last 4 games. They had been beaten UCLA and Illinois mixed in with close victories over Nebraska and Northwestern. A trip to the horseshoe in Columbus did not look like the ideal place for the Ducks to turn their season around. It didn’t get off to a good start, as Ohio State raced out to a 14-0 lead at the end of the first quarter. However, a bell went off for the Ducks after that, and they took apart the Buckeyes. Ducks respond with hot streak Oregon scored 38 consecutive points before Ohio State would score again. The Buckeyes had problems on both sides of the ball, as Oregon quarterback Dylan Raiola was able to sit in the pocket and spread the ball around to his receivers. Ohio State was unable to put any pressure on Raiola. Oregon emerged with a 41-28 upset victory and Ohio State fans were angered with their team’s brutal performance. The Buckeyes have been forced to go with backup quarterback Luke Fahey since the injury to starter Julian Sayin. After a hot start in the first quarter, Fahey and the Buckeyes offense were unable to continue the chase. As Oregon scored on multiple possessions, the Buckeyes failed on play after play. Ohio State fans let Fahey and head coach Ryan Day hear their dissatisfaction with loud booing. Nobody was more upset than wide receiver Jeremiah Smith, who is widely considered the best college player in the nation. While his overall stats for the game were respectable as he caught 7 passes for 133 yards and 1 touchdown, he was angered by the inconsistent offense when the Ducks were on their 38-point roll. articles._body: To say Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Doncic is off to a hot start to the 2026-27 NBA season would be an incredible understatement. The six-time All-Star’s offensive outburst has led the Lakers to an 8-2 record and atop the Western Conference Standings. They are tied with the Philadelphia 76ers for the best record in the league. While the NBA world marvels at Doncic’s feats, teammate Austin Reaves saw this coming. Near the start of last season, Luka Doncic dropped 91 points in two games (45.5 average) for the Lakers, albeit going 1-1. Through 10 games played, Doncic is averaging 40.1 points, ESPN reporter Dave McMenamin recently reposted his article where Austin Reaves correctly predicted that this was coming. Reaves not only said that Doncic could average 40 points a game, but that it would help the team win. And that’s certainly what Doncic has been doing to start the year. In his last four games, he’s dropped 45, 42, 40 and 53 points, all Laker wins. And he’s been doing so on high efficiency. He’s shooting 49.8 percent from the field and 41.9 percent from the 3-point line, both career-highs. In addition to his scoring, he’s also averaging 7.8 rebounds, 7.7 assists and 1.7 steals, making an impact on both ends of the court. Not only is he leading the league in scoring, but also in field goals made (12.2) and attempted (24.6), 3-pointers made (5.8) and attempted (13.8) and free-throws made (9.9) and attempted (11.3). The Lakers will put their four-game win streak on the line when they visit the Detroit Pistons on Sunday, Nov. 8. However, the team might be without their offensive ace as Doncic was listed as questionable on the front end of a back-to-back. articles.title: Alanis Morissette Shares She Identifies as Pansexual
articles.summary: The singer-songwriter chatted about it briefly in a podcast appearance the week of releasing her new holiday album.
articles._body: Alanis Morissette identifies as pansexual, she revealed in a podcast appearance earlier this week. The hitmaker — who just dropped her first holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception , featuring new single “To an Empath at Christmas Time” — visited the Handsome Podcast as the podcast trio’s first in-person guest for an episode that was uploaded on Nov. 3. Related Alanis Morissette Announces First Christmas Album, Drops Lead Track Featuring Brandi Carlile & Steve Martin Druski & The Strokes on 'SNL': Here's Where to Watch 'Saturday Night Live' Online for Free WWE Crown Jewel 2026: Here's How to Watch the Premium Live Event Online for Free “I’m sorry for the men that hurt you, but I’m not sorry for the songs that came from it. Those are pretty amazing,” comedian Fortune Feimster, who co-hosts the show with Tig Notaro and Mae Martin, said at one point toward the end of the episode, adding, “Did it make you want to be a lesbian at any point?” “I’m pansexual, so yeah,” Morissette shared in reply. “I get everything.” GLAAD defines someone who identifies as pansexual as “a person who has the capacity to form enduring physical, romantic, and/ or emotional attractions to any person, regardless of gender identity.” The term is different than the term bisexual, which means that a person is attracted to people of more than one gender (whereas pansexual means gender is not a determining factor in attraction). Notaro then asked, “Wait, you’re not really pansexual, are you?” to which Morissette confirmed, “I am.” Joking that they should’ve launched the episode with this tidbit, Notaro said, “How did I not know this?” “You know, I like to leave it for the epilogue,” quipped Morissette. “I like to confuse people on the way out. Is it confusing?” Morissette, who’s got three Billboard 200 No. 1 albums under her belt and whose top hit “Ironic” soared to No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1996, is married to husband Mario Treadway, aka the artist Souleye. The couple wed in 2010 and are parents to three children. Her 14-track holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception , arrived on Friday (Nov. 6). The set was led by her recording of “Beautiful Star of Bethlehem,” featuring Brandi Carlile and Steve Martin; Morissette gets snowed-in in a music video for second single “To an Empath at Christmas Time,” released on Saturday. “The lights are green and red and shimmering white/ These days are super dark and even quieter nights/ All this time to sense what all year felt not right/ Nothing to distract us from this heavy ride,” she sings on the opening of the midtempo “Empath.” On the song’s chorus, Morissette says, “You don’t have to smile big for us/ Nor have a joyous time/ You won’t have to hold your breath until New Year time/ Your precious sensitivity has felt like curse and crime/ But you’re not alone with your SOS inside/ To an empath at Christmas time.” Watch her full conversation on the Handsome Podcast below.

articles.title: So much ‘liquid gold’ could hit the market that the world’s top producer is withholding output—but supplies can’t stay ‘extra virgin’ for long
articles.summary: Spanish olive oil production is projected to jump 23% to 1.6 millions tons, marking the fourth-largest harvest ever.
articles._body: A bumper harvest of olives threatens to jolt the olive oil market, prompting the world’s top producer to suppress supplies for the first time ever. On Friday, Spain’s agriculture ministry ordered farmers to hold back 12% of their production until the end of September 2027, requiring them to store supplies on their farms or at third-party facilities. “The measure aims to ensure farmers’ profitability and also to protect the interests of olive oil buyers,” it said, according to the Financial Times , adding that “greater stability to the market” will benefit producers and consumers. While the move is unprecedented, the European Union allows olive oil supplies to be held back, unless it leads to excessive market distortion. The current harvest season for so-called “liquid gold” began in September, and favorable weather this past spring promises to reverse years of drought and heat that kept olive production low. This season, Spanish olive oil production is projected to jump 23% to 1.6 millions tons, marking the fourth-largest harvest ever. The agriculture ministry seeks to keep 188,000 tons off the market. But expectations for more supply have already sent olive oil prices down. At mills in Andalusia, they averaged 2.93 euros per kilogram last weekend, down about 15% in about two months. The olive oil industry has pushed back against the government’s attempt to prop up prices, pointing out the market is global while the order only applies to Spanish producers. Kyle Holland, senior analyst at commodity data firm Expana, also noted that olive oil degrades over time, telling that FT that after several months in storage ”very quickly that olive oil is not going to be extra virgin anymore.” He added that top olive oil buyers already have hefty supplies, so ordering farmers to store away some production would have little immediate impact on prices. Spain isn’t the only country dealing with wild swings in key commodities. The Quebec Maple Syrup Producers, which oversees Canada’s strategic syrup reserve, recently warned the stockpile will be completely empty by February. While new supplies will continue to be produced, the reserve won’t be able to help ease any wobbles in output, which depends heavily on the weather and can be volatile. Demand has increased in recent years as producers have diversified to more market beyond the U.S., but last year saw an especially big spike after President Donald Trump launched his global trade war. To get ahead of anticipated tariffs, Americans rushed to buy up Canadian syrup supplies. As a result, total syrup exports jumped nearly 16% last year, up from 9% growth in 2024. Meanwhile, the Iran war has forced oil-consuming countries around the world to drain crude stockpiles. In the U.S., the Strategic Petroleum Reserve has fallen to the lowest level since 1982. Elsewhere, Japan has a rice reserve that had to be drawn down last year as prices soared amid bad weather and looming threats from natural disasters that sparked panic buying. But this year, Japan has already swung to a record surplus . And China tapped its strategic pork reserve in 2019 after an outbreak of swine fever sent prices higher. But this year, prices have slumped as the anemic consumer economy has weighed on demand while the government’s prior encouragement to boost production has now resulted in oversupply. Pork prices have plunged 39% over the last four years. To help prop up the market, China has repeatedly purchased pork for the strategic reserve. This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Ohio State’s implosion vs. Oregon reaches new low not seen in 27 years
articles.summary: Coach Ryan Day’s Ohio State Buckeyes had a strong first quarter at the Horsehoe in Columbus vs. the Oregon Ducks, but gave up 17 points in the second quarter on a day when Luke Fahey filled in for injured QB Julian Sayin. The Buckeyes got a big prediction from a former All-American before t
articles._body: Coach Ryan Day’s Ohio State Buckeyes had a strong first quarter at the Horsehoe in Columbus vs. the Oregon Ducks, but gave up 17 points in the second quarter on a day when Luke Fahey filled in for injured QB Julian Sayin . The Buckeyes got a big prediction from a former All-American before the game, but let him down as they fell behind, 38-14, with four minutes left in the fourth and final quarter. Stewart Mandel of The Athletic shared the news of Ohio State’s epic collapse against the Ducks. “Ohio State hasn’t given up this many points at home to a team ranked this low since 1999,” Mandel wrote. The game also marked the first time the Buckeyes had given up 38 unanswered points since 1999 against the Wisconsin Badgers, as defensive coordinator Matt Patricia’s unit was outfoxed and outplayed at Ohio Stadium. The Buckeyes made the score a more respectable 38-22 after Luke Fahey rushed for a two-point conversion on the heels of a 13-yard touchdown toss to Jeremiah Smith. A strong rushing day from Bo Jackson did little to assuage frustrations of the Buckeyes’ fans. Ducks fans eagerly awaited the end of the game as they wondered how the postgame handshake would go between Lanning and Day after Day’s viral dust-up with Lincoln Riley in Week 9 after losing to the USC Trojans. The Ducks reeled off 5.6 yards per play while Ohio State had 4.9 yards per play and the game began to wind down in Columbus. Ohio State clung to faint hopes of a comeback victory, but Lanning and Oregon looked like they were about to secure a much-needed win over their nemeses and fellow Big Ten adervsaries. articles.summary: LOS ANGELES – Since JJ Redick took the helm as head coach of the Los Angeles Lakers, the team has used their two-way contract players quite often. In year one, Christian Koloko and Trey Jemison received plenty of minutes amid the Anthony Davis trade, while Jordan Goodwin had his deal conver
articles._body: LOS ANGELES – Since JJ Redick took the helm as head coach of the Los Angeles Lakers, the team has used their two-way contract players quite often. In year one, Christian Koloko and Trey Jemison received plenty of minutes amid the Anthony Davis trade, while Jordan Goodwin had his deal converted to standard contract. Last year, Drew Timme and Nick Smith Jr. contributed to wins while Smith had his contract converted. This year, one player looking to potentially get minutes for the Lakers is Chris Mañon . The second-year guard is back on a two-way contract, and during his rookie season, Redick mentioned that he has the tools to become an elite defensive player in the NBA . Chris Mañon didn’t see much playing time last year with the Lakers, and he’s beginning this season getting reps in the G League with the rebranded Coachella Valley Lakers. While Mañon has always been more of a shooting guard, one thing the Lakers’ coaching staff had asked of him during training camp and the preseason was to play more point guard. It’s been an adjustment for him, but it’s challenge he’s willing to meet head on. “It’s a whole new role. You got to get your team organized, get them into plays, keep them in the right spots. You got to help them out all while handling pressure, people trying to take the ball from you,” Mañon said during Coachella Valley Media Day on Nov. 2. “It’s super fun for me. I love learning new things and being able to be versatile, so it’s been super fun.” Across the last two seasons, Mañon has appeared in a total of 11 games for the Lakers. The G League is where he’s been able to get live reps and he started this season off with a bang. In Coachella Valley’s opening night win against the Salt Lake City Stars, he finished with 17 points, five rebounds, three assists and three steals. Last year, he appeared in 46 games with the then South Bay Lakers, at a little over 26 minutes per game. He averaged 11.6 points, 6.0 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 2.1 steals while shooting 51.2 percent from the field. While he has the most experience out of the Lakers’ three two-way contract players, it’s a good bet he’ll see most of his game reps with Coachella Valley. And if that’s the case, Mañon is on board with being able to continue sharpening his skills to stick in the NBA. “That’s what it is, you get to develop your skills and learn and grow with a different group of guys,” Mañon said. “Hopefully Coach [Alex] Cerda lets me continue to grow and I’m super excited to play.” The Lakers’ G League team is coming off a historic season having finished atop the Western Conference standings with a 26-10 record. That included a franchise record 12-game win streak, and Mañon being named to the G League All-Defensive Team while being the runner-up in the Defensive Player of the Year voting. Amid a coaching change with Zach Guthrie being promoted to Redick’s staff and Alex Cerda taking the helm, Coachella Valley still stands to be a good team, especially if they get help from the Lakers as they did for Friday’s win with Bronny James and Cameron Carr. “Obviously we made a pretty deep run last year in the G League playoffs,” Mañon said. “I think … we’re one of the premier teams in the G League. We’re going to compete every day, play as hard as we can. We got some high-flyers on the team, we got some people that can score, people that can handle. We got a little bit of everything on this team.” The post The ‘super fun’ new role Chris Mañon is eager to play for Lakers appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Could Yankees’ Ben Rice return to catcher in 2027?
articles.summary: Ben Rice made his MLB debut with the New York Yankees during the 2024 season. He primarily played first base, but did catch in one contest. The 2025 campaign saw Rice spend various amounts of time in different roles. He played first base and designated hitter most of the time, but he did catch in
articles._body: Ben Rice made his MLB debut with the New York Yankees during the 2024 season. He primarily played first base, but did catch in one contest. The 2025 campaign saw Rice spend various amounts of time in different roles. He played first base and designated hitter most of the time, but he did catch in 36 games (26 starts). In his 2026 All-Star season , Rice did not catch a single game . With New York in need of catching help, could Rice return to the position in 2027? Bryan Hoch of MLB.com recently published an article that looked at areas of the lineup where the Yankees can improve this offseason. Unsurprisingly, catcher was mentioned. Hoch brought up the idea of Rice being a potential “in-house” option for New York. “One in-house alternative to consider is Rice,” Hoch wrote. “… Given their roster construction, the Yankees would benefit from keeping Rice’s catching in play.” The chances of Ben Rice becoming a full-time catcher in the big leagues are likely slim. He just hit 41 home runs and recorded an .897 OPS while spending time at DH and first base. Forcing Rice to consistently focus on catcher could impact his offensive performance. However, Hoch makes a good point. “Keeping Rice’s catching in play” makes sense. Even if he catches just 20-30 games, having him be a third option of sorts at the position makes sense. The Yankees could lean on two catchers — likely a starter and a backup unless a quality platoon opportunity presents itself. Rice could then start on occasion while still serving as the DH or first baseman most of the time. Will the Yankees take that approach? It remains to be seen. If the Yankees want an uptick in offensive production at the catcher position, 30 games of Rice catching would go a long way toward helping that goal become a reality. articles.title: Bob Chesney leads UCLA to first 9-0 record since 1998
articles.summary: Nobody expected the UCLA Bruins to emerge as one of the top teams in the Big Ten this year. After last season’s painful 3-9 season, it seemed the Bruins would have been happy with a .500 season. In his first year at the helm, Bob Chesney has led the Bruins to their first 9-0 start […]
articles._body: Nobody expected the UCLA Bruins to emerge as one of the top teams in the Big Ten this year. After last season’s painful 3-9 season, it seemed the Bruins would have been happy with a .500 season. In his first year at the helm, Bob Chesney has led the Bruins to their first 9-0 start since 1998 following today's win over Minnesota. pic.twitter.com/bIJrMWZg4o — FOX College Football (@CFBONFOX) November 7, 2026 Nobody gave that message to first-year head coach Bob Chesney. He was hired to take over the UCLA program after his successful run at James Madison, and he has put together a brilliant year. The Bruins improved their record to 9-0 (6-0 in the Big Ten) after the Bruins defeated Minnesota 34-20 in Minneapolis. The Bruins are 9-0 for the first time since the 1968 season Not only did the Bruins take it to the Gophers, they did it in an early start that was the equivalent of 9 a.m. Pacific Time. There was no hesitation as the Bruins moved down the field smartly on their opening possession before going ahead on a field goal. However, the story of the game for Chesney’s team was its big play ability, particularly in the second half. Quarterback Ty Dieffenbach threw a pair of 75-yard TD passes to wide receiver Aidan Mizell in the fourth quarter to give the Bruins full control of the game. Diffenbach received brilliant protection by the UCLA offensive line on both TD passes, and Mizell’s speed allowed him to run through the Golden Gophers secondary and into the end zone. Diffenbach took over at quarterback for injured Nico Iamaleava one month ago. He passed for a career-best 303 yards as he completed 8 0f 16 passes with 3 TDs and 1 interception. The UCLA offensive line allowed just 1 sack. The Bruins ( ranked 8th in the CFP rankings, 5th in the AP poll) have regular-season games remaining against Illinois, Michigan and archrival USC. articles._body: Dierre Hill Jr. showed off his explosiveness with an incredible touchdown highlight in the No. 23 Oregon Ducks’ clash with the No. 12 Ohio State Buckeyes on Saturday afternoon. Hill is going through the sophomore campaign of his collegiate career with the Ducks. He stands out as the full-time starter at running back, producing great plays as an attacker on the ground. Oregon needs all the offense it can get following Dante Moore’s season-ending injury, requiring Dylan Raiola to step up in his absence. Hill looks to step into the spotlight as the Ducks’ center of the adjusted offense, showing off his pure talent during Oregon’s matchup with Ohio State. The touchdown highlight took place in the early minutes of the third quarter. Hill gashed through the Ohio State run defense, dashing his way for 48 yards into the end zone for the touchdown. Oregon RB Dierre Hill Jr. refused to go down on this 48-yard TD to put the Ducks up two scores over Ohio State. pic.twitter.com/uJIj1QdgHU — Underdog CFB (@UnderdogCFB) November 7, 2026 How Dierre Hill Jr., Oregon played against Ohio State Dierre Hill Jr. enjoyed a strong offensive performance, pulling off the ranked upset win over the Buckeyes. It took some time for Oregon to get going, trailing 14-0 after the first quarter. They roared back with a remarkable response, torching Ohio State 31-0 in the second and third periods. The Buckeyes never recovered from that stretch, attempting a rally that ended up being unsuccessful. Dylan Raiola had a solid performance leading the offense, completing 25 out of 40 passes for 257 yards and two touchdowns. Hill led the rushing attack with 13 carries for 75 yards and two touchdowns while catching four passes for 31 yards. Dakorien Moore led receivers with seven catches for 56 yards and a touchdown, while Brandon Smith caught three passes for 52 yards and a touchdown. Meanwhile, Evan Stewart recorded four receptions for 47 yards. The No. 23 Ducks will look forward to their next matchup, being at home. They host the Michigan Wolverines in Week 11 as kickoff commences on Nov. 14 at 3:30 p.m. ET. articles.title: South Carolina’s LaNorris Sellers pulls off amazing 41-yard TD run while limping
articles.summary: Coach Shane Beamer’s South Carolina Gamecocks welcomed the Texas A&M Aggies to Williams-Brice Stadium in Columbis, South Carolina for a game that saw star QB LaNorris Sellers exit with an apparent injury. Sellers turned heads with his unique choice of internship before the game and then
articles._body: Coach Shane Beamer’s South Carolina Gamecocks welcomed the Texas A&M Aggies to Williams-Brice Stadium in Columbis, South Carolina for a game that saw star QB LaNorris Sellers exit with an apparent injury . Sellers turned heads with his unique choice of internship before the game and then took the field to battle the Aggies. Sellers pulled a Willis Reed in the fourth quarter as he came back into the game. He wasn’t moving as well as fans had noticed before, but he still reeled off a clutch game-winning touchdown run that sent the hometown faithful into a ruckus in Columbia. "HE CAN BARELY WALK AND HE JUST SCORED THE GAME WINNER" VIA ESPN pic.twitter.com/AtMhRinNgP — 247Sports (@247Sports) November 7, 2026 South Carolina won by a score of 17-9, moving to 6-3 on the season, 4-3 in the rugged SEC Conference. They managed to bring home the win on the strength of 251 passing yards, even though the Aggies outgained them on the day by totals of 457 to 360. Sellers finished with 20-of-31 completions for 251 yards and a touchdown while also rushing for 34 yards on six carries including the game winner. His top receiving target was former five-star recruit Nyck Harbor, a physically imposing player with track speed who caught four passes for 70 yards. Mazeo Bennett Jr. added three catches for 66 yards and a touchdown while Brady Hunt added three catches for 51 yards. Sellers was up to his old tricks in Week 9 against Oklahoma , and looked like a stud against the Aggies in a winning effort. The Gamecocks now have a chance to finish their season out on a strong note with Arkansas, No. 2 Georgia, and Clemson on the docket in the near future. articles.title: Watch Oregon execute insane fake punt vs. Ohio State
articles.summary: Oregon football was unlikely to stump a top-notch Ohio State defense straight up, especially in the face of an unrelenting Columbus crowd. Dylan Raiola is coming off a fabulous outing versus Northwestern, but a little creativity is still needed. Dan Lanning and the Ducks disoriented the Buckeyes
articles._body: Oregon football was unlikely to stump a top-notch Ohio State defense straight up, especially in the face of an unrelenting Columbus crowd. Dylan Raiola is coming off a fabulous outing versus Northwestern, but a little creativity is still needed. Dan Lanning and the Ducks disoriented the Buckeyes late in the first half with a trick play , and what ensued was a seismic shift in momentum. Showing a punting formation on fourth-and-9 on its own 31-yard line, Oregon snapped the ball to senior linebacker Teitum Tuioti, who ran briefly before passing the ball to Jalen Lott. The freshman wide receiver sprinted across swaths of open space and then hurdled over a defender to cap off a 30-yard reception. Down 14-3 with less than three minutes remaining in the first half, the Ducks were seemingly about to cede possession to Ohio State. Instead, through masterful misdirection and enormous guts, they flipped the game. WHAT IN THE WORLD?! FAKE PUNT JUMP PASS!! pic.twitter.com/27mOQkOqSX — CBS Sports (@CBSSports) November 7, 2026 Dierre Hill Jr. scored on a 9-yard rushing touchdown with 1:25 left in the second quarter. Oregon picked off Buckeyes quarterback Luke Fahey on the next drive and ended the half with a Jamari Johnson 2-yard sneak TD run . One more Ohio State score, and this game would have been out of hand before the break. Stunningly, the Ducks went into the locker room up 17-14. Hill stretched the lead to begin the third via a 48-yard rushing touchdown. Oregon punctured gaping holes in a Matt Patricia-coached defense that showed signs of vulnerability last Saturday versus USC. One play should not destroy a squad, especially when they are leading, but the Ducks’ perfectly designed fake punt completely changed the complexion of this Big Ten matchup. Ingenuity is a boon to those who wield it, and a curse to those victimized by it. The post Watch Oregon execute insane fake punt vs. Ohio State appeared first on ClutchPoints .

Alabama Power spent more than $6 million on ads last year — and customers can be billed for half of them until 2029
articles.summary: Jim Zeigler, a perennial candidate in Alabama across several decades, will return to the PSC 48 years after leaving the commission.
articles._body: This article originally appeared on Inside Climate News , a nonprofit, non-partisan news organization that covers climate, energy and the environment. Sign up for their newsletter here . On a busy election day, the Alabama Public Service Commission requested that Alabama Power voluntarily stop billing customers, effective immediately, for television commercials and other ads it buys to promote various aspects of its business. Alabama Power is the largest electricity provider in Alabama, with territory covering about two-thirds of the state. Though it is a monopoly, the company spends millions each year on advertising, touting its reliability, customer service and other aspects of its business.  In recent months, the company has launched a series of television commercials touting a rate freeze it announced late last year amid heavy criticism over rising electricity prices.  A state law passed earlier this year will prohibit Alabama Power from including the costs of those commercials in customers’ electric bills, meaning the powerful utility will have to find all of the dollars in corporate profits. But the new law won’t take effect until 2029. Currently, Alabama Power is allowed to bill customers for half of its non-public safety advertising costs.  During Tuesday’s meeting, PSC President Cynthia Lee Almond moved to “request” that Alabama Power voluntarily begin excluding those costs immediately. “I don’t see any reason why we shouldn’t go ahead and take steps now to begin that process, rather than waiting until Jan. 1, 2029,” Almond said during the meeting. Almond then made her motion, which was not on the meeting agenda, but came after the regular report from the commission’s electricity division.  “I move that the commission request that Alabama Power consent to exclude all advertising expenses from retail rate setting until after Dec. 31, 2028, when the new law takes effect,” Almond said. “Assuming Alabama Power consents, this interim measure would be reflected in its [Rate Stabilization and Equalization] filings for 2027 and 2028.”  Commissioners Jeremy Oden and Chris Beeker IV voted yes after a brief discussion.  According to the company filings with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, Alabama Power spent more than $6 million in general advertising last year, roughly $4 per customer. It’s unclear from the federal filing how much of that total was passed on to customers or how much might be impacted by the new prohibition.  Alabama Power did not immediately respond to a request for comment.  Daniel Tait, executive director of Energy Alabama, said the move was a boon to Alabama Power customers, who faced some of the highest electric bills in the country in recent years.  “We are grateful for the leadership of President Almond and the full commission for acting to end customers paying for Alabama Power’s advertising,” Tait said. “Once in place, Alabama will have one of the strongest customer protections in the nation on this front.” This will be among the last actions of the commission under its current construction before a major overhaul takes effect.  In January, the commission will expand from three members to seven. Outgoing Gov. Kay Ivey has appointed four new commissioners , who will take office in January, including the PSC’s two first-ever Black members.  Oden and Beeker will also leave the commission in January after being defeated in Republican primaries. Cullman County Sheriff Matt Gentry will take Oden’s Place 1 seat, and former state auditor and PSC Commissioner Jim Zeigler will replace Beeker in Place 2.  Zeigler, a perennial candidate in Alabama across several decades, will return to the commission 48 years after leaving the PSC. He served one term from 1975-1979, during an era of skyrocketing energy costs and protracted political battles over electric rates between Alabama Power and then-Gov. George Wallace.  Almond will be the sole remaining member of the current commission.  The new seven-member commission will be overseen by the state’s first secretary of energy, who will be selected by Gov.-elect Tommy Tuberville. The new secretary will set the commission agenda, and overruling the secretary will require a vote of five of seven commissioners.  Tuberville has not yet announced his pick for secretary of energy. The only statutory requirement is that the secretary “must have experience in utility regulation or energy policy or a related field.” This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Orioles rumors: Gunnar Henderson trade gossip gets reality check
articles.summary: Rumors have swirled early in the MLB offseason that have suggested the Baltimore Orioles will consider trading anyone on the roster aside from first baseman Pete Alonso. While the O’s would benefit from some changes following their mediocre 2026 season, will they be open to moving star infi
articles._body: Rumors have swirled early in the MLB offseason that have suggested the Baltimore Orioles will consider trading anyone on the roster aside from first baseman Pete Alonso . While the O’s would benefit from some changes following their mediocre 2026 season, will they be open to moving star infielder Gunnar Henderson despite his multiple years of team control remaining on his contract? Jake Rill of MLB.com recently addressed the idea of a Henderson trade. “It seems highly unlikely the Orioles would trade Henderson,” Rill wrote in a recent article. “… It would take a huge offer to pry him away from Baltimore.” Henderson had some good moments this past season , but he did not perform up to his expectations. The 2024 All-Star hit just .225 to go along with a .712 OPS in 2026. He added 24 home runs and 10 stolen bases. Even if the Orioles were open to trading him, one would imagine they would wait another year or two in hopes that Henderson finds his All-Star form once again. Say he has a massive year in 2027 and a contract extension proves to be unrealistic. Trading him next offseason in that scenario would lead to more trade return value in a deal. Of course, it remains to be seen if Baltimore is even open to the idea of moving him at all within the next couple of years. As Rill mentioned, the O’s would need to receive a “huge offer” to even consider the idea of trading him soon. Barring unforeseen circumstances, it seems likely that Gunnar Henderson will once again be in the Orioles lineup to begin the 2027 campaign. articles.title: Show HN: Sentient, Your Coding Agent Shouldn't Be a Black Box
articles.summary: after working quite rigorously for a few months with claude code, I found out that I was blindly approving permission requests for the sake of progressing my projects, this led me to realize that coding agents generate hundreds of commands underneath the covers which is necessary, but quite scary
articles._body: after working quite rigorously for a few months with claude code, I found out that I was blindly approving permission requests for the sake of progressing my projects, this led me to realize that coding agents generate hundreds of commands underneath the covers which is necessary, but quite scary if you ask me. you've probably seen news recently about agents deleting databases or environments in production by accident. so i wanted to create something to gain visibility into what's actually happening and potentially block things before they occur. coding agents often log everything that they're doing, but even still, i want the ground level truth of what's happening. that's why i created sentient, written using claude code. it's open source (mit license), runs completely locally, no cloud syncing, read only, and watches actions straight from the kernel. all of this is summarized with a hopefully simple web ui. i run claude code on linux, so kernel tracking relies on tetragon, but, at the same time, i am trying to get approval to use security endpoint on mac, and will eventually roll out on windows. if you want to run sentient today against just the agent logs without kernel logs, that's also available now, you just need golang and sqlite3 to build. and today, i'm only supporting claude code, but will eventually get to codex and the like. please have a try, ping me if you have any questions or comments: hello@nosaka.ai https://github.com/nosaka4i/sentient https://nosaka.ai/blog/sentient Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50409020 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles._body: UCLA football felt some disrespect despite the Bruins ranking fifth in the AP Poll . The College Football Playoff poll plugged UCLA at No. 8, behind two-loss Texas. Now the Bruins gained a vocal backer in Joel Klatt after beating Minnesota 34-20 Saturday. The verbose Fox Sports analyst dropped the mic with this statement directed toward the CFP committee. After @UCLAFootball moved to 9-0, @joelklatt had this to say to the CFP committee pic.twitter.com/8MmYE2QFDB — FOX College Football (@CFBONFOX) November 7, 2026 UCLA continues to hum along under first-year Bruins coach Bob Chesney. The Bruins are off to their best start since the 1998 season now that they’re 9-0 overall. Yet that UCLA team tripped up toward the end of the regular season, falling to Miami 49-45 when the Bruins were ranked No. 3 that season. UCLA then lost in the Rose Bowl to Wisconsin to finish the year. Yet now this Bruins team has become galvanized through the former James Madison coach. Including leaning into backup quarterback Ty Dieffenbach amid Nico Iamaleava losing the rest of his 2026 season with a torn ACL injury . The Cal Poly QB transfer Dieffenbach completed only eight passes out of 16 attempts. But he racked up 303 yards through the air and torched the Golden Gophers with three touchdowns. Dieffenbach averaged an astonishing 18.9 yards per play, including hitting this 75-yard dime. DIEFFENBACH TO MIZELL FOR ANOTHER 75-YARD TOUCHDOWN! That's two in back-to-back drives for @UCLAFootball pic.twitter.com/10OEHyMRlO — FOX College Football (@CFBONFOX) November 7, 2026 He turned Aidan Mizell into a 100-yard performer, catching two passes for 105 yards with both receptions becoming scores. Running back Wayne Knight racked up 109 yards on 18 carries and scored one touchdown. Now UCLA closes the regular season with two home games inside the Rose Bowl, starting with the Nov. 13 showdown against 6-3 Illinois. Then they go to Ann Arbor the following week to face Michigan. Perhaps the Nov. 28 crosstown showdown with USC determines who’ll play for the Big Ten title. Watkins is back on the court following a successful ACL rehab. The Trojans look to be fierce in the mix as they aspire for deep NCAA Tournament runs with Watkins r
articles._body: WNBA legend Candace Parker has high hopes for JuJu Watkins and the USC Lady Trojans’ national championship chances this season. Watkins is back on the court following a successful ACL rehab. The Trojans look to be fierce in the mix as they aspire for deep NCAA Tournament runs with Watkins returning to full health. Parker talked about her picks to win the national championship in both men’s and women’s college basketball during her appearance on the Post Moves podcast. She didn’t hesitate to name Duke as her favorite on the men’s side, but when it came to the women’s side, she decided to go against the typical favorites and favor Watkins and the Trojans squad instead. “I t would be so simple to take number one or number two. I’m a renegade; I don’t like picking with everybody, so I’m gonna pick USC… Juju has her eyes set on a national championship to be one of the greats. That’s what you got to do. You got to win. So I got Southern California ,” Parker said. Candace Parker goes BOLD with JuJu Watkins and the USC Trojans @ATT #att pic.twitter.com/q8URpdQhD1 — Post Moves with Candace Parker & Aliyah Boston (@PostMovesShow) November 7, 2026 What lies ahead for JuJu Watkins, USC this season JuJu Watkins is on a mission to return to form as one of the best players in the country. She has a promising future ahead of her in the pros, needing to deliver great performances to show she has successfully come back from the severe injury. Five players scored in double-digits for USC in the opening win over UNLV, including Watkins. In 25 minutes of action, she finished with a stat line of 21 points, five rebounds, two assists, and two steals. She shot 9-of-22 from the field and 3-of-4 from the free-throw line. Jazz Davidson led the team with 23 points, five rebounds, four assists, and two steals. She shot 10-of-11 overall, including 1-of-2 from downtown. Saniyah Hall came next with 22 points and seven rebounds, Kennedy Smith had 12 points and four steals, while Sitaya Fagan provided 11 points and three assists. The Lady Trojans will look forward to their next matchup, being at home. They host the Utah State Aggies as tip-off commences on Nov. 8 at 8 p.m. ET. articles._body: The New York Mets are preparing for the brief period of free agency before the conclusion of the Collective Bargaining Agreement. Prior to that event that is scheduled for December 2, the Mets are expected to be one of the teams that makes a significant bid for high-profile free agent Tarik Skubal. What could an offer look like from the Mets for Tarik Skubal? @chelsea_janes discusses on the most recent episode of Mets Mailbag: pic.twitter.com/Bb9ZYtRHlv — SNY Mets (@SNY_Mets) November 7, 2026 The long-time Detroit Tiger was traded to the Los Angeles Dodgers shortly before the trade deadline last summer but he did not sign an extension with that team. As a result, the pitching sensation will hit the market and a huge offer is expected. The Mets are clearly one of the teams that Skubal will be talking to because owner Steve Cohen has been committed to bringing in the best and most expensive free agents for several years. Mets insider Chelsea Janes discussed the situation on SNY, and she believes the Mets will make an offer to Skubal that could make him the highest paid pitcher in Major League Baseball. However, while Skubal might want an offer that goes 9 or 10 years, the Mets are not likely to go past 6 or 7 years. She said the Mets don’t mind paying out huge money — “ 7 years for $340 million ” — a term that is longer than that is not likely to be acceptable. If that figure is correct, Skubal would be paid an average of $48.57 million per season. Skubal had a 12-7 record last season while pitching for the Tigers and Dodgers. He had 2.72 earned run average and struck out 186 batters in 158.2 innings. Skubal won the American League Cy Young Award twice, is a two-time All Star and he also won the pitching triple crown. Skubal will turn 30 later this month and he has pitched 7 seasons in the big leagues. The post Mets’ potential Tarik Skubal contract offer gets intriguing update appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles._body: The Los Angeles Lakers are set to play the Detroit Pistons on Sunday night. Luka Doncic is listed on the injury report as questionable due to lower back tightness after scoring 53 points in LA’s 124-118 win against the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday. Walker Kessler is also on the NBA injury report, but he’s listed as available as he deals with a left finger splint. Kessler has enjoyed a big start to his Lakers career . After spending his first four seasons in the NBA with the Utah Jazz, Kessler is now playing a crucial role for an LA team that has championship aspirations. He’s averaged 14.6 points, 10.4 rebounds and 2.4 blocks through his first 10 games of the new campaign. His 71.6 field goal percentage leads the league. Kessler and Doncic have quickly built chemistry with one another. Luka often does a tremendous job of getting the big men he plays with involved. Kessler deserves credit, however, as he’s given the Lakers quality production at the center position. Barring unforeseen circumstances, Kessler is expected to play on Sunday. Doncic, however, is questionable. Updates on his injury status will be provided ahead of tip-off. The Lakers and Pistons have both started the season strong. LA is 8-2 and in first place in the Western Conference. The Lakers are tied with the Philadelphia 76ers for the best record in the league. The Pistons’ 6-2 record is good for third place in the Eastern Conference. Detroit will be looking to get back on track after losing to Philadelphia by a final score of 112-106 on Wednesday. In-N-Out’s billionaire owner vows iconic chain ‘will always be’ in California and says leaving the state would be the ‘dumbest business decision ever’
articles.summary: "This is where we started. It's where we are now, and it's where we will always be," Lynsi Snyder, president and owner of In-N-Out, said.
articles._body: Lynsi Snyder, president and owner of In-N-Out, moved her family to Tennessee recently but reaffirmed that the iconic burger chain will never abandon California. In an interview with actor Terry Crews that In-N-Out posted online , she was asked how the company will retain its California DNA as it expands to more states around the country. “This is where we started. It’s where we are now, and it’s where we will always be,” Snyder replied. Her grandparents opened the first In-N-Out in Southern California in 1948, and the company has gradually expanded to other parts of the state—and to other parts of the country. While far from being the biggest chain, it retains a cult following that has helped its expansion as people who moved out of California make pilgrimages when restaurants open in new states. But Snyder, who grew up in Northern California, revealed last year that she and her family were moving to Tennessee , saying that raising kids was difficult in the state and that “doing business is not easy” there either. That sparked fears In-N-Out might leave California, prompting the burger heiress—who is worth an estimated $7.3 billion —to clarify that her departure from the state doesn’t mean the company will too . In a video posted to her Instagram page last year, Snyder told followers: “We’re not leaving California, or leaving our roots behind. Each one of our locations is here to stay.” Still, there has been a corporate exodus from California to states like Texas, where Elon Musk has relocated the headquarters for Tesla and SpaceX. In-N-Out has also clashed with state authorities, such as when it refused to comply with officials and request that customers must show proof of vaccination to make purchases during the pandemic. And the company reluctantly raised prices after California imposed higher minimum wages for fast-food workers in 2024. But during her latest interview, Snyder addressed the fears about In-N-Out, which maintains headquarters in California and Tennessee. “There were rumors about ‘they’re gonna close all their California stores.’ I’m like what where did this even come from? That’s unimaginable. I can’t even imagine that — dumbest business decision ever,” she said. Snyder added that In-N-Out continues to grow in California, with “lots of stores” slotted for the other cities in the state. At the same time, the company has expanded to Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Washington and Tennessee. Snyder suggested that Mississippi, Arkansas, and Oklahoma are under consideration, with New Mexico also in the works. But she insisted the company is taking a slow and steady approach to growth that won’t compromise on the quality of its food her grandparents’ values, adding that In-N-Out won’t be able to accommodate every request to open a new location. As for her own family’s relocation to Tennessee, Snyder described it as “kind of a God thing” and said she originally wanted to move to Colorado because she loves the mountains. But her husband floated the idea of going to Tennessee instead. While they already had made plans, she recalled that “something just kind of clicked.” “I felt it and then started looking at it, just praying, and I’m like ‘I think you’re right. I think that’s where we’re supposed to go,'” Snyder said. This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles._body: The No. 14 LSU Tigers went into halftime down 10-3 to the No. 5 Alabama Crimson Tide on Saturday. It’s been a hard-fought contest through the first two quarters, as the only touchdown in the first half came in the second quarter for the Crimson Tide. Despite the slow start, head coach Lane Kiffin is still confident his team can pull out of Week 10 with a victory. During his halftime interview right before going into the locker room with his team, Kiffin claimed that the offense has to start putting up points on the scoreboard to challenge Alabama if the Tigers hope to win this game. The 54-year-old admitted that quarterback Sam Leavitt has to play smarter in the second half after turning the ball over right before halftime. “We got to do a better job against blitz zero down [in the red zone],” Kiffin said. “And obviously, Sam [Leavitt] made a poor decision there. We were in field goal range. Our defense settled down a little bit, but we got to finish drives a lot better on offense. We’re moving it, but we’re stalling.” Lane Kiffin on LSU throwing an interception while in field goal range before the half: "Obviously, Sam [Leavitt] made a poor decision there." pic.twitter.com/DpYzDIUnvR — ESPN College Football (@ESPNCFB) November 7, 2026 While it wasn’t a touchdown, the Tigers at least scored more points early in the third quarter upon returning from halftime, and are now down 10-6. LSU is in the middle of a dogfight as the program is doing everything possible to keep its College Football Playoff hopes alive. Additionally, a win would catapult the team above Alabama in the SEC rankings, further increasing the odds of reaching the postseason. Lane Kiffin brought the stars out for this Week 10 matchup against the Crimson Tide. Kiffin was spotted walking down Victory Hill with Shaquille O’Neal, Paul Skenes, Angel Reese, and even Kevin Costner by his side. articles._body: Coach Lane Kiffin’s LSU Tigers took on Kalen DeBoer’s Alabama Crimson Tide in Baton Rouge during Week 10, as Kiffin’s team opened a 13-10 lead behind QB Sam Leavitt . Pittsburgh Pirates pitcher Paul Skenes and his girlfriend Livvy Dunne also joined the game as Alabama staked a 10-3 halftime lead that set the stage for a second half LSU comeback. Kiffin helped to reunite LSU dignitaries Angel Reese and Shaquille O’Neal, as the basketball legends were seen posing for a photo together during the game. LSU royalty (via @LSUwbkb , @sportsiren ) pic.twitter.com/I9YsaLjm09 — espnW (@espnW) November 7, 2026 O’Neal called Reese the greatest athlete to ever come out of the Tigers’ athletic department . Reese is now with the WNBA’s Atlanta Dream, the league’s runner-up to the Golden State Valkyries this season. At halftime, Kiffin spoke to a reporter and said his team needs to do a better job of handling the blitz and taking care of the football. “Obviously, Sam (Leavitt) made a poor decision there,” he said of his QB, who threw an interception in field goal range. “Our defense settled down a little bit, but we’ve gotta finish drives a lot better on offense. We’re moving it, but we’re stalling.” Alabama seized a 17-13 lead over the home team as he found tight end Josh Ford for a seven-yard scoring pass that led to a Conor Talty extra point. Kiffin and the Tigers had their moments midway through the game, but Alabama looked like they weren’t going anywhere as fans cheered with vigor at Tiger Stadium in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The festive atmosphere was tempered by the score as Leavitt and his offense looked to strike back at the heart of DeBoer’s team. articles._body: The San Francisco 49ers will face off against the Las Vegas Raiders in a home game in Week 9. It’s another opportunity for the club to extend its lead in the NFC West standings. However, a day before kickoff, the organization announced it’s switching things up with the roster. The 49ers made multiple roster moves ahead of Sunday’s matchup against the Raiders, according to Nick Wagoner of ESPN. Some changes were made with players on the IR, including wide receiver Christian Kirk, while one individual was elevated from the practice squad. “ 49ers Saturday moves,” Wagoner posted on X. “Activated from IR: WR Demarcus Robinson. Placed on IR: WR Christian Kirk. NOT activated from IR: DB Nate Hobbs. Elevated from PS: WR KhaDarel Hodge.” This is Kirk’s second trip to the IR. The 29-year-old wideout is dealing with a meniscus injury in his right knee. He’ll have to miss at least the next four weeks. There is a chance he’ll need surgery on his right knee, but that is yet to be determined. Injuries have been a key issue for the 49ers this season. Especially in the wide receiver room, as rookie De’Zhaun Stribling is currently on the IR, while Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel have dealt with injuries throughout the campaign but have so far avoided trips to the IR. Either way, the team is still firmly in first place in the NFC West. Depending on how Week 9 plays out, the 49ers’ lead could improve, increasing their chances of clinching the division for the playoffs. articles.summary: Utah football escaped rival BYU 28-20 Saturday, further boosting its College Football Playoff hopes. Quarterback Devon Dampier and his elusiveness sparks a big reason why the Utes are 9-0 and envisioning the postseason. Dampier, though, dropped an interesting take on the secret behind why he̵
articles._body: Utah football escaped rival BYU 28-20 Saturday , further boosting its College Football Playoff hopes. Quarterback Devon Dampier and his elusiveness sparks a big reason why the Utes are 9-0 and envisioning the postseason. Dampier, though, dropped an interesting take on the secret behind why he’s so slippery on the football field. “All the tall people try to tackle me like I’m tall,” said the 5-foot-11 quarterback . Dampier looks nothing like the prototypical passers NFL and even college football powers look for. He looks way shorter than Utah’s last top overall pick in legendary quarterback Alex Smith. But Dampier proves week after week why he’s emerged as one of the hardest QBs to game plan against. Utah even turned to him as a receiver too momentarily. Devon Dampier, are you serious?! What a catch from the QB pic.twitter.com/rXEEZFR9qw — SportsCenter (@SportsCenter) November 7, 2026 Dampier finished 14-of-26 passing for 177 yards and tossed two touchdowns. He handed the Holy War rival Cougars fits with his legs too, carrying the ball 20 times for 89 yards and crossing the end zone twice there on runs. Dampier slipped by a would-be sack too in epic fashion. Not a lot of QBs in the country can make both of these plays. Devon Dampier is a magician with his ability to create but he can also make some spicy throws. Watching him at Utah is so fun. (Also a sick pancake from Wayshawn Parker.) pic.twitter.com/fokblIkPDr — Bobby Football (@Rob__Paul) November 7, 2026 He hit some notable NCAA history too , per Sam LeSueur of Yahoo Sports. “Devon Dampier became the first player in NCAA history to record 150+ passing yards, 25+ receiving yards, two passing touchdowns, and two rushing touchdowns in a single game,” LeSueur posted on the social media website X, formerly Twitter. Dampier has Utah thinking about a potential fourth undefeated season in program history, and the Utes’ first since beating a Nick Saban-led Alabama team in the 2008 Sugar Bowl. And that Utah team hit a program record 13 victories. Utah remains the last undefeated left in the Big 12, while also potentially eliminating BYU from both the conference title and CFP race. articles.title: Patriots makes receiver roster move amid AJ Brown’s injury absence
articles.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel’s New England Patriots are 5-3 on the season heading into Week 9’s home game against the Green Bay Packers, and QB Drake Maye is running out of weapons. Maye has a tough task on his hands against Jordan Love and the Packers with star wideout AJ Brown’s injury c
articles._body: Coach Mike Vrabel’s New England Patriots are 5-3 on the season heading into Week 9’s home game against the Green Bay Packers, and QB Drake Maye is running out of weapons . Maye has a tough task on his hands against Jordan Love and the Packers with star wideout AJ Brown’s injury concerns continuing . The Pats made a move to replenish their receiver room with a familiar face, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN, who shared the news that Mack Hollins was added to the team’s 53-man roster from the practice squad. Hollins has played in four games with the Pats this season, and has caught 15 passes for 209 yards with a long of 26. At 6-foot-4, the 33-year-old North Carolina Tar Heels alumnus provides a similarly big target to Brown that Maye can push the ball downfield when the situation warrants it. Hollins’ best receiving yards season came in 2025, when he recorded 550 yards with Vrabel and Maye’s team en route to a Super Bowl appearance. The Patriots will be without potential star running back TreVeyon Henderson against Green Bay, as Henderson got a message from his head coach . Rhamondre Stevenson will start at running back, giving Maye a versatile target out of the backfield who has caught 20 passes for over 200 yards and a touchdown this season.
