articles.title: Thunder’s Ajay Mitchell reveals aggressive approach after scoring a career-high
articles.summary: For the second time this season, Oklahoma City Thunder’s Ajay Mitchell set a new career high with 35 points in a 128-97 win over the Memphis Grizzlies. While Mitchell has often been the second-leading scorer since the Thunder lost three starters due to long-term injures, All-Star Shai Gilge
articles._body: For the second time this season, Oklahoma City Thunder’s Ajay Mitchell set a new career high with 35 points in a 128-97 win over the Memphis Grizzlies. While Mitchell has often been the second-leading scorer since the Thunder lost three starters due to long-term injures, All-Star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with 28 points on 11-for-22 shooting. Mitchell addressed his approach during his postgame media availability. “I was just trying to be aggressive out there; see what the defense would give us, and just try to play the game,” Mitchell said. “Every night is going to be different. So, I just go into every game with the same mindset, going out there and playing, and not worrying about anything else.” Thunder’s Ajay Mitchell went 14-for-20 from the floor, including 4-of-7 from deep, and finished with five assists, and one rebound. Oklahoma City is 4-2 since losing Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, and All-Star Chet Holmgren to their respective injuries. Williams and Wallace will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, and Holmgren is expected to miss 8-to-10 weeks with a right knee injury. For Mitchell, staying focus to every detail is vital for the shot-handed Thunder’s success this season. “Staying confident no matter what’s going on,” Mitchell said. “I know the amount of work I put in. So, when I go out there and it’s not falling, I’m not worried. I’m really focused on just helping this team win. Every possession matters. So, for me, it’s trying to move on really quick to the next one. No matter if shots are going or not. That’s really been my mindset these past two years. I try to keep it like that.” Mitchell is averaging 26.0 points on 56.6/38.5/76.5 shooting splits, 4.3 rebounds, and 3.3 assists across his last three games. Thunder head coach Mark Daigneault commended his team for stringing together wins without most of its core players. “I thought we got our feet underneath us,” Daigneault said. “And gained some confidence. It was obviously a tough week. We have kind of a new collection of guys. We have to learn each other. I have to learn that, and that took a little bit of calibration, but the guys are doing a great job.” The Thunder will host the Washington Wizards on the second night of a back-to-back on Saturday. articles._body: Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Doncic is being listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Detroit Pistons, per NBA insider Marc Stein. Doncic — who scored 53 points in LA’s 124-118 win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday night — is dealing with low back tightness. The 27-year-old is currently in his second full season with the Lakers. He’s been a superstar for a long time, but Doncic looks like the MVP frontrunner at the moment. Luka is turning in video game numbers right now. In fact, it would be difficult to even reach the numbers he’s recording in a video game. Luka Doncic is currently averaging 40.1 points per game to go along with 7.8 rebounds and 7.7 assists per contest. One may argue that his numbers are not especially shocking since he is leading the league in both field goal attempts and three-point attempts per game, but Doncic has remained efficient despite his high volume of shot attempts. Doncic is shooting 49.8 percent from the field and 41.9 percent from beyond the arc. The Lakers star has only played in nine games, so it’s far too early to begin seriously discussing the MVP subject. Still, his start to the season has been phenomenal, and the Lakers have reaped the benefits. Their 8-2 overall record is good for first place in the Western Conference. Tip-off for the Lakers-Pistons game in Detroit is scheduled for 6 PM ET on Saturday night. Updates on Luka Doncic’s injury status will continue to be monitored and provided as they are made available. Hello Show HN,

I'm a college student, and I enjoy playing word games like Codenames, but it can be hard sometimes to find enough people to play when everyone is available, so I made an app that allows you to fill any seat with an AI teammate and also play against AI. This way it allows for peop
articles._body: Hello Show HN, I'm a college student, and I enjoy playing word games like Codenames, but it can be hard sometimes to find enough people to play when everyone is available, so I made an app that allows you to fill any seat with an AI teammate and also play against AI. This way it allows for people to get the full strategic experience of codenames just on their own. Through this experiment, I was also able to measure and benchmark a few different LLMs through AWS Bedrock API calls and give them ELO ratings based on stuff like win rate and clue/guess accuracy. If anyone is interested, they can see more about my benchmarking methodology here: https://wordspies.com/hn#method . I think it's pretty interesting because it gives you a lot of insight into these various LLMs' NLP capabilities. A few interesting stats were that I rated Gemini 4 Argon at 1775, GPT-6.1 Sol at 1744, GPT-6 Astra at 1723, Claude Fable 5.1 at 1623, and Claude Opus 5.5 at 1592. There are quite a few interesting things you'll find from there, like how, although newer and more expensive models tend to perform better, there are some rare exceptions, like Kimi K2.5 slightly edging out Kimi K3. Check the site out if you're interested in NLP and data science and would like to see what level of frontier LLMs you can successfully beat! articles._body: No. 7 Texas continued its march to the College Football Playoff on Saturday with a 34-20 road victory over No. 18 Missouri . The Longhorns racked up their fourth Top 25 ranked victory of the season, putting them in strong position to make the CFP field even if they suffer a loss over their final three games (No. 14 LSU , Arkansas , and Texas A&M ). As for the Tigers, they have now lost two of their last four games since their dominant 45-17 win over No. 8 Florida on Oct. 3. Missouri fans were audibly upset during Saturday’s game due to some questionable refereeing decisions, including an Arch Manning fumble that traveled forward 12 yards and was picked up for a Texas first down. The referees also missed what appeared to be an apparent intentional grounding call on Manning. $39.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage Postgame, however, Missouri head coach Eli Drinkwitz refused to bash officiating in the loss. Along with an attempt to avoid a fine, he chose not to be ‘disrespectful’ to Steve Sarkisian and the Texas Longhorns. “My job is to respond to the situations. They have officials, and they have a crew from the SEC that calls in. They reviewed it. I don’t know what to tell you,” Drinkwitz said . “If I say what I want to say, I’m going to get fined until I don’t have any retirement. I’m not going to do that. I’m not going to blame the officials. That would be disrespectful to Coach Sarkisian & his team.” Missouri loss comes one day after Austin Simmons re-signed with program In the loss, Missouri quarterback Austin Simmons completed 23/43 passes for two touchdowns. The performance comes just one day after Simmons re-signed with the program for the 2027 season. In his first year at Mizzou , Simmons has led the Tigers to a 6-3 record. He currently ranks second in the SEC in passing yards (2,204) and is tied for first with passing touchdowns (20). Simmons spent the first two seasons of his collegiate career at Ole Miss , where he played under former head coach Lane Kiffin . He entered the 2025 season as the Rebels’ starter, but was soon passed up by backup Trinidad Chambliss after suffering an injury in their second game of the season. Simmons finished out the season as Ole Miss ‘ backup, and hit the Transfer Portal in the offseason. The Miami native opted to remain in the SEC, winding up at Missouri to succeed quarterback Beau Pribula (who transferred to Virginia ) in Columbia. Simmons has more than lived up to his expectations, and had the Tigers in the thick of the College Football Playoff race heading into Saturday’s game.

An Anthony Davis-Lakers reunion?? @ScottKaplan sparked the trending story with @WindhorstESPN https://t.co/MXIsXmKDib pic.twitter.com/e4xsI0H3RK — ESPN Los Angeles (@ESPNLosAngeles) November 7, 2026 Brian Windhorst joined Scot Kaplan with ESPN Radio Los Angeles to separate fact from fiction regarding the rumors. “You know, Anthony Davis is one of the biggest question marks in the league this year. articles._body: The Atlanta Falcons are set to face off against the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday in Week 9. It’s an opportunity for the club to get back in the win column after being shut out 16-0 in Week 8 by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. However, the offense will have to play without Brian Robinson Jr., as the backup running back is dealing with an injury. Reports indicate that the 27-year-old was officially placed on the IR , according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. Robinson will have to miss at least the next four weeks as he continues dealing with a lingering hamstring issue. “Falcons placed RB Brian Robinson Jr. on injured reserve,” Schefter reported. The five-year veteran has already missed the past two games, as he last appeared in the team’s 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears. Robinson will miss the next three games for Atlanta, as the Falcons’ Week 11 bye is within the four-week minimum for his IR stint. The soonest Robinson can return is the Week 13 matchup against the Detroit Lions. It’s an unfortunate loss for the offense, as the former third-round pick has been a nice addition to the backfield, helping in short-yardage situations. In his six appearances this season, Robinson has accumulated 211 yards and four touchdowns off 53 rush attempts. This story is currently developing, and more information will be available soon. But coach Steve Sarkisian, quarterback Arch Manning and the Longhorns are alive and well. All after knocking off No. 18 Missouri 34-20 on Saturday. Texas improves its CFP and even
articles._body: Texas football absorbed a potential blow to its College Football Playoff chances with the Hollywood Smothers injury . But coach Steve Sarkisian, quarterback Arch Manning and the Longhorns are alive and well. All after knocking off No. 18 Missouri 34-20 on Saturday. Texas improves its CFP and even SEC title game hopes in the process. Sark and company now own a 7-2 overall record. But the road win at Missouri hands Texas this accolade: Four different victories against teams ranked in the top 20. The Longhorns took down previous No. 1 Ohio State with Manning leading the epic comeback from down 20. Texas later defeated No. 13 Tennessee inside Neyland Stadium. No. 7 Ole Miss fell in Austin on Halloween night, which helped pump new CFP hope for the ‘Horns . Now this road win over a foe ranked in the top 25 adds to a growing postseason resume for Texas. Plus helps keep Texas in the race to land in Atlanta come Dec. 5, when the SEC Championship Game will be held. Texas still needs to win out to clinch a potential spot in the conference title game. Plus likely still needs multiple external factors to play into the Longhorns’ favor. A la watching Kentucky and Georgia lose at least once. Texas owns the tiebreaker already over Ole Miss by virtue of its Halloween win. Even the Rebels going 10-2 won’t guarantee Ole Miss makes it to Atlanta, especially if the ‘Horns own the same record. So Texas remains alive and kicking, while Mizzou at three losses is now facing a more fringe chance of making it to the CFP. However, despite this improvement, Matt LaFleur’s team remains at the bottom of a competitive NFC North, and their ongoing offensive s
articles._body: The Green Bay Packers have bounced back from a disappointing start to the 2026 season, winning four of their last five games to improve their record to 5-3. However, despite this improvement, Matt LaFleur’s team remains at the bottom of a competitive NFC North , and their ongoing offensive struggles have become increasingly hard to overlook. They have faced difficulties in establishing a reliable running game, with injuries and inconsistent blocking forcing the coaching staff to try different combinations along the offensive line. Although the passing attack has helped to compensate, these issues may become more problematic as the team approaches the toughest part of their schedule. General manager Brian Gutekunst should look to address this situation before the NFL trade deadline on November 10. An interesting option is Las Vegas Raiders offensive lineman Jackson Powers-Johnson, who lost his starting job despite being a second-round draft pick just two years ago. Packers must trade for Raiders’ Jackson Powers-Johnson before NFL deadline Kirby Lee-Imagn Images. The Green Bay Packers’ offensive line has undergone significant changes throughout the season due to injuries, forcing several players into roles they are not accustomed to. The challenges with protection became evident early on, as the Packers struggled to protect quarterback Jordan Love during the opening games. They allowed pressure at an alarming rate, despite utilizing a strategy designed to get the ball out quickly. So, the running game has been even more disappointing, and Green Bay has had difficulty creating space at the line of scrimmage, often leaving running back Josh Jacobs with little opportunity to build momentum before encountering defenders. These issues have persisted, although the team has shown some improvement recently. To address the situation, the Packers signed experienced guards Laken Tomlinson and Kevin Zeitler during the season, hoping to stabilize a unit that has struggled with injuries and inconsistent performances. Tomlinson has become a key contributor, even shifting to right guard to accommodate Aaron Banks on the opposite side. In contrast, Zeitler has not seen any offensive snaps, despite coming in with considerable starting experience, and offensive coordinator Adam Stenavich explained that Tomlinson’s performances played a role in the decision to keep him in the lineup, leaving Zeitler without a regular offensive role. This situation highlights the challenges Green Bay faces in establishing a consistent offensive line combination. Sean Rhyan has provided valuable stability at center, but an ankle injury will prevent him from playing against New England in Week 9. Additionally, starting right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele is out for the remainder of the season due to a serious knee injury. Why Jackson Powers-Johnson could benefit from a fresh start Powers-Johnson entered the NFL with high expectations after a successful college career at Oregon. The Raiders selected him with the 44th overall pick in the 2024 NFL Draft, drawn to his versatility and physical style of blocking. He seemed capable of solidifying a long-term starting position, particularly given his ability to play multiple roles on the interior offensive line, but his development has not been as direct. Powers-Johnson began the 2026 season as the starting right guard for Las Vegas, but his performances did not secure the position. The Raiders initially replaced him with Caleb Rogers and eventually shifted to rookie Trey Zuhn III. This decision has left Powers-Johnson largely sidelined from the offense. In his last three appearances, he has played only 16 snaps, all on special teams, and this represents a significant decrease in responsibilities for a player who started the season hoping to be an established starter. Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak has praised his attitude and versatility, acknowledging that Powers-Johnson can contribute at both guard and center. Nevertheless, the coaching staff appears confident in continuing with Zuhn, whose performances have helped enhance the Raiders’ rushing attack. This situation creates a unique dilemma for Las Vegas. While Powers-Johnson remains a talented young offensive lineman, the franchise has already invested in another player for his position. Retaining him as a backup makes practical sense, but the opportunity to gain meaningful draft compensation could be appealing. For Green Bay, Powers-Johnson’s declining role doesn’t diminish his potential, so the Packers would be acquiring a player who already has starting experience at the professional level and is still several years away from the typical peak of an offensive lineman. His versatility could also prevent the organization from becoming overly reliant on a specific interior combination. Why the Raiders should consider the trade © Trevor Ruszkowski-USA TODAY Sports Las Vegas has had a challenging season, but with a 4-4 record, the franchise has legitimate reasons to stay competitive. Kubiak has helped the Raiders achieve several impressive offensive performances, including their 38-33 victory over the New York Jets in Week 8. Therefore, the organization has little incentive to trade established starters just to accumulate extra draft picks. Powers-Johnson, however, presents a different situation, and the Raiders have moved forward with a different offensive line combination, and the former second-round pick has been given limited opportunities to contribute. General Manager John Spytek must decide whether keeping him as a reserve is more valuable than trading him for a draft pick that could help strengthen the roster in other areas. articles.title: UFC’s Dana White Offered White House Press Secretary Job By Trump
articles.summary: Amber Searls-Imagn Images
articles._body: U.S. President Donald Trump announced Saturday on social media that Dana White, the CEO of the UFC, has been offered the White House press secretary position. Trump, in a post on Truth Social , urged White to accept the job and said he asked White to have several UFC fighters as assistants. “I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States,” Trump wrote. “I have requested that he bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country. … We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job!” White posted a photo to Instagram of himself in the White House press briefing room and wrote: “On to the next chapter.” CNN reported later Saturday that White had declined the offer . TMZ reported that White would meet with Trump in person on Monday about the position. White said he plans to meet Monday with Trump but declined to provide details about their conversations on the topic. “I’m flying to Washington, D.C., right now,” White said at a news conference Saturday in London for a boxing event. “… Yeah, I’ve got a lot of jobs already. … I’m going to meet with him. We have a meeting on Monday. So I’m sure I’ll have more to talk about after that.” The UFC and the White House did not immediately respond to requests by Front Office Sports for further comment. White is a longtime Trump associate. He introduced Trump at the 2024 Republican National Convention and spoke at the 2016 and 2020 Republican conventions. In June, a UFC event, called UFC Freedom 250 , was held on the South Lawn of the White House. Katie Zacharia, a conservative commentator who’d worked at the Trump Media & Technology Group, left as the White House press secretary last month after only five days in the role. She’d succeeded Karoline Leavitt, who left in August after the birth of her second child. The offer to White comes in the aftermath of the Republicans’ heavy losses in this week’s midterm elections . Trump announced Friday that Stephen Miller would replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff. articles.summary: South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers was assisted off the field in a game against Texas A&M after he was hit hard and fumbled late in the first half. He appeared to get landed on awkwardly following the hit. Sellers was hit by one defender and coughed up the ball. Moments later he was con
articles._body: South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers was assisted off the field in a game against Texas A&M after he was hit hard and fumbled late in the first half. He appeared to get landed on awkwardly following the hit. Sellers was hit by one defender and coughed up the ball. Moments later he was contacted by another. As he went down, his left ankle appeared to get trapped underneath one of the defenders and twisted. [ $39.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] He immediately was assisted off the field by athletic trainers, unable to put much weight on the ankle. He quickly headed into the team’s medical tent, and he left the game and did not return in the first half. He went to the locker room early for X-rays. The results of those X-rays were revealed by the broadcast crew just before the second half began. “After that sack fumble in the first half when he was rolled up on, that left ankle, I just got word from Shane Beamer a moment ago, LaNorris Sellers is going to try to give it a go,” sideline reporter Stormy Buonantony said. “The X-rays on that ankle were negative. But I’ll tell you watching him in warmups a moment ago he was visibly uncomfortable trying to step into that throw. The warmup throws did not look good. He numerous times pushed over, had his, kind of stomped out his feet, looked very uncomfortable, guys.” Initially, Sellers exited the game and headed to the locker room. Things didn’t look particularly good, and there was concern that he might be out for the game when the injury first unfolded live. “Yeah, moments ago he just walked out of the medical tent here without his cleat on,” Buonantony said in the first half. “The athletic trainer handed him his cleat back and it looks like they are walking over to the locker room as we speak, guys. Terrible news for LaNorris Sellers.” Sellers did not return in the first half. At halftime, Buonantony asked head coach Shane Beamer about the status of his star quarterback and whether he might be able to return in the second half. “We’re concerned. He’s got an ankle right now,” Beamer said. “They’re taking an X-ray on it, I don’t know the results of that right now.” Sellers has been instrumental in the team’s success, which has included recent wins over ranked Florida and Tennessee squads. At 5-3 on the season, the Gamecocks checked in at No. 21 in the first College Football Playoff rankings this week, still clinging onto hopes of a postseason berth. Of course, should LaNorris Sellers prove to be out for any extended period, that might become much more difficult. He’s been the team’s regular starter on offense for multiple years now. Going into Saturday’s contest against Texas A&M, Sellers had thrown for 1,849 yards and 16 touchdowns, against seven interceptions. He had also run for a team-leading 603 yards and six scores. Beamer spoke to what the team might have to do if he can’t return, with South Carolina leading 7-6 at the break. “We’ve got a lot of confidence in Cutter Woods , he’s our backup,” Beamer said. “Total confidence in him. The bigger issue right now is we’re getting our butts kicked on the line of scrimmage. We’re not running the ball and they’re running the ball down our throats right now.” In his career, which dates back to the start of the 2023 season, LaNorris Sellers has amassed 6,906 passing yards, 49 touchdowns and 22 interceptions. He has also run for 1,598 yards and 19 touchdowns.

Utah football accomplishes feat not seen since 2008 with win over BYU
articles.summary: Utah football watched its most winning head coach depart in December of 2025 following a 23-year run in Salt Lake City, and almost 11 months later, the community is celebrating one of the greatest moments in program history. The Utes survived the Holy War on Saturday, earning a hard-fought 28-20
articles._body: Utah football watched its most winning head coach depart in December of 2025 following a 23-year run in Salt Lake City, and almost 11 months later, the community is celebrating one of the greatest moments in program history. The Utes survived the Holy War on Saturday, earning a hard-fought 28-20 victory over visiting BYU, and are now 9-0 for the first time since 2008 . Utah boasts the longest active winning streak at 15 games and entered the day as the No. 3-ranked team in the College Football Playoff Rankings. Since both Miami and Georgia face arduous tests in the form of Notre Dame and Ole Miss, respectively, there is a chance the Utes claim the No. 1 spot for the first time ever. This was supposed to be a transitional phase. Instead, HC Morgan Scalley is on the cusp of leading the university to unexplored heights. Given the Utah’s crucial roster balance — rank in the top-15 in points scored and points allowed — along with the parity that is sweeping the sport, reaching the mountaintop is possibly more attainable than ever before. The Utes took a huge step forward inside Rice-Eccles Stadium. They posted four interceptions on Bear Bachmeier, with Nate Ritchie recording the final one in the end zone with just two seconds left in the game. Despite posting zero sacks, the defense made the BYU quarterback uncomfortable at crucial times. Utah QB Devon Dampier committed a fumble late in the first half, which was heroically bailed out by a James Chenault Jr. pick two plays later, but he managed to avoid the interception problems that plagued him against Houston and Colorado. The 22-year-old completed 14-of-26 passes for 177 yards and two touchdowns, both of which went to Braden Pegan, while also rushing 20 times for 89 yards and another two scores. It was not always pretty, as the Utes blew an early 14-0 lead, but they regained their composure and converted opportunities late. Barring disaster, Utah will clinch or receive its first CFP bid at the end of the season. From uncertainty to perfection. What a year! articles._body: New Balance's Numeric line is back with another banger, a "Breakfast Tea" version of Franky Villani's 417 skate model. Villani's pro signature shoe lands in this tan "Breakfast Tea" scheme, which has also appeared on Andrew Reynolds' New Balance Numeric 993 dad-shoe crossover. articles.title: Browns’ Shedeur Sanders hype video drops ahead of first start of season
articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns are scheduled to take on the New Orleans Saints in Week 9 with the goal of advancing to a 6-3 record amid the club’s surprisingly hot start. With Deshaun Watson dealing with a concussion, head coach Todd Monken is turning to Shedeur Sanders to lead the offense on Sunday
articles._body: The Cleveland Browns are scheduled to take on the New Orleans Saints in Week 9 with the goal of advancing to a 6-3 record amid the club’s surprisingly hot start. With Deshaun Watson dealing with a concussion, head coach Todd Monken is turning to Shedeur Sanders to lead the offense on Sunday. Sanders, who started seven games in his rookie year, is set to get his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. On Saturday, a hype video featuring the 24-year-old quarterback was shared on social media and is sure to get Browns fans excited. A new hype video from Shedeur Sanders ahead of his first start of the season against the Saints pic.twitter.com/vuxrfiGjQ7 — ESPN Cleveland (@ESPNCleveland) November 7, 2026 Before the start of the season, Sanders was the fan favorite pick to win the starting job. However, Watson won the role outright in training camp and the preseason, impressing Monken along the way. Since then, the Browns find themselves in the middle of the playoff race in the AFC North, with the eight-year veteran totaling 1,806 passing yards and seven touchdowns while completing 65.5% of his pass attempts. While Shedeur Sanders is set to start, Deshaun Watson is not ruled out for Sunday’s game. Well, not yet, at least. The three-time Pro Bowler cleared concussion protocol and is deemed questionable for the Browns’ matchup against the Saints. He still has a chance to at least serve as the backup behind Sanders. This will be Sanders’ 11th NFL game, and his eighth career start. The former fifth-round pick has appeared in two games for the Browns this year, but hasn’t had many opportunities to throw the ball (three passes with three completions for two yards). In his career so far, Sanders has recorded 1,402 passing yards for seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions with a 57.2% completion percentage. articles.title: Converse’s Fluffy "UGG" Has the Sole of a Running Shoe
articles.summary: Converse's T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa shoe is a smooth slip-on hybrid with fur touches, UGG flavor, & chunky running-style soles.
articles._body: You can almost always count on Converse Japan for a quirky remix of the brand's most classic models, like the Chuck Taylor. Today, the Japanese imprint is dishing out a UGG-coded slip-on moccasin. Really, the Converse T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa is like a slipper, running shoe, and UGG shoe in one. It features the classic suede-like moccasin-style upper, complete with a fluffy fur collar and hairy lining. Underfoot, a chunky foam sole with a hollowed-out center looks like it came straight from a modern-day running shoe. And it's hands-free, so you can slip on the fluffy T-Bone moc and go. It's like Nike's EasyOn models but make it All-Star this time around. Converse Japan has made the chunkiest ballerina sneakers , Chuck Taylor sneaker-heels , and luxe square-toe sneakers . And the brand has done it again with the T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa. It's another weird, albeit interesting, hybrid model with high-quality touches. It's also still very much connected to the brand's DNA, this time leaning into Converse's running side. The T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa shoes are slated to drop on November 20 on Converse Japan's website for ¥10,890, roughly $68. It'll land in black and chestnut colorways. There's also a non-boa version up for grabs, for those looking for a simple, quirky moc runner. articles.title: Dodgers’ perfect trade offer for Brewers’ Trevor Megill
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers should pursue Trevor Megill by offering Emmet Sheehan in a straight swap that addresses different pitching priorities. Los Angeles would acquire an established late-inning reliever, while the Milwaukee Brewers would receive a major league starter capable of contributing to
articles._body: The Los Angeles Dodgers should pursue Trevor Megill by offering Emmet Sheehan in a straight swap that addresses different pitching priorities. Los Angeles would acquire an established late-inning reliever, while the Milwaukee Brewers would receive a major league starter capable of contributing to their championship defense. The price would be substantial. Sheehan offers three remaining seasons of team control, compared with Megill’s one. That difference makes this a serious proposal rather than an attempt to acquire Milwaukee’s closer with expendable depth. ESPN’s Jeff Passan reported that the Brewers would at least listen to offers for Megill this offseason. That willingness creates an opening for discussions, but it does not establish an asking price or a decision to trade him. The following package is an editorial proposal, not a reported offer. Its appeal rests on exchanging immediate bullpen strength for a longer period of starting-pitching help. Hypothetical trade Dodgers receive Trevor Megill Brewers receive Emmet Sheehan Why Trevor Megill fits the Dodgers’ bullpen Megill finished 2026 with a 2.63 ERA, 0.89 WHIP and 30 saves. He struck out 69 batters and walked 15 across 61 2/3 regular-season innings, providing the kind of production that makes pursuing him worthwhile. The Dodgers would be acquiring a pitcher who can protect a late lead without requiring a lengthy free-agent commitment. Megill remains arbitration-eligible for 2027 before reaching free agency, giving Los Angeles a defined period to evaluate the investment. His role need not depend on receiving every save opportunity. With Edwin Diaz and Tanner Scott already in the bullpen, the Dodgers could use Megill against dangerous hitters before the ninth or turn to him when another reliever needs rest. That flexibility becomes more valuable with Evan Phillips, Alex Vesia, Blake Treinen and Brusdar Graterol in free agency. Their uncertain returns leave Los Angeles with important innings to redistribute . However, acquiring Megill would not resolve every bullpen need. He turns 33 in December, and one effective season cannot eliminate the uncertainty that accompanies relief pitching. The Dodgers should evaluate his health and workload alongside his recent performance. The strongest argument is dependable recent production in a role the club needs to strengthen. The weakest would be assuming his closing experience guarantees postseason success. Why Emmet Sheehan could interest the Brewers Sheehan would give the Brewers an immediate rotation candidate instead of requiring them to wait years for the trade’s return to reach Milwaukee. The right-hander posted a 4.57 ERA with 132 strikeouts and 33 walks across 112 1/3 innings in 2026. Those results support interest in his strikeout ability and control, although his run prevention needs improvement. At 26, Sheehan remains under team control through 2029. Milwaukee would acquire three seasons to develop and use him, providing a longer runway than keeping Megill through his final arbitration year. That matters with Brandon Woodruff and Dustin May in free agency . Sheehan could compete for available starts without the Brewers committing to a multiyear contract on the open market. His arrival would not guarantee that those departures are covered. Milwaukee must assess his durability, pitch execution and ability to work deeper into games before assigning him a permanent place in the rotation. The Brewers should also resist treating starting experience as automatic superiority over relief production. Megill already provides valuable outs. Sheehan would need to contribute enough innings, at an acceptable level, to justify surrendering that certainty. Both clubs must replace what they surrender Abner Uribe gives Milwaukee a credible closing candidate after recording a 1.97 ERA in 2026. Aaron Ashby remains another important option following a season with 116 strikeouts across 89 1/3 innings. Moving Uribe into the ninth would nevertheless create assignments elsewhere. The Brewers would need additional relievers to absorb those responsibilities rather than assume their existing bullpen depth makes Megill unnecessary. For the Dodgers, the opposite concern is rotation depth. Trading Sheehan would remove usable innings, and a lengthy list of starters does not guarantee enough healthy pitchers throughout the season. The Dodgers should compare this proposal with signing a free-agent reliever while retaining Sheehan . Spending money could preserve valuable starting depth; completing the trade would prioritize Megill’s immediate contribution over that flexibility. Both pitchers face arbitration, so the financial comparison requires their eventual salaries rather than treating estimates as commitments. Neither club should present this primarily as a salary-clearing transaction. Keeping Megill remains sensible if the Brewers doubt Sheehan’s immediate fit or development potential. This is the offer the Dodgers should make because it gives Milwaukee a meaningful reason to negotiate without requiring another premium prospect. Los Angeles would strengthen its late innings, while the Brewers would add controllable starting help. Both teams could improve, provided they can replace the pitching value they surrender. articles.title: Nike’s Ruggedized Recovery Sneaker Is Ready for Cold Days
articles.summary: Nike's Rejuven8 Run 4x4 sneaker is a winterized recovery shoe featuring thick muddied-up soles & cozy suede uppers.
articles._body: Nike's winter shoe collection just got better. Now, the brand's introducing a neat hiking-style Rejuven8 Run sneaker for the cold days ahead. Unlike the previous breezy recovery shoe , the Rejuven8 Run 4x4 shoe, originally named the Rejuven8 WNTR , wears more winter-appropriate attire. This version comes with cozy, shaggy suede uppers. It also keeps the inner removable bootie, which can be worn on its own, thanks to a thin outsole support. Another cool thing about the Rejuven8 Run 4x4 sneaker is its soles. It comes with gritty, black, chunky soles that make it look like the sneakers stepped in some mud. They did not (I think). It just goes to show that Nike's newest recovery sneakers aren't afraid to get dirty, if need be. It's also extremely cushioned, with Nike Air coming to the rescue in the soles. Nike's winterized recovery shoe has a similar vibe to New Balance's new TL900 "hiking shoe ." It has trail-worthy charm as well as street-savviness. Nike's effort makes post-winter workouts look good, though. The Rejuven8 Run 4x4 is scheduled to drop on November 18 on Nike's website for $145. articles.summary: “I now have to rest, in order to make a complete recovery,” the singer wrote.
articles._body: Deep Purple ’s Ian Gillan is recovering after a medical emergency forced the legendary rock band to postpone its European tour. On Saturday (Nov. 7), the 81-year-old singer shared a health update with fans, revealing that he had undergone a successful procedure and would need time to rest before making a full recovery. Related Deep Purple’s Ian Gillan Provides Update on Medical Emergency That Postponed Euro Tour: ‘I Was Hoping That I Would Get the All Clear’ Deep Purple’s Ian Gillan Hospitalized Following Medical Emergency, Two Shows Postponed Glenn Hughes Says He’s On the Mend After Another 10-Hour Open-Heart Surgery: ‘All Is Well’ “I had a procedure yesterday which was successful,” Gillan wrote on Facebook . “I now have to rest, in order to make a complete recovery and ensure that I’m as fit as can be before getting back to work, thanks everybody for your patience and understanding. I really do appreciate it and apologise for all the inconvenience.” Last weekend, Deep Purple revealed that Gillan had been hospitalized with an unspecified health issue, prompting the postponement of two concerts in Germany. Days later, the band confirmed that the remainder of its scheduled U.K. and European tour would also be postponed due to the singer’s illness. The cancellations began with the band’s Oct. 31 show at QI Arena in Leipzig and its Nov. 1 date at Sporthalle in Hamburg. Gillan later shared more details about the health scare on Instagram. “Thank you for all the good wishes and support over the last few days, it means the world. I had a medical problem whilst in Leipzig which required urgent attention at the hospital,” the singer wrote . “I was hoping that I would get the all clear to hang on until the end of the tour, but there are very serious risks involved in me doing so,” he continued. “As a result, and on the advice of my medical team and management we have made the decision to postpone the rest of the European/UK tour until further notice. I’m very sorry about any inconvenience this may cause, but it’s in the best interest all round.” Deep Purple has been on the road for its SPLAT! world tour since late summer, with the postponed U.K. and European dates originally set to run through late November. At press time, the band’s Latin American leg was still scheduled to launch Dec. 5 in São Paulo, Brazil, with a final stop in Mexico City on Dec. 19. Gillan has fronted Deep Purple during multiple stints since first joining the band in 1969. He is the voice behind some of the group’s biggest hits, including its signature 1973 song “Smoke on the Water,” which peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

articles.title: Saints make surprising Kendre Miller decision despite RB concerns
articles.summary: The New Orleans Saints have released running back Kendre Miller ahead of their Week 9 matchup against the Cleveland Browns, leaving the organization with limited options in the backfield amid several injuries. Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reported the surprising roster decision Saturday
articles._body: The New Orleans Saints have released running back Kendre Miller ahead of their Week 9 matchup against the Cleveland Browns , leaving the organization with limited options in the backfield amid several injuries. Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reported the surprising roster decision Saturday on X, formerly known as Twitter. “The Saints released Kendre Miller, per source,” Underhill reported. The move comes as New Orleans (2-5) prepares to host Cleveland (5-3) on Sunday , with the Saints already dealing with significant injuries at running back. Veteran Travis Etienne Jr. remains on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, while CJ Donaldson has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest due to a shoulder injury and concussion. Those absences, combined with Miller’s release, leave Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime as the Saints’ only two available running backs entering the matchup. Miller, 24, appeared in six games this season, recording 159 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 57 carries, averaging just 2.8 yards per attempt. He also contributed nine receptions for 37 yards. The former third-round pick out of TCU struggled to establish consistency throughout the season despite receiving increased opportunities. Saints face uncertainty at running back ahead of Browns matchup Stephen Lew-Imagn Images In New Orleans’ Week 6 victory over the New York Giants, Miller recorded a season-high 70 rushing yards on 20 carries. However, he followed that performance with just six rushing yards on eight attempts during the Saints’ 16-10 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers in Paris . Across four seasons with New Orleans, Miller appeared in 27 games, totaling 656 rushing yards and five touchdowns on 184 carries. He also recorded 29 receptions for 217 yards. Miller’s departure raises additional questions about the Saints’ offensive depth as head coach Kellen Moore looks to get the organization back on track following its Week 8 bye. With Etienne sidelined and Donaldson unavailable, Kamara and Estime could see increased responsibilities against Cleveland. The decision also ends Miller’s tenure with the organization after New Orleans selected him with the No. 71 overall pick in the 2023 NFL Draft. The Saints will attempt to rebound from their Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh when they host the Browns on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. articles.title: Eagles Week 9 injury report vs. Giants: Saquon Barkley still battling through hamstring issue
articles.summary: Saquon Barkley is preparing to face his former team, but the Philadelphia Eagles running back is not entering Week 9 with a clean bill of health. Barkley continues to manage hamstring and back injuries after missing Wednesday’s practice and participating on a limited basis Thursday and Friday. Th
articles._body: Saquon Barkley is preparing to face his former team, but the Philadelphia Eagles running back is not entering Week 9 with a clean bill of health. Barkley continues to manage hamstring and back injuries after missing Wednesday’s practice and participating on a limited basis Thursday and Friday. The encouraging development for Philadelphia is his game status. Barkley received no injury designation and is available for Sunday’s matchup against the New York Giants. His restricted practice schedule reflects ongoing injury management rather than an official questionable or doubtful designation. That distinction matters for an Eagles offense missing several receiving options. Philadelphia has ruled out six players, including DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks and Britain Covey, while quarterback Tanner McKee remains questionable. Barkley’s availability offers some stability amid another challenging week of personnel adjustments. Saquon Barkley cleared to play despite lingering injuries Steve Roberts-Imagn Images Barkley’s practice progression followed a familiar pattern: time off early in the week, followed by limited work as the Eagles prepared for another divisional matchup. He has continued playing through the hamstring and back issues, including last Sunday’s loss at Washington, when he scored a rushing touchdown. His production against the Commanders illustrated both his value and the limitations surrounding Philadelphia’s ground game. Barkley finished with 13 carries for 30 yards and a touchdown, adding a 24-yard reception. Those numbers followed a seven-carry, 62-yard performance against Dallas in Week 7. Through six appearances this season, Barkley has accumulated 274 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 56 attempts. His 4.9-yard average shows he can still produce efficiently overall, but his recent workloads have been considerably smaller than the volume associated with his most productive Philadelphia stretch. For perspective, Barkley rushed for 2,005 yards during his first Eagles season in 2024 and followed that with 1,140 yards in 2025. This year’s interrupted availability has made establishing that same rhythm more difficult. The Giants matchup adds a familiar opponent, but the central issue is workload rather than sentiment. Clearance to play does not establish how many touches Barkley will receive or whether Philadelphia will distribute more opportunities elsewhere. The final injury report confirms availability, not an unrestricted role. Eagles rule out six as other injured starters progress Smith’s hamstring injury and Wicks’ ankle issue leave Philadelphia without two important receivers. Covey is also out with a knee injury. All three missed every practice this week, limiting the offense’s receiving depth before Sunday’s game. Friday's Injury Report #NYGvsPHI pic.twitter.com/XMbBMJMCSP — Philadelphia Eagles (@Eagles) November 6, 2026 The remaining confirmed absences are linebacker Jihaad Campbell, who has hamstring and quadriceps injuries, defensive back Michael Carter II, who is dealing with an abdomen injury, and cornerback Jonathan Jones, who has a hamstring issue. Each recorded three consecutive missed practices. McKee’s rib injury remains another situation to monitor. He practiced fully Wednesday before being limited Thursday and Friday and carries the Eagles’ lone questionable designation. Philadelphia has already announced that Joe Milton will start against New York. Elsewhere, kicker Jake Elliott and outside linebacker Jonathan Greenard advanced from limited participation to full practices Friday. Jalyx Hunt remained limited throughout the week with knee and ankle injuries but received no game designation. Zack Baun, Markel Bell, Jordan Davis, Landon Dickerson, Dallas Goedert, Kenny Moore II and Moro Ojomo practiced fully throughout the supplied report. Jordan Mailata’s listed sessions were also full, although his Friday entry is missing. None carries a listed game designation, providing encouragement around an otherwise depleted roster. articles.title: Jason Sudeikis ‘guarantees’ Notre Dame football will upset Miami on Saturday
articles.summary: Jason Sudeikis brought a personal connection to ESPN College GameDay on Saturday, joining the broadcast as its celebrity guest picker ahead of Notre Dame’s home matchup against Miami. The actor and comedian appeared at Library Lawn in South Bend. Known for playing Ted Lasso and his time on “Satur
articles._body: Jason Sudeikis brought a personal connection to ESPN College GameDay on Saturday, joining the broadcast as its celebrity guest picker ahead of Notre Dame’s home matchup against Miami. The actor and comedian appeared at Library Lawn in South Bend. Known for playing Ted Lasso and his time on “Saturday Night Live,” Sudeikis drew on his family’s Notre Dame ties when making his selection. College GameDay shared the moment Saturday on X, formerly Twitter, capturing his prediction for the matchup. “Well, I have on good authority that little baby Jesus is being babysat tonight by my uncle George and by Coach Lou Holtz, and all three of them are guaranteeing a victory for the Irish, and so am I.” Jason Sudeikis and the four horsemen are riding for Notre Dame pic.twitter.com/9Qg6eNl63b — College GameDay (@CollegeGameDay) November 7, 2026 The broadcast’s hosts dubbed the group “the four horsemen.” Sudeikis’s connection to the university spans generations. His maternal grandfather graduated from Notre Dame, as did his Uncle Jim, a member of the class of 1975. His late uncle George Wendt, who played Norm on “Cheers,” attended before dropping out after his junior year. Wendt died in May 2025. Sudeikis also attended a Notre Dame basketball camp in sixth grade and witnessed the Irish’s October 15, 1988, game against Miami from the stands. That matchup later became the subject of an ESPN “30 for 30” documentary. He found support for Saturday’s pick across the panel. Nick Saban, Pat McAfee, and Kirk Herbstreit selected Notre Dame, while Desmond Howard chose Miami. The Hurricanes and Irish hold the No. 1 and No. 11 spots, respectively, in the season’s first College Football Playoff rankings. Saturday’s game kicks off at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT on NBC and Peacock, with Notre Dame seeking an upset that would strengthen its playoff resume. articles.title: Saints’ Kelvin Banks Jr. finally makes injury return in time for Browns clash
articles.summary: The New Orleans Saints could receive a major boost to their offensive line ahead of Sunday’s Week 9 matchup against the Cleveland Browns. Rookie left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. is nearing his return after missing several games with a serious ankle injury, New Orleans plans to activate him from
articles._body: The New Orleans Saints could receive a major boost to their offensive line ahead of Sunday’s Week 9 matchup against the Cleveland Browns . Rookie left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. is nearing his return after missing several games with a serious ankle injury, New Orleans plans to activate him from injured reserve. ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reported on Saturday that New Orleans plans to activate Banks from injured reserve. The 2025 first-round pick suffered a high ankle sprain during the Saints’ Week 2 game against the Baltimore Ravens and required surgery. His recovery has progressed faster than initially expected. Banks was placed on injured reserve on September 23 but recently returned to practice . He participated in limited sessions throughout the week and was listed as questionable on the team’s final injury report. Although his planned activation is encouraging, his availability for Sunday’s game has yet to be confirmed. The Saints drafted Banks ninth overall in 2025, and he started all 17 games as a rookie. His return could strengthen an offensive line that has struggled to protect quarterback Tyler Shough and consistently open running lanes. Having their starting left tackle back would give the offense more stability. New Orleans could also use Banks with fellow offensive tackle Asim Richards dealing with a thumb injury. Richards remains questionable for Sunday’s matchup against Cleveland. His potential absence makes Banks’ return even more important for the Saints. At 2-5, New Orleans needs to build momentum to stay competitive in the NFC South. Getting Banks back would provide a timely boost as the team looks to improve its offensive production. However, the Saints must still prepare for a challenging matchup against a Browns defense capable of putting pressure on Shough. articles._body: The New York Jets will be without three additional players for their Week 9 road matchup against the Kansas City Chiefs after downgrading Joseph Ossai, Nahshon Wright and VJ Payne to out on Saturday. As New York (2-6) looks to snap a three-game losing streak against Kansas City (5-2), the organization made the changes to its latest injury report just one day before Sunday’s contest. The Jets now face another difficult challenge against a Chiefs team that has won five of its first seven games. Kansas City will look to capitalize on its home-field advantage while New York attempts to avoid falling further behind in the AFC standings. With three more players officially ruled out, the Jets will need other members of their roster to step into larger roles against Kansas City. New York will face the Chiefs on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS, hoping to end its losing streak and secure its third victory of the season. articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys made several roster moves Saturday ahead of their Week 9 road matchup against the Indianapolis Colts, including placing rookie first-round linebacker Malachi Lawrence on injured reserve and activating outside linebacker Marist Liufau. As Dallas (3-5) prepares to face the strugg
articles._body: The Dallas Cowboys made several roster moves Saturday ahead of their Week 9 road matchup against the Indianapolis Colts , including placing rookie first-round linebacker Malachi Lawrence on injured reserve and activating outside linebacker Marist Liufau. As Dallas (3-5) prepares to face the struggling Colts (2-6) on Sunday, the organization also elevated wide receiver Jordan Hudson and tight end James Mitchell from the practice squad while ruling out defensive tackle Jonathan Bullard. NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reported the moves Saturday on X, formerly known as Twitter. “The #Cowboys placed rookie first-round LB Malachi Lawrence on IR and activated OLB Marist Liufau from IR. The team elevated WR Jordan Hudson and TE James Mitchell from the practice squad. “DT Jonathan Bullard will remain on IR and has been ruled out for tomorrow.” Lawrence’s placement on injured reserve represents another setback for a Dallas defense looking to improve its consistency. The rookie will miss at least four games, leaving the Cowboys without one of their young defensive contributors during an important stretch of the season. Cowboys bolster roster depth ahead of crucial Week 9 clash vs. Colts However, Liufau’s return provides Dallas with additional depth at linebacker. His activation comes at an important time as the Cowboys attempt to address their defensive struggles and get back into the NFC playoff race. Meanwhile, Hudson and Mitchell will provide additional offensive depth for quarterback Dak Prescott and the Cowboys. Their elevations give Dallas more options at wide receiver and tight end heading into Sunday’s matchup. Bullard’s continued absence also leaves the Cowboys without another defensive lineman as they prepare to face Indianapolis. Dallas enters Week 9 looking to rebound from a disappointing 33-30 overtime loss to the Arizona Cardinals in Week 8 . The defeat dropped the Cowboys to 3-5, increasing the pressure to turn their season around. The Cowboys will face the Colts on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on Fox, hoping their latest roster adjustments help them secure a much-needed victory. articles.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers face several availability concerns ahead of their Saturday meeting with the New York Knicks. Starting center Jarrett Allen headlines the list of absentees after being ruled out for a second straight game with a right knee contusion, as the NBA listed seven players as unava
articles._body: The Cleveland Cavaliers face several availability concerns ahead of their Saturday meeting with the New York Knicks . Starting center Jarrett Allen headlines the list of absentees after being ruled out for a second straight game with a right knee contusion, as the NBA listed seven players as unavailable . The NBA’s official injury report lists Allen, Sam Merrill, Jaylon Tyson, and Nae’Qwan Tomlin as out due to injuries. Khalifa Diop, Tristan Enaruna, and Ernest Udeh Jr. are also unavailable because of their G League assignments or two-way status. For New York, Josh Hart has been ruled out with an ankle injury . Allen injured his right knee during Wednesday’s loss to the Oklahoma City Thunder and was also unavailable for Cleveland’s NBA Cup victory over the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday. Merrill, who took his place in the starting lineup, will also miss Saturday’s game because of a right elbow injury. Tyson and Tomlin remain out with a right ankle sprain and lower back stress reaction, respectively. Without Allen, head coach Kenny Atkinson may continue using Evan Mobley as his starting center. Mobley delivered 22 points and six rebounds against Philadelphia, while Thomas Bryant provided a boost off the bench with 13 points and six rebounds. Merrill’s absence also leaves Atkinson with another decision on the wing. He could retain the Mobley-Watson frontcourt combination but would need to find a replacement for Merrill in the starting lineup. Cleveland averages 119.2 points per game, fourth in the NBA. However, the Cavaliers will need contributions from their available players to maintain that production against a Knicks team led by Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns. articles.title: Florida’s new property tax cuts could defund the police, fire fighters and EMS in small towns, threatening ‘rural dark ages,’ former GOP lawmaker says
articles.summary: "A thinner tax base means fewer services. The dark ages won’t arrive all at once. They’ll arrive one closed fire station at a time."
articles._body: The blue tsunami that swept across the country on election day petered out in Florida, where voters continued to elected Republicans to statewide offices and approved a massive cut to their property tax bills. Amendment 3 expands the so-called homestead exemption, shielding more of a home’s assessed value from taxation. It will nearly triple from $51,400 currently to $150,000 in 2027 and increase again to $250,000 in 2028. It also lowers the cap on annual assessments on rental and commercial properties from a 10% hike to 5%. The amendment doesn’t apply to school-related property taxes but creates a path for abolishing non-school property taxes completely. State economists have projected that local governments will lose nearly $5 billion in the first year and nearly $12 billion a year once the exemption is fully phased in. But while Amendment 3 requires remaining tax revenue go toward public safety and other local services, it doesn’t mandate that police, fire and emergency medical services be funded first or that they receive a minimum level of funding. Proponents argued that lowering property tax bills would provide relief as higher inflation worsens the cost of living. But sheriffs, police chiefs, fire chiefs and local government officials came out against the plan as they face a steep hit to their budgets. To be sure, local governments can raise revenue in other ways, such sales taxes and fees. But they can crash in bad economic times and are unlikely to completely offset losses from Amendment 3. “In the end, though, essential services would still almost certainly be affected,” University of Tampa economists Abigail Hall and Aaron Wood wrote in the Conversation . “Funding for police, fire and emergency medical services is primarily the responsibility of local governments, and, for most counties, they make up the largest line item in their annual expenditures. Reducing property taxes would amount to a direct hit, especially in smaller, less-populated counties.” Leading up to election day, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri estimated the county’s general fund could lose about $180 million in the first year after the measure passes, adding that the sheriff’s office accounts for half of the county’s spending, which mostly covers personnel costs. That means the county could have fewer deputies available to respond to calls, with community policing programs, marine patrols and K-9 units also facing cuts, he warned. In addition, the county’s emergency medical services fund could suffer a $20 million reduction. “I think there’s no doubt — zero — that there has to be position cuts,” Gualtieri told WLRN last month. Outgoing Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, who backed Amendment 3, has dismissed such warnings as “fearmongering” and suggested state grants could offset any budget shortfalls to local agencies. Florida Realtors, another backer, insisted the measure could be implemented without compromising the essential services. Still, some details are lacking, and a special session of the legislature could be called to spell out exactly how the amendment will work. Jeff Brandes, a former Republican state senator and president of the Florida Policy Project, wrote in an op-ed for Florida Politics on Friday that grants can’t fill recurring revenue shortfalls. And unlike big cities like Miami, which can hike hotel taxes and lean on other tourism-related sources, small inland towns have fewer options to generate tax revenue. He pointed to research from the Florida League of Cities, which found that at least 90% of homestead values will no longer be taxable in 108 of Florida’s 411 cities. And in 33 counties, at least seven in 10 homesteads fall below the $250,000 exemption limit. “The amendment itself sends no reimbursement to fiscally constrained counties, the poorest and most rural places with the least room to absorb a loss, and nothing in the amendment guarantees that police and fire will be protected,” Brandes said. “That is how rural Florida slides into rural dark ages: slower emergency response, crumbling roads, shorter library hours, shuttered recreation programs. Fewer services discourage investment. Less investment thins the tax base. A thinner tax base means fewer services. The dark ages won’t arrive all at once. They’ll arrive one closed fire station at a time.” Because fire departments could see drastic cuts, Florida homeowners may end up paying higher insurance bills, offsetting savings from property taxes. Insurance Services Office, a private insurance-data company, evaluates local fire protection and assigns ratings that insurers can use in underwriting. “A reduction in fire protection services in a community can lead to a lower ISO rating,” a spokesman for the Insurance Information Institute told Bloomberg . “The ISO rating is among numerous risk factors property insurers use to underwrite homes in Florida and could potentially cause premiums to increase if the rating is downgraded.” Amendment 3’s effects could extend to the state’s broader economy as well. In a pre-election analysis from the Tax Foundation , the think tank described the measure as not just a tax cut, but a fundamental restructuring of local government finance. Since Florida doesn’t a state income tax, property taxes are a reliable source of revenue, even in economic downturns, and they reduce need for higher taxes on labor, entrepreneurship, capital formation, and consumer spending, it said. “The elimination of a substantial portion of the property tax base does not eliminate the cost of local government services,” the Tax Foundation pointed out. “Amendment 3 would create highly distortive tax shifts, change who pays, and change how those costs are distributed. The result would be economically harmful both to Florida communities and the state overall.” This story was originally fea

articles.title: Converse’s Fluffy "UGG" Moc Has the Sole of a Running Shoe
articles.summary: Converse's T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa shoe is a suave slip-on hybrid with fur touches, UGG flavor, & chunky running-style soles.
articles._body: You can almost always count on Converse Japan for a quirky remix of the brand's most classic models, like the Chuck Taylor. Today, the Japanese imprint is dishing out a UGG-coded slip-on moccasin. Really, the Converse T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa is like a slipper, running shoe, and UGG shoe in one. It features the classic suede-like moccasin-style upper, complete with a fluffy fur collar and hairy lining. Underfoot, a chunky foam sole with a hollowed-out center looks like it came straight from a modern-day running shoe. And it's hands-free, so you can slip on the fluffy T-Bone moc and go. It's like Nike's EasyOn models but make it All-Star this time around. Converse Japan has made the chunkiest ballerina sneakers , Chuck Taylor sneaker-heels , and luxe square-toe sneakers . And the brand has done it again with the T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa. It's another weird, albeit interesting, hybrid model with high-quality touches. It's also still very much connected to the brand's DNA, this time leaning into Converse's running side. The T-Bone Slide Moccasin Boa shoes are slated to drop on November 20 on Converse Japan's website for ¥10,890, roughly $68. It'll land in black and chestnut colorways. There's also a non-boa version up for grabs, for those looking for a simple, quirky moc runner. articles.title: Cowboys Week 9 injury report vs. Colts: George Pickens’ nagging hamstring issue clouds trade rumors
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys enter their Week 9 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts with George Pickens’ availability unresolved and speculation about his future still circulating. The receiver remained limited throughout the practice week because of a hamstring injury and carries a questionable designa
articles._body: The Dallas Cowboys enter their Week 9 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts with George Pickens’ availability unresolved and speculation about his future still circulating. The receiver remained limited throughout the practice week because of a hamstring injury and carries a questionable designation for Sunday’s game. Head coach Brian Schottenheimer expressed optimism Friday, saying he was “hopeful” Pickens would play . However, three consecutive limited practices leave Dallas preparing for uncertainty at a position already missing KaVontae Turpin, who has been ruled out with a rib injury. Pickens headlines a lengthy injury report that also includes questionable designations for Jake Ferguson, Joey Porter Jr. and DeMarvion Overshown. With multiple offensive options managing injuries, Dallas faces decisions that could shape both its personnel packages and passing-game approach. George Pickens’ hamstring complicates the trade conversation Jerome Miron-Imagn Images Pickens’ injury provides important context for the discussion surrounding his role. He previously appeared on the injury report with both shoulder and hamstring issues, but only the hamstring remains listed entering the Colts matchup. His practice workload nevertheless stayed restricted Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. That distinction matters because reduced involvement can invite conclusions about a player’s standing. Offensive coordinator Klayton Adams said Thursday that Pickens’ limited workload was injury-related rather than a reflection of his performance, offering a football explanation amid the trade speculation. The rumors have developed ahead of the November 10 trade deadline, with Pickens playing the season on the franchise tag. Schottenheimer’s earlier criticism of his run blocking and subsequent questions about his usage have added attention to an already closely watched situation. Still, speculation should not be confused with an impending transaction. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reported that he had been told the Cowboys were not trading Pickens, adding that “as of right now, there’s nothing there.” Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb also pushed back against the trade conversation Thursday. Their support reinforces the distinction between outside debate about Dallas’ roster strategy and the immediate task of getting Pickens healthy enough to contribute against Indianapolis. For Sunday, the practical question is whether Pickens can provide his usual receiving threat. Being active would not automatically establish that he can handle an unrestricted workload. Cowboys injury report includes two absences and seven questionable players Dallas has ruled out Turpin and outside linebacker Malachi Lawrence, who missed all three practices with an ankle injury. Pickens joins Jonathan Bullard, Ferguson, Marist Liufau, Overshown, Porter and Luke Schoonmaker among seven players listed as questionable. #Cowboys final injury report vs. Colts is below. i expect a move made to make room for the likely return of Marist Liufau from IR (Malachi Lawrence to IR?). correction: PJ Locke and Caleb Downs have officially cleared concussion protocol. Dee Winters is… pic.twitter.com/q5zGmRhacW — Patrik [No C] Walker (@VoiceOfTheStar) November 6, 2026 Ferguson missed Wednesday and Thursday before returning for limited work Friday because of an ankle injury. Schoonmaker remained limited throughout the week with a groin issue, leaving uncertainty at both tight end spots. Porter moved from full participation Wednesday to limited work Thursday and Friday with an ankle injury. Bullard, managing a calf issue, and Liufau, dealing with a forearm injury, practiced fully all week despite their questionable designations. Overshown was limited in the two sessions recorded on the supplied report with hamstring and back injuries. His Friday participation entry is absent, so it should not be treated as a confirmed missed practice. Elsewhere, Caleb Downs and P.J. Locke progressed from no participation to full Friday sessions. Tyler Smith and Dee Winters also finished fully, while Kenny Clark and Drew Shelton practiced fully throughout. Broderick Jones and Von Miller returned to full participation after personal and rest absences, respectively. Their Friday entries are missing. Those players carry unspecified game statuses in the supplied report, not confirmed absences. articles.title: Yankees’ Aaron Judge-Jazz Chisholm Jr. ‘stern’ talk report draws honest opinions from ex-players
articles.summary: The New York Yankees’ offseason has brought renewed attention to their clubhouse, with former major leaguers Erik Kratz and AJ Pierzynski weighing in on the responsibilities that come with leading a team. Their discussion centered on captain Aaron Judge, second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. and the Y
articles._body: The New York Yankees’ offseason has brought renewed attention to their clubhouse, with former major leaguers Erik Kratz and AJ Pierzynski weighing in on the responsibilities that come with leading a team. Their discussion centered on captain Aaron Judge, second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. and the Yankees’ clubhouse standards , including how managers and veteran players share responsibility for accountability. Foul Territory shared the exchange Saturday on X, formerly Twitter, with Kratz explaining when a team leader should intervene. “While I think somebody does need to have a stern talking to Jazz, other players need a stern talking to. I think everybody kind of gets out of line, and I think Judge is that guy.” Aaron Judge having to "sternly" tell Jazz Chisholm Jr. to stop certain behaviors is being blown out of proportion. pic.twitter.com/iZZ6Rwpd0w — Foul Territory (@FoulTerritoryTV) November 7, 2026 The comments followed a report that Judge had sternly told Chisholm to stop certain behaviors. That account prompted the discussion, but the former players’ responses did not establish a clubhouse rift. Pierzynski drew on his experience when assessing the situation: “If he sternly talked to him and Jazz accepted it, I don’t understand what the big deal is about this. This happens a lot. You’d be surprised how many times managers would come to certain people and say, ‘Hey, I need you to talk to so and so because they’re not doing something right because it can’t be me all the time.’” Chisholm’s season included taking the field with a lollipop vs. the Detroit Tigers and an ejection after arguing a checked-swing call and slamming his helmet. On the field, he finished 2026 batting .231 with 19 home runs, 55 RBIs, 41 stolen bases and a .711 OPS across 137 games. The Yankees did not extend Chisholm a $23.15 million qualifying offer before Monday’s deadline. He now enters free agency, leaving his future with New York unsettled as the organization begins its offseason. articles.title: Browns Week 9 injury report vs. Saints: Shedeur Sanders set to start with Deshaun Watson out
articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns are turning to Shedeur Sanders for their Week 9 matchup against the New Orleans Saints, giving the second-year quarterback his first start of the 2026 season. Head coach Todd Monken announced the decision Friday after Deshaun Watson missed team repetitions throughout the prac
articles._body: The Cleveland Browns are turning to Shedeur Sanders for their Week 9 matchup against the New Orleans Saints, giving the second-year quarterback his first start of the 2026 season. Head coach Todd Monken announced the decision Friday after Deshaun Watson missed team repetitions throughout the practice week while dealing with a concussion. Watson has cleared concussion protocol Saturday and will travel to New Orleans, but Sanders remains the starter. Elsewhere, defensive tackle Maliek Collins is the only player listed as out on the supplied injury report. Several other Browns finished the week with improved participation, offering some encouragement around a team preparing for a change under center. Shedeur Sanders gets his opportunity against New Orleans Barry Reeger-Imagn Images Sanders’ promotion follows a week in which Watson could not participate in the full offensive preparation. Watson missed Wednesday and Thursday before returning for limited work Friday. Monken said the veteran could handle individual drills but was unable to take team reps, leaving Sanders to prepare for the starting assignment. Watson’s concussion followed a helmet-to-helmet hit during Cleveland’s Week 8 loss to Pittsburgh. He initially passed evaluations and returned to the game, but subsequently reported symptoms that developed Monday night. His clearance Saturday changes his medical availability, not Cleveland’s announced starting plan. For Sanders, Sunday represents an opportunity to show progress after spending the first eight weeks as Watson’s backup. He briefly replaced Watson against Pittsburgh, completing both attempts for two yards, but the Saints matchup will provide a substantially larger test of his command of the offense. The assignment is not unfamiliar territory. Sanders made seven starts during his rookie season, finishing with a 3-4 record as a starter. That experience gives him a foundation, although this will be his first start of the current campaign. Cleveland’s offensive challenge is straightforward: build sustained possessions without asking Sanders to rescue every series. Protection, manageable down-and-distance situations and reliable receiving options become especially important when a backup moves into the starting role. Browns injury report: Maliek Collins out, others improve Collins will miss the Saints game with an elbow injury after recording no practice participation throughout the week. His absence removes an established contributor from the interior defensive line and forces Cleveland to redistribute those snaps. Final injury report for Saints-Browns. pic.twitter.com/otFQyUs6bc — Jeff Nowak (@Jeff_Nowak) November 6, 2026 The offensive line received better news. Tackle Austin Barber progressed from not practicing Wednesday to limited work Thursday and full participation Friday. Center/guard Elgton Jenkins moved from limited participation to consecutive full sessions. Neither carries a game designation on the supplied report. Wide receiver Denzel Boston also finished with a full Friday practice after two limited sessions because of a calf injury. His availability provides Sanders with a receiver who has recorded 26 catches for 409 yards and three touchdowns through eight games. Defensively, cornerback Myles Harden and defensive end Jared Verse finished with consecutive full practices. Linebacker Carson Schwesinger advanced to full participation Friday despite wrist and ankle injuries. Quincy Williams remained limited Thursday and Friday with a hamstring issue but received no game designation. Tight end Harold Fannin Jr. and safety Emmanuel McNeil-Warren were limited Wednesday and Thursday with groin and hip injuries, respectively. Their Friday participation entries are absent from the supplied report, and neither has a listed game designation. Those blanks should not be interpreted as confirmed missed practices. articles._body: It has been an eventful Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship for Rory McIlroy through the first three days of the tournament. McIlroy began the tournament with a controversy, as he was penalized two strokes on Thursday after attempting to improve his lie on hole 12. McIlroy later claimed the situation was an accident . On Friday, McIlroy bounced back and shot a 63 while recording 11 birdies . He shot a 67 on Saturday and is now just two strokes back of Jon Rahm’s lead, per GOLF.com. Jon Rahm is 18 holes away from a victory in Abu Dhabi. A Round 3 (66) puts him at 18-under and one clear of Tyrrell Hatton and Francesco Laporta, with Rory McIlroy two back. Sunday's going to be fun. pic.twitter.com/nKRxFM4qm7 — GOLF.com (@GOLF_com) November 7, 2026 Rahm is -18 heading into Sunday. Meanwhile, Francesco Laporta and Tyrrell Hatton are both -17. McIlroy is at -16 under, which is quite impressive after his two-stroke penalty on Thursday led to him finishing the round with a 70. He’s gotten back on track over the past two days and is now in a position to make a run on the final day. Rory McIlroy has already had a tremendous year. He won the Masters for the second consecutive season on the PGA Tour. He’d love to add another win this weekend while playing on the DP World Tour. McIlroy revealed his “goal” for Sunday as he attempts to surpass Rahm and win the tournament, via DP World Tour. “If I can just limit the mistakes, there’s enough good golf,” McIlroy said. “There’s enough birdies. There’s enough opportunities… If I can play a clean round of golf tomorrow, I won’t be too far away. “… I’m going to have to go out and shoot a low one, something in the mid to low 60s to get it done tomorrow, and that will be the goal.” It should be an exciting final day of the Abu Dhabi Aldar Championship. articles._body: It's basically a fancy wrapper around your quiz data so that as a host you can show showmanship and present like a TV show host. Built exclusively for the use case of live quiz/trivia hosting with friends and family, in person or over zoom. Few features I always lacked and few problems with other alternatives that this web app solves: 1. Keeping costs low or free since most apps require a subscription, and much like geoguessr, I don't want to pay a monthly fee for something I may use very occasionally. Since I don't store any data and it remains in local browser storage, no need for accounts/auth and cloud storage (of-course there were trade-offs) 2. Doing buzzer rounds or audio/video clues that previously required using different apps. 3. Friction of making accounts or downloading apps. This works completely in browser using laptop and phones. 4. As a quiz master or host, I don't like being tied to my laptop when hosting, so I made a quiz master remote where I can control the entire quiz using my phone and move around freely.
