Titans’ ideal 2027 NFL Draft targets after league-altering Jeffery Simmons trade with Bears
articles.summary: The Tennessee Titans made one of the biggest moves ahead of the 2026 NFL trade deadline, sending star defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons to the Chicago Bears for two first-round picks. That means now, with two picks in Round 1 of the 2027 NFL Draft, the Titans have a chance to significantly improve
articles._body: The Tennessee Titans made one of the biggest moves ahead of the 2026 NFL trade deadline, sending star defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons to the Chicago Bears for two first-round picks. That means now, with two picks in Round 1 of the 2027 NFL Draft, the Titans have a chance to significantly improve the roster. So, let’s take a look at the Titans’ ideal 2027 NFL Draft targets with their own and the Bears’ selections. Titans’ draft targets with their own pick At 1-7 heading into Week 9, the Titans will have one of the top picks—if not the No. 1 selection—in the 2027 NFL Draft. With a top-three or -four slot, here are the Titans’ draft targets at the top of the board. What they shouldn’t do is draft a quarterback. Cam Ward is playing better of late, and the truth is, the 2027 QB class is now not all what it was cracked up to be. WR Jeremiah Smith, Ohio State Jeremiah Smith is the best player in this draft class, and arguably one of the best college prospects in the last half-decade or so. No matter what team gets the top overall pick, they will have a hard time passing on Smith unless they desperately need a QB. And even then, the Buckeyes’ pass-catcher may still be the smarter selection. With Carnell Tate starting to come into his own and Elic Ayommanor still just 23 years old, the Titans could help Ward immensely by taking Smith and adding him to this young stable of wideouts that will look like a basketball team with the addition of the 6-foot-4 Smith. EDGE Colin Simmons, Texas In the latest ClutchPoints’ 2027 NFL Mock Draft , the Titans get the No. 2 overall pick and take Texas edge-rusher Collin Simmons, who is one of—if not the—best defensive players in this draft. Simmons is a beast of the edge and leads the nation with 10.5 sacks and 16.0 tackles for a loss. That comes on the heels of his SEC-leading 12.0 sacks from last season. Veteran OLB Jacob Martin is having a surprisingly productive season with 6.5 sacks this year, but having a young, elite EDGE is worth its weight in gold. After losing Simmons, the Titans can start to rebuild their defense around another elite defensive lineman, albeit at OT Jordan Seaton, LSU If the Titans don’t get one of the top two picks in the 2027 NFL Draft, they can start looking at their needs and deciding between relatively equal targets. Notre Dame cornerback Leonard Moore, South Carolina EDGE Dylan Stewart, and LSU offensive tackle Jordan Seaton are all among the options, but for the Titans, Seaton would be best. With Peter Skowronski and JC Latham in place on the right side of the line, Tennessee needs to upgrade the left side. Seaton is an NFL-ready LT who will seamlessly slide into Dan Moore Jr.’s spot and stay there for the next decade. Tennessee targets with the Bears’ 2027 NFL Draft pick The Bears kick off Week 9 with a 6-2 record, and after the Jeffery Simmons trade, they should be able to not only make the NFC playoffs, but make a deep run as well. That means the Titans will have their second first-round pick toward the end of Day 1, and in that case, here are the prospects to target. OL Trevor Lauck, Iowa Whether or not the Titans take Seaton with their first pick, the offensive line still needs upgrading. That means a player like Iowa offensive lineman Trevor Lauck should be in play here. Lauck is 6-foot-5, 314 pounds, and should have guard/tackle flexibility at the next level. That makes him a valuable asset for any team, especially a franchise like the Titans, who will be better able to make a decision on Ward with better protection up front. DT Justin Scott, Miami With the pick that the Titans got from the Bears in the Jeffery Simmons trade, why not take another defensive tackle to build around? Right now, it seems as though Ole Miss’ Will Echoles and Tennessee’s Xavier Gilliam are in Tier 1 of the DT rankings. After that, there are several excellent prospects in Tier 2, and beauty is in the eye of the beholder here. Justin Scott can dominate the line with his elite speed and quickness. The 6-foot-4, 303-pound lineman needs to get stronger and could put on more weight, but he has athleticism you can’t teach. If Scott isn’t the Titans’ style, though, they can target Oregon’s A’Mauri Washington, Scott’s current teammate, Ahmad Moten Sr., or Oklahoma’s David Stone. TE Trey’Dez Green, LSU In the latest ClutchPoints’ 2027 NFL Mock Draft, LSU tight end Trey’Dez Green goes well before the second Titans’ pick. However, we are higher on this player than most, so if he is available in the 20s or even 30s, when Tennessee picks again, Green could be a great pick. The 6-foot-7 pass catcher, who also played basketball for the Tigers, is as unique a weapon to come out of college in the last decade. If the right coach or offensive coordinator gets their hands on Green, he could be special. For the Titans, adding another huge target to their arsenal could do wonders for Ward as well. The post Titans’ ideal 2027 NFL Draft targets after league-altering Jeffery Simmons trade with Bears appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles._body: The Phoenix Suns received several injury updates ahead of their Saturday matchup with the Houston Rockets . Jordan Goodwin is doubtful, while Rasheer Fleming is questionable. Mark Williams remains unavailable as he continues recovering from left shoulder surgery. According to the NBA’s official injury report, Goodwin is dealing with a right calf injury and is listed as doubtful. Fleming has a left ankle sprain and carries a questionable designation. Williams remains out following surgery on his left shoulder. Goodwin has missed Phoenix’s previous two games after suffering the calf injury during Monday’s loss to the Golden State Warriors. His absence leaves the Suns without an important defensive option in their backcourt. The guard’s versatility and ability to defend multiple positions have made him a valuable piece of the rotation. Fleming also missed the last two games after hurting his ankle during practice on Tuesday. His potential return could give Phoenix another option on the wing, although he has yet to establish a regular role in the rotation this season. Houston will also be missing key frontcourt depth. Backup centers Clint Capela and Steven Adams remain sidelined with right ankle and right soleus injuries, respectively. Their absences could affect the Rockets’ rebounding, especially against a Phoenix team that has struggled to control the glass. The Suns surrendered 15 offensive rebounds against the Orlando Magic on Thursday, despite securing a double-digit victory. Houston’s strength on the boards could make that a major concern, even without Capela and Adams. Phoenix enters the matchup at 2-5 after snapping its four-game losing streak. The Suns will look to carry that momentum forward despite their injury concerns as they aim to secure back-to-back wins. articles._body: Shedeur Sanders will get his first big opportunity of the 2026 NFL season this Sunday afternoon. Deshaun Watson has cleared concussion protocol and is remains questionable versus the New Orleans Saints, but Cleveland Browns head coach Todd Monken will start the former Colorado Buffaloes star regardless, per Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network. Sanders, one of the most polarizing young signal-callers in the game today, amassed legions of supporters during his collegiate career and maintains a healthy amount of support in Forest City. He struggled in his rookie year and was unable to wrestle the starting job away from Watson, who has completed 65.5 percent of his passes for 1,806 yards and seven touchdowns this season. Although the three-time Pro Bowler is not exactly filling up the stat sheet, he has produced a few clutch drives and done enough to put Cleveland right in the mix for a playoff berth. Sanders will be tasked with keeping the Browns (5-3) in the hunt when they battle the Saints (2-5) in the Caesars Superdome. The No. 144 overall selection in the 2025 NFL Draft posted a 56.6 completion percentage and threw 10 interceptions to just seven touchdowns in eight games played last season. He has more weapons to utilize in 2026, though, with wide receivers Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion flashing promise during their respective rookie campaigns. Ultimately, the defense will likely continue to define this squad. Whoever is operating at QB must take care of the football, make the straightforward throws and live to play another down when necessary. Shedeur Sanders does not have to be the hero. He can generate headlines just by helping Cleveland leap back into a playoff slot. articles._body: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson plans to make his NFL debut Sunday against the Cleveland Browns, though his questionable designation and a pending roster move leave his availability unsettled. Tyson completed three limited practices this week after the Saints opened his 21-day practice window. A hamstring injury has kept him out of New Orleans’ first seven games, delaying the first-round pick’s opportunity to play alongside Chris Olave and catch passes from quarterback Tyler Shough. Tyson, the No. 8 overall pick, has yet to play this season due to a hamstring, but “should be good to go” for New Orleans. pic.twitter.com/jjce1i6LnP — Jordan Schultz (@Schultz_Report) November 7, 2026 Tyson suffered a Grade 2 right hamstring strain during an August 13 joint practice with the Jacksonville Jaguars. articles.title: Nebraska HC Matt Rhule explains decision to fire offensive coordinator after Illinois loss
articles.summary: Nebraska football coach Matt Rhule fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen on Saturday following the Cornhuskers’ 24-13 loss to Illinois, ending his tenure amid the program’s mounting offensive struggles. The decision came less than 24 hours after the Cornhuskers suffered their fou
articles._body: Nebraska football coach Matt Rhule fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen on Saturday following the Cornhuskers’ 24-13 loss to Illinois , ending his tenure amid the program’s mounting offensive struggles. The decision came less than 24 hours after the Cornhuskers suffered their fourth straight loss, dropping to 5-4 after opening the season with five consecutive wins. Nebraska generated 426 yards against Illinois but struggled to convert scoring opportunities. The latest setback raised further concerns about the Cornhuskers’ offensive direction amid their slide down the Big Ten standings. The Athletic’s Mitch Sherman shared Rhule’s official statement Saturday on X, formerly Twitter, detailing the coach’s reasoning behind the decision. Nebraska has fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen. Statement from coach Matt Rhule: “Like so many of you, I am angry, I am disappointed and I am frustrated with our results this season. As the head coach, I am ultimately responsible for every aspect of our… — Mitch Sherman (@mitchsherman) November 7, 2026 Rhule accepted responsibility for every aspect of the program, including its wins and losses. He identified the offensive plan and execution as areas that were not working for Nebraska , explaining that the team needed a different direction. Holgorsen joined Nebraska during the 2024 season and subsequently received a two-year contract. The former West Virginia and Houston head coach had led the offense since his arrival. Rhule praised Holgorsen’s offensive knowledge, leadership and work with the Cornhuskers while announcing the dismissal. Glenn Thomas, Nebraska’s co-offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach, now takes responsibility for calling plays as the Cornhuskers seek to turn their yardage into more points. Rhule also acknowledged the fan base’s high expectations, saying he embraces them. He recognized supporters’ passion for Nebraska’s players and asked fans to stand behind them with important games remaining on the schedule. He plans to continue evaluating the program throughout the season and at its conclusion, leaving open the possibility of additional changes. articles.title: The anatomy of an upset: Fort Valley State beats Florida A&M in early season action
articles.summary: Early-season basketball is usually treated as an afterthought, specifically in HBCU basketball. Out-of-conference games across the board often look lopsided, and the more compelling matchups don’t come until after the turn of the new year. But a couple of early-season matchups are often wor
articles._body: Early-season basketball is usually treated as an afterthought, specifically in HBCU basketball. Out-of-conference games across the board often look lopsided, and the more compelling matchups don’t come until after the turn of the new year. But a couple of early-season matchups are often worth your attention, such as Jackson State’s compelling victory over Tulane on Thursday evening. Another game worth a spotlight was Fort Valley State University’s 75-70 victory over the Charlie Ward-led Florida A&M Rattlers . The game was particularly exciting for me as a Fort Valley State University alumnus, but I think it shows an interesting trend for both Fort Valley State as they head into SIAC competition and things that Florida A&M needs to clean up. A slow start, then a run It did not look like an upset for most of the first half. The Wildcats shot 11-of-35 from the field and 3-of-16 from three, and they went into halftime down 34-28 at the Al Lawson Center. FAMU, in turn, shot 44 percent and had led by as many as seven. Then Fort Valley came out of the break on a 19-5 run. In the first six minutes of the second half the Wildcats went from down six to up eight, 47-39. Ronald Durham got it started with a layup off a steal, Inslee Carroll scored in the paint, and Ka’leel Stillman hit a three off a Carroll assist. Katayvon Jefferies then knocked down a three at the 15:31 mark to make it 40-39, and Fort Valley never trailed again. FAMU’s only points in that stretch were five from Jaden Kempson. Fort Valley made 16 of its 29 shots after the break (55.2 percent), including 5 of 9 from three, and hit 10 of 14 free throws. Fort Valley was the better team on Thursday night It might be odd to say that when a Division II program plays a Division I program, but Fort Valley State was clearly the better team throughout the game. They played with energy and aggressiveness FAMU wasn’t prepared for. The Wildcats forced 20 turnovers, 10 in each half, and finished with 13 steals. They scored 18 points off those turnovers to FAMU’s 14, and took 64 shots to FAMU’s 51. That is how they won, even though FAMU shot better at 47.1% to 42.2%. FAMU also won the rebounding battle 39-36, so Fort Valley created its edge through extra possessions. They also showed tremendous depth. Fort Valley’s bench scored 34 points to FAMU’s 15, and 23 of those came in the second half, when FAMU’s bench scored six. Jefferies, Stillman and Cordarius White accounted for all 34. Jefferies finished with 15 points on 5-of-12 shooting from three. Only one of the threes came in the first half, so 12 of his 15 points came after it. Two of them came 39 seconds apart and pushed a 53-48 lead to 59-48. Stillman added 11 points, and White scored eight on 4-of-5 shooting. No need to panic at Florida A&M, but some improvements are needed Florida A&M struggled in key areas, including turnovers and free-throw shooting. FAMU gave it away 20 times, and Fort Valley turned those turnovers into 18 points. They also shot 15-of-30 (50 percent) from the line and only 7-of-16 in the second half. Their depth was also a concern in this game. Daisean Williford scored 22 and Kempson scored 21, so those two accounted for 43 of FAMU’s 70 points. The rest of the team scored 27 and shot 10-of-26. FAMU’s bench gave it 15 points, less than half of Fort Valley’s 34. But the Rattlers were not down and out and could have made a comeback to secure the victory. Fort Valley led by 14, 66-52, with 3:06 to go, and the Rattlers outscored the Wildcats 18-9 the rest of the way. Williford hit threes at 2:14, 0:20 and 0:05, and Kempson hit one at 2:51, cutting it to 73-70 with five seconds left. Carroll then made two free throws to seal it. Amari Floyd’s dunk off a Carroll assist at 0:31 had given the Wildcats room when FAMU cut it to seven. It was a strong finish, but a late rally can only do so much after falling that far behind. While, in the grand scheme of things, the win will amount to a morale booster and a reputation builder for the Wildcats, the Rattlers now have something more to work on. There still is a lot to learn from this game. That certainly should not go under the radar this weekend. The post The anatomy of an upset: Fort Valley State beats Florida A&M in early season action appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Nebraska football news: Cornhuskers Week 10 loss to Illinois continues concerning November trend
articles.summary: The defeat marked the Nebraska Cornhuskers‘ fourth straight loss, dropping them to 5-4 after a 24-13 setback against Illinois in Week 10. The result puts more pressure on head coach Matt Rhule and raises questions about the team’s ability to finish the season strong. According to On3
articles._body: The defeat marked the Nebraska Cornhuskers ‘ fourth straight loss, dropping them to 5-4 after a 24-13 setback against Illinois in Week 10. The result puts more pressure on head coach Matt Rhule and raises questions about the team’s ability to finish the season strong . According to On3 college football insider Brett McMurphy, Nebraska has struggled in November since joining the Big Ten in 2011. Bo Pelini went 10-6 during the month, while Mike Riley posted a 4-7 record. Scott Frost finished 3-8, excluding the 2020 COVID-19 season. Matt Rhule’s 2-11 mark is the worst among the four coaches. Nebraska finished with 426 total yards but failed to turn that production into enough points. Quarterback Anthony Colandrea completed 32 of 43 passes for 284 yards and one touchdown without an interception. Jacory Barney Jr. led the team with 93 receiving yards on six catches, including a 51-yard touchdown. Jamal Rule added 69 rushing yards on 15 carries, while Mekhi Nelson scored on a 15-yard run. However, Nebraska missed both field-goal attempts and converted only one of four fourth-down chances. Illinois was more efficient on offense. Quarterback Katin Houser threw for 292 yards and three touchdowns on 22-of-36 passing. He also avoided an interception. Collin Dixon led the receivers with eight catches for 129 yards and two touchdowns. The Fighting Illini finished with 376 total yards and scored on all four of their red-zone trips. The loss added to the growing frustration among Nebraska fans. One fan questioned the program’s coaching, pointing out that the school has continued to invest in football without seeing the results it expects. Nebraska now needs to find answers quickly, with its remaining games offering a chance to end the season on a stronger note. Doncic finished the game with 53 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists, and 1 steal while shooting 51.5% from the field and knocking down 5 3-pointers in only 38 minutes. This is now his fourth straight game where he scored 40 or more points and his second 50-point game of the season, following his 52-point, 10-assist performance against the Utah Jazz on October 25. It’s a lot of fun for me. It’s more when you play like this and when you win games. Uh so it’s been like this my whole life, basketball was my dream. Playing NBA was my dream. Notre Dame great Jerome Bettis shares ‘proud’ reaction to watching son score 1st career TD
articles.summary: Jerome Bettis Sr. made a name for himself at Notre Dame, scoring 20 total touchdowns during the 1991 season and averaging 5.7 yards per carry. He also did pretty well for himself in the NFL, ranking second all-time on the Pittsburgh Steelers in rushing yards and rushing TDs. That is all in the pa
articles._body: Jerome Bettis Sr. made a name for himself at Notre Dame, scoring 20 total touchdowns during the 1991 season and averaging 5.7 yards per carry. He also did pretty well for himself in the NFL, ranking second all-time on the Pittsburgh Steelers in rushing yards and rushing TDs. That is all in the past as far as “The Bus” is concerned, however. He is completely immersed in his son’s career now. Almost 33 years after Bettis charged into the end zone for the final time as a member of the Fighting Irish, his son recorded his first collegiate touchdown , and did so for the same historic program. Jerome Bettis Jr. left his man in the dust and connected with Heisman Trophy candidate CJ Carr for a 31-yard score in last Saturday’s 35-13 win versus Navy. His old man is still beaming with joy . “It was incredible, it was a moment that I’ll never forget,” the Super Bowl 40 champion and Hall of Fame running back told ESPN’s Jess Sims on College GameDay, several hours before Notre Dame’s season-defining showdown with Miami . “People ask me, ‘what about your first touchdown?’ I don’t even remember my first touchdown. “It was so much about him and his opportunity. And to go out and see him score a touchdown with that helmet on, it was one of the proudest moments I’ve had as a dad.” "It was one of the proudest moments I've had as a dad." Notre Dame legend Jerome Bettis telling @jess_sims what it was like watching his son score his first TD with the Fighting Irish last week pic.twitter.com/dqLGGoH14g — College GameDay (@CollegeGameDay) November 7, 2026 Fatherly pride at its finest. Jerome Bettis Jr. entered that Navy game with only four receptions on the season, but he surpassed that total in one afternoon. The 19-year-old wide receiver notched six catches for 78 yards and the aforementioned TD. While it is probably true that the scoreboard provided him with more playing time, Bettis seized his chance and forced head coach Marcus Freeman to take notice. Will he get a look versus No. 1 Miami? A 6-foot-2 target could be mighty valuable in the red zone. Jerome Bettis Sr. is already on cloud nine. Imagine how he will react if his son helps his Alma mater firmly establish itself as a College Football Playoff team and legitimate championship contender. Open kickoff is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. ET inside Notre Dame Stadium. articles.title: Show HN: Jacq, a DSL that compiles model and kernel descriptions to CUDA
articles.summary:
I was working (with agents) on testing out various attention algorithm ideas I had, and I found that the existing infrastructure/libraries made it more difficult than it should be.

So I created Jacq, a DSL and compiler. A jacq file describes a model’s configuration, weights, layers, and pipelin
articles._body: I was working (with agents) on testing out various attention algorithm ideas I had, and I found that the existing infrastructure/libraries made it more difficult than it should be. So I created Jacq, a DSL and compiler. A jacq file describes a model’s configuration, weights, layers, and pipeline. Jacq turns it into a standalone CUDA inference runtime and a Python weight exporter. Kernel descriptions can also generate CUDA harnesses. The easiest way to try it is the TinyLlama example in the README. Building, validating, visualizing, and generating CUDA only require Rust. Of course, running inference does require an NVIDIA GPU, CUDA, Python dependencies, and weights. Jacq doesn't support other GPU vendors (AMD, etc) or Metal, yet (PR's welcome!) There's also an experimental vLLM patch to compile and patch your jacq file into a vLLM build, as well. Feedback very welcome! Holgorsen had been with Nebraska since 2024, starting as a consultant before taking over as offensive coo
articles._body: Nebraska has fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen , On3’s Pete Nakos reported. The decision comes after the Cornhuskers suffered their fourth straight loss on Friday night against Illinois . Holgorsen had been with Nebraska since 2024, starting as a consultant before taking over as offensive coordinator later that year. He then stayed in the role after taking over for Marcus Satterfield full-time in 2025. Previously, Holgorsen was the head coach at Houston , where he went 31-28 from 2019-23. $39.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage Nebraska head coach Matt Rhule later announced Holgorsen’s departure, which comes amid the four-game skid during which the Huskers have failed to score 20 or more points. Co-offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach Glenn Thomas will take over play-calling the rest of the season. “Like so many of you, I am angry, I am disappointed and I am frustrated with our results this season,” Rhule said in a statement . “As the head coach, I am ultimately responsible for every aspect of our program – including wins and losses – and it is my responsibility to make changes when they are warranted. Watch on Fubo (Try for Free) “While there are many areas that need improvement, our offensive plan and execution is simply not working. Earlier today, I relieved offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen of his duties. As I have recently shared, Dana has a fantastic offensive mind, he is a strong leader, and he has done great work here at Nebraska. But simply, we need a change. Co-offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach Glenn Thomas will take over play-calling duties.” Through nine games this year, Nebraska ranks fifth in the Big Ten with 425 total yards of offense per game. The Cornhuskers are also averaging 30.2 points, which sits seventh in the Big Ten, but have failed to top 20 points during every game of the losing streak. Prior to the skid, Nebraska was off to a 5-0 start and averaging 43.6 points. Since then, the Cornhuskers are 0-4 and scoring 13.5 points per game. During Friday night’s road game against Illinois, NU put up 425 yards of offense, but had just 13 points. “The Nebraska fan base has high expectations and I embrace them, and I also know of their passionate support of the young men in our program,” Rhule said. “I hope they will continue to be there for our players with very important games still ahead. Our entire program is determined to finish this season strong.” Nebraska will now get ready for its final three-game stretch of the 2026 season. The Huskers will head to Rutgers in Week 11 before the season’s final home game against Ohio State . That then sets up the rivalry matchup against Iowa to close things out.

articles._body: This scratches an itch I experience most months. articles.summary: There is little doubt that New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel likes the makeup of his team. articles._body: There is little doubt that New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel likes the makeup of his team. The defending AFC champions have hit their stride after a slow start, and they hope to run down the Buffalo Bills and regain the lead in the AFC East before the end of the season. The Patriots made a couple of big moves in the offseason by adding wide receivers A.J. Brown from the Philadelphia Eagles and Romeo Doubs from the Green Bay Packers. Brown has had to contend with multiple nagging injuries this season and he has played in just three games this season. His lack of production has been a major disappointment this season. Doubs got off to a brutal start in the season opener against the Seattle Seahawks and he has been rather ordinary since then with 14 receptions for 261 yards and 3 touchdowns. Those two should have been the team’s top receivers this season. Doesn’t that mean the Patriots are going to add receivers before the Nov. 10 trade deadline? Barmore a trade possibility for New England Perhaps not. It seems more likely the Patriots will be sellers, and the name mentioned most frequently is defensive end Christian Barmore. He has played in seven games this season, but his production in defensive coordinator Zak Kuhr’s defense has been minimal. He has 7 tackles, 3.5 sacks and 1 forced fumble. The Patriots clearly expected more from him this season. The Patriots are reportedly shopping Barmore and the team is looking for a fourth-round pick for him, according to the Boston Globe . However, Vrabel tried to diminish the idea that moving Barmore — or any other Patriots player — is a trade deadline priority. “I have not shared that information with anybody,” Vrabel said. “This time of year, I think that all these things kind of get drummed up. So, we’re focused on trying to prepare for Green Bay and make the corrections from the game. This is business as normal here, so I don’t know where a lot of these things come from. Certainly not from any conversations with me.” Patriots could trade a defensive back In addition to Barmore, the Patriots may also be shopping cornerback Carlton Davis. Davis is in his ninth year in the NFL and his second with the Patriots. He has been limited to four games this season and he is listed on this week’s injury report as questionable with a neck injury. His numbers don’t compare with previous years. He has started double-digit games every season in his career, including a career-best 17 games last year when he had 10 passes defensed. Davis has just four starts this season. He has just 1 pass defensed this year and the former second-round draft choice with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers may not be the best fit in New England’s secondary. Backup cornerback Charles Woods has contributed more at this point in the season. He has 32 tackles, 4 passes defensed and 1 tackle for loss and has been quite competent in the Patriots defense. Injuries have led to multiple Patriots needs Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images The New England Patriots did not make any major moves before last year’s trade deadline, and multiple observers believe that’s the same philosophy they will follow again this year. However, injuries have left them with needs at the offensive guard slot, edge rusher and even the cornerback position. While Vrabel is not going to talk about the specifics to the media, he is certainly having conversation with Eliot Wolf, the team’s vice president of player personnel. The Patriots have suffered key injuries at guard, and they could make a deal with the New Orleans Saints for Cesar Ruiz. The 27-year-old Ruiz is in his seventh season and is in the prime of his career. The 6-4, 317-pound Ruiz is a solid pass blocker and that could mean quite a bit for QB Drake Maye. Another area that is likely to get the Patriots’ attention is that Ruiz is durable. He has played through multiple injuries and that should earn him quite a bit of favor with Vrabel and Wolf. Pats could go after former standout If the Patriots are going to make a move at the edge rusher slot, they need to call the Washington Commanders to bring back K’Lavon Chaisson. He signed with the Commanders in the offseason after spending the 2026 season with the Patriots. Chaisson has started 7 games for Washington this season and has 3.5 sacks, 19 tackles and 2 forced fumbles. He was a key part of the Patriots’ Super Bowl run last year with 31 tackles, 7.5 sacks, 2 passes defensed, 2 forced fumbles and 1 fumble recovery. The former first-round draft choice of the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2020 from LSU is solid in all areas, and he can be a consistent contributor if the Pats make a move to bring him back. Law enforcement sources told TMZ that security personnel co
articles._body: A man was arrested on suspicion of stalking Philadelphia 76ers star LeBron James after allegedly entering his Los Angeles property Friday night and claiming to be the NBA superstar’s son , according to a report from TMZ on Saturday. Law enforcement sources told TMZ that security personnel contacted police around 9 p.m. Friday after spotting an unidentified man on surveillance cameras at James’ property. Officers from the Los Angeles Police Department responded to the scene and arrested the suspect on suspicion of stalking. TMZ reported that the man made an unusual claim while speaking with authorities. “Oddly enough … the suspect claimed to believe he is LeBron’s son during his chat with cops,” TMZ reported. Authorities confirmed that the suspect did not enter James’ residence, although police filed a stalking report following the incident. The man’s identity has not been publicly disclosed, and additional details surrounding his alleged actions remain unclear. There has been no indication that James or his family encountered the suspect during the incident. LeBron James dealing with off-court issues amid 76ers season The reported arrest comes just days after James took legal action against a sports betting application allegedly using his name and likeness without authorization. On Thursday, James sent a cease-and-desist letter to the Bron AI sports betting app over an advertisement that evoked his identity without permission. Meanwhile, James remains focused on his 24th NBA season with Philadelphia, which suffered a 119-95 NBA Cup loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers on Friday night. The defeat dropped the 76ers to 8-2 on the season following their strong start. Philadelphia will conclude its three-game road trip Sunday against the Chicago Bulls at 3:30 p.m. ET. The 76ers previously defeated Chicago 126-107 on Monday and will look to secure another victory as they continue their early-season push in the Eastern Conference. Show HN: Coldframe, a honeypot that poses as a supermarket fridge controller
articles.summary:
I built Coldframe, a honeypot that pretends to be a supermarket refrigeration controller. Inspired by the events on industrial fridge installations in the past weeks, I wanted to see what people would try against a convincing fake.

To learn more about this I built a honeypot that resembled perf
articles._body: I built Coldframe, a honeypot that pretends to be a supermarket refrigeration controller. Inspired by the events on industrial fridge installations in the past weeks, I wanted to see what people would try against a convincing fake. To learn more about this I built a honeypot that resembled perfectly the Danfoss AK-SM 800A and Dixell XWEB interfaces. Both of them are recognized on Shodan as real ones (an not as honeypots). It’s one Python file using only the standard library, and it builds on eppser/danfoss-ak-sm-decoy and public research by Synacktiv, Claroty and Ironhackers. Things that were fun to get right: - Matching real units. I used Shodan records of real devices to match header order, page titles, certificate fields and TLS versions. The Danfoss persona sends nginx headers in the same order as a real AK-SM 800A. The Dixell persona sends no Server header and pads its page to exactly 8,202 bytes. - Recognising exploit attempts. It recognises CVE-2025-41450, the Danfoss “code of the day” login bypass, and records whether the submitted code is correct for today. It also tags attempts targeting three other Danfoss CVEs and the XWEB vulnerabilities. - Letting them in. Default logins open a fake store dashboard with defrost buttons, so you see the second move, not just the first. Nothing behind it is real. Two instances have been live for a day. So far they’ve only seen generic scanners and Shodan’s crawler, which is called refrigerator.census.shodan.io. Feedback welcome, especially from anyone who has seen these devices in the field! articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway stock is a haven again as investors flee AI bloodbath while its own portfolio takes a hit amid reshuffling
articles.summary: Berkshire bought $2.4 billion of stocks during the third quarter and sold some $2.8 billion.
articles._body: Investors are seeking shelter from the AI storm in Berkshire Hathaway after shares of the conglomerate had lagged the broader market since Warren Buffett announced his departure as CEO last year. Berkshire’s class B stock is up 13.6% so far this year, beating the S&P 500’s 7.8% gain. The outperformance has come as Wall Street rotates out of once high-flying tech stocks that rode the AI boom. Since Oct. 1 alone, Berkshire stock has soared 14% while the S&P has fallen about 4%. That mirrors other years that saw major market upheaval. Most recently, Berkshire gained 4% in 2022 when the Federal Reserve launched an aggressive rate-hiking campaign that sent the broad market index down 18%. Still, Berkshire’s own closely followed portfolio hasn’t been immune to recent market swings. According to its third-quarter earnings report filed on Saturday, investment gains plunged 46% from a year earlier to $9.4 billion. Berkshire’s top stock holdings remained Alphabet , American Express , Apple , Bank of America and Coca-Cola during the quarter. While a more detailed filing later this month will reveal its precise moves, the quarterly earnings report showed that Berkshire bought $2.4 billion of stocks during the period and sold some $2.8 billion. The company grew its stake in “commercial, industrial, and other” equities by $2.3 billion on a cost basis, and cut its stake in “banks, insurance and finance” by $400 million. Meanwhile, CEO Greg Abel, who took over from Buffett at the start of this year, continued to draw down Berkshire’s massive cash pile and accelerated stock repurchases. It repurchased $9.6 billion of its stock in the third quarter, more than double the pace in the second quarter. And in the first four weeks of the fourth quarter, Berkshire bought back about $2 billion more in stock. With a broad array of firms under the Berkshire umbrella, the conglomerate remains focused on traditional businesses like railroad BNSF, Brooks running shoes, See’s candies, and Forest River RVs. Abel added to that strategy in July, when he agreed to buy home builder Taylor Morrison for $6.8 billion. That broke a long drought without any major acquisitions as Buffett bemoaned the lack of good bargains. Berkshire’s holdings in the traditional economy have paid off. In the third quarter, its railroad, energy and manufacturing businesses delivered strong profits, though insurance underwriting tumbled. That’s as the AI boom has not only supercharged the tech sector but also industries that benefit from the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent on data center construction as well as electrical grid upgrades. As a result, U.S. GDP has been running hot, expanding 3.4% in the third quarter, accelerating from 2.2% in the second quarter. But the Democratic sweep of gubernatorial races in data center hot spots like Texas, Ohio and Georgia is expected to slow down the AI buildout and the overall economy. This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Oilers news: Wayne Gretzky utters 3-word reaction to Connor McDavid chasing his records
articles.summary: Wayne Gretzky has another reason to keep an eye on the NHL record book. Edmonton Oilers superstar Connor McDavid is off to a historic start this season. His scoring pace could put several of the league legend’s long-standing records within reach, prompting Gretzky to share his thoughts on M
articles._body: Wayne Gretzky has another reason to keep an eye on the NHL record book. Edmonton Oilers superstar Connor McDavid is off to a historic start this season. His scoring pace could put several of the league legend’s long-standing records within reach, prompting Gretzky to share his thoughts on McDavid’s historic scoring pace and record chase. Gretzky shared his reaction Friday in Toronto, saying, “It’s incredible.” He praised McDavid’s impact on Edmonton and the sport. He also highlighted the captain’s determination to bring a Stanley Cup back to the city. “What he’s doing for his hockey team and for the game and for the city of Edmonton, it’s unmatched right now,” Gretzky said, as reported by Chris Johnston of The Athletic. Through Edmonton’s first 17 games, McDavid has recorded at least one point in every outing. He leads the team with 44 points and 34 assists. His current production puts him on pace for 217 points, which would surpass Gretzky’s NHL record of 215 points set in 1985-86 . McDavid has also recorded five four-point games in just 17 appearances. Mario Lemieux was the last player to reach that mark so quickly, doing so during the 1995-96 season. Gretzky also believes McDavid has a chance to challenge his famous 51-game point streak from the 1983-84 season. “If anybody can do it, it’s him, right?” Gretzky said. Maintaining that level for 51 consecutive games remains a difficult challenge. However, McDavid’s incredible start has given hockey fans another reason to watch history unfold. His ultimate goal, though, remains bringing the Stanley Cup back to Edmonton. articles.title: 49ers’ Brandon Aiyuk must jump multiple hurdles before NFL return becomes official
articles.summary: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk still faces financial and roster questions after meeting with the team Friday as he pursues a return to the NFL. Aiyuk and newly hired agent Drew Rosenhaus visited the organization’s business offices near Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California. T
articles._body: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk still faces financial and roster questions after meeting with the team Friday as he pursues a return to the NFL. Aiyuk and newly hired agent Drew Rosenhaus visited the organization’s business offices near Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California. The 28-year-old has remained on the reserve/left squad list since December 2025. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport outlined the obstacles Saturday on X, formerly Twitter, sharing a clip from “The Insiders.” “He did not. Has not officially been reinstated to try to get on the 49ers roster. That has not happened. Now there are several issues here.” From The Insiders on @nflnetwork : Brandon Aiyuk came and went on Friday, exiting the #49ers facility with no resolution. pic.twitter.com/2P7kvXq78w — Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet) November 7, 2026 The NFL sent Aiyuk and the NFLPA a letter Thursday regarding bonuses the league says he must repay to the 49ers. Rapoport described a disagreement over the amount. “The NFL believes that is 13 million. The NFLPA believes the number is a little less. We’ll see where they land if there’s a negotiation.” Aiyuk signed a four-year , $120 million extension before the 2024 season after earning second-team All-Pro honors in 2023. Arbitration could prolong the repayment dispute. He has not played since suffering a multi-ligament knee injury on October 20, 2024. Even reinstatement would not necessarily force an immediate roster move, Rapoport explained. “My understanding is the NFL is expected to give a two-week roster exemption if he gets reinstated, which means the 49ers wouldn’t have to do anything immediately anyway.” The trade deadline arrives Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET/1 p.m. PT, but general manager John Lynch has said he does not expect Aiyuk to play for San Francisco again. Neither reinstatement nor the potential exemption would settle where he resumes his career. articles._body: With the College Football Playoff expanding in the years to come , there are a lot of questions around NCAA football regarding the future of bowl games. In the past, teams with 5-7 season records have sometimes been able to participate in bowl games. According to a new report, that trend will continue under specific circumstances. “NEW: If teams (with) 5-7 records are needed to fill bowls, the bowl’s conference will choose replacement (and) choice won’t be based on highest APR scores, sources told On3 . If an ESPN-owned bowl is selecting from pool of G6 teams, ESPN chooses the team to fill the vacancy, source said,” On3 reporter Brett McMurphy posted to X, formerly Twitter. Teams traditionally have to win at least six of their 12 scheduled games in a season to reach bowl eligibility. In the past, almost all bowl teams each year are at minimum 6-6 on the campaign. There are some teams though through the years who have been able to go to bowl games with 5-7 records. Part of the reason why is because there are so many NCAA football bowl games each year . The CFP is soon expanding to a 24-team field. When that happens, it is estimated that many bowl games will simply disappear . “I would say that it’s too soon to predict the number of bowl games moving forward,” Bowl Season executive director Nick Carparelli told CBS Sports. “But I think it’s safe to say that, as a complementary part of college football’s postseason, there will still be more teams playing in bowl games than are participating in the playoff.” Time will tell if bowl games are eliminated in the years to come due to the shifting landscape of NCAA sports. articles.summary: Baltimore Ravens star quarterback Lamar Jackson could still return before the end of the 2026 NFL season despite undergoing thumb surgery, but his chances of playing again may depend on whether newly acquired quarterback Jacoby Brissett can keep the team in playoff contention. NFL Network’s
articles._body: Baltimore Ravens star quarterback Lamar Jackson could still return before the end of the 2026 NFL season despite undergoing thumb surgery, but his chances of playing again may depend on whether newly acquired quarterback Jacoby Brissett can keep the team in playoff contention. NFL Network’s Tom Pelissero reported Saturday via X, formerly known as Twitter, that Jackson’s potential return remains a possibility following Baltimore’s 33-10 Week 9 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars on Thursday Night Football. “Two-time NFL MVP Lamar Jackson’s chances for playing again this season depend on his recovery — and whether Jacoby Brissett can keep the Ravens alive long enough to make a potential late-season return worthwhile.” Jackson’s latest setback came shortly after he returned from a Grade 1 high ankle sprain sustained during Baltimore’s Week 4 victory over the Tennessee Titans . The 29-year-old suffered a thumb injury during the Ravens’ 36-10 Week 8 loss , requiring surgery and prompting the organization to place him on injured reserve. The injury raised concerns that Jackson could miss the remainder of the regular season. However, Pelissero’s latest report suggests Baltimore has not completely ruled out a return, provided Jackson recovers sufficiently and the Ravens remain competitive in the AFC playoff race. Jacoby Brissett faces crucial stretch with Ravens amid Lamar Jackson injury Mandatory Credit: Joe Camporeale-Imagn Images Baltimore made a significant move earlier this week to address its quarterback situation, acquiring veteran Jacoby Brissett from the Arizona Cardinals ahead of the NFL trade deadline. The Ravens sent Arizona a 2027 fifth-round draft pick in exchange for Brissett , a 2027 fourth-round selection and a 2028 seventh-round pick. The transaction became official Friday, giving Baltimore an experienced option under center during Jackson’s absence. Brissett now faces the challenge of keeping the Ravens competitive while their franchise quarterback continues recovering from surgery. The veteran’s performance over the coming weeks could ultimately determine whether Baltimore remains in position to make a playoff push and potentially welcome Jackson back late in the season. With Jackson on injured reserve, the Ravens must navigate a difficult stretch without their two-time MVP. His absence places additional pressure on Baltimore’s offense to establish consistency and avoid falling further behind in the AFC standings. Baltimore will have additional time to prepare for its next matchup following Thursday’s loss to Jacksonville. The Ravens will return to action against the winless Los Angeles Chargers (0-7) on Monday, Nov. 16, at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN. For Baltimore, the upcoming matchup represents an opportunity to turn its season around while keeping Jackson’s potential return meaningful. articles._body: Sports media personality Skip Bayless nitpicks at the Dallas Cowboys to a T. That is no surprise to anyone. On a recent appearance on Stephen A. Smith’s YouTube channel, Bayless looked back at 2024, when the Cowboys hired Brian Schottenheimer to replace Mike McCarthy, per Brogan Clasper of HITC/Yahoo Sports. He cited his ideal candidate: Jim Harbaugh. “When Jim Harbaugh was available… I was pounding the desk: just go get Jim Harbaugh. Look, I know they’re off to a horrendous start, mostly because of Justin Herbert. Jim Harbaugh is a football coach who has won everywhere he’s been, and he’s been winning with the Chargers. They’ve been a playoff team until now, and this is horrendous, but I’m just saying he was available”. Ultimately, Bayless said Cowboys owner Jerry Jones wouldn’t hire a coach known for taking charge. “There’s no way Jerry Jones is going to hire Jim Harbaugh, because he’s too commanding,” Bayless said. “He’s too much his own man, and he’s going to say no to Jerry Jones. He’s going to take the stage over, take the team over, and change the culture.” Bayless cited Harbaugh’s pedigree at the collegiate level and in the NFL. “Look at Jim Harbaugh’s record at the University of San Diego, then at Stanford. Look what he did with the 49ers. Look what he did at Michigan, winning the national championship. Again, the Chargers were a playoff team last year, and they’ll be back; they’ll figure this out.” Ultimately, the Baltimore Ravens hired Harbaugh . Yankees’ perfect trade offer for Rangers’ Corey Seager
articles.summary: The New York Yankees should pursue Corey Seager with an offer that gives the Texas Rangers two affordable major league contributors and substantial financial flexibility. Will Warren and Spencer Jones would provide immediate pitching and outfield help, while New York would acquire a shortstop wit
articles._body: The New York Yankees should pursue Corey Seager with an offer that gives the Texas Rangers two affordable major league contributors and substantial financial flexibility. Will Warren and Spencer Jones would provide immediate pitching and outfield help, while New York would acquire a shortstop with a higher offensive ceiling. The proposal should include the Rangers contributing $30 million toward Seager’s remaining salary. That payment would help balance the Yankees’ financial exposure against the value of the young players they would surrender. The Athletic’s Ken Rosenthal pointed to the Rangers’ payroll crunch as the driving force behind a potential Seager trade in a Foul Territory clip shared on X, formerly Twitter, on Thursday. “Seager, deGrom, Eovaldi — they’re making $92 million combined next year. The Rangers’ payroll will be flat, according to their president of baseball operations, Chris Young, at $190 million. And you’ve got those guys making almost half of the salary. Those three players, half of the payroll — that’s not a workable equation, and that’s why the Rangers will be looking to do some things.” Could the Rangers shake up their core this offseason? @Ken_Rosenthal explains why Corey Seager, Jacob deGrom, and Nathan Eovaldi could all become trade candidates. pic.twitter.com/T9A74iCyhX — Foul Territory (@FoulTerritoryTV) November 5, 2026 This package is an editorial proposal, not a reported offer or an established asking price. The $30 million contribution is a suggested negotiating figure. Hypothetical trade Yankees receive Corey Seager and $30 million toward his remaining salary Rangers receive Will Warren and Spencer Jones Why Corey Seager fits the Yankees Seager’s appeal begins with his potential to produce more offense than New York’s current shortstop options. However, his recent results require restraint. He hit .227/.312/.424 with 20 home runs and a .736 OPS in 2026. The Yankees would be betting on a rebound , rather than purchasing a player coming off another dominant season. His .860 OPS in 2025 demonstrates the offensive upside, but previous production cannot guarantee future health or performance. The positional fit also requires planning. George Lombard Jr. is projected to open 2027 at shortstop for the Yankees . Acquiring Seager would require evaluating Lombard at another infield position instead of assuming both players automatically fit. New York should preserve regular playing opportunities for Lombard rather than turn his development into an afterthought. Seager would make the most sense as part of an infield plan that improves the lineup without wasting its younger talent. Why the Rangers should consider Warren and Jones Warren gives Texas a tangible rotation addition . The right-hander finished 2026 with a 3.92 ERA and 158 strikeouts across 156 innings. His control through 2030 would provide four more seasons before free agency. That makes him meaningful compensation. The Rangers would acquire someone capable of taking major league starts immediately, reducing their dependence on expensive outside pitching additions. Jones supplies another player who could contribute in 2027. He hit .245 with 11 home runs, 10 stolen bases and a .742 OPS across 86 games in his first major league season. His 105 strikeouts in 289 plate appearances underscore the development risk. Texas would need to believe it could help him make more consistent contact without sacrificing his power. Evan Carter’s hip surgery adds relevance to Jones’ outfield experience. Still, the Rangers should evaluate his defense carefully rather than assume his athleticism guarantees dependable center-field play. Keeping part of Seager’s salary would be the price of obtaining this stronger return. Texas would retain a financial obligation while adding two younger players and freeing substantial resources for other needs. The cash component should remain tied to the players included. If Texas wants to contribute less money, the Yankees should reduce the talent offered. If the Rangers want a stronger return, retaining more salary would give them a clearer argument for requesting additional young players. Both clubs must account for the risks Seager now has full trade-veto rights, making his approval essential. The Yankees cannot assume he wants to leave Texas or would welcome this destination. Medical evaluations matter just as much. Seager underwent elbow surgery after a season that included back problems. New York must determine whether his expected availability justifies a commitment running through 2031. The Yankees would also lose Warren’s innings and Jones’ outfield opportunities. They should proceed only with credible replacements, particularly when the acquisition itself would consume additional payroll. For the Rangers, the decision comes down to whether affordable production and financial flexibility outweigh keeping Seager. For the Yankees, his potential offensive rebound must justify the cost in talent and salary. This proposal gives Texas a path to a more balanced roster and New York a chance to strengthen its lineup, with both clubs accepting risk to address their offseason needs. According to a collaborative report from ESPN
articles._body: The Los Angeles Chargers (0-7) have reportedly shut down trade inquiries involving several key players, including 35-year-old star pass rusher Khalil Mack, despite remaining the NFL’s only winless team ahead of Tuesday’s trade deadline. According to a collaborative report from ESPN’s Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport on Saturday, the Chargers have made it clear that Mack will not be available, even as opposing teams continue exploring potential deals. “Despite their 0-7 record, the Los Angeles Chargers continue to tell teams that they have no interest in trading away Khalil Mack, and the veteran pass rusher will not be going anywhere before Tuesday’s deadline, according to sources.” Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh also expressed his desire to keep the veteran defensive star in Los Angeles. “I want Khalil Mack here,” Harbaugh told reporters. “Khalil Mack wants to be here.” The Chargers reportedly view Mack as an important part of their organization because of his leadership and on-field production. Despite their disastrous start, Los Angeles has shown little interest in parting ways with established players to acquire future assets. Chargers remain unwilling to trade key players despite 0-7 start The organization’s unwillingness to entertain trade offers extends beyond Mack, with quarterback Justin Herbert and wide receiver Ladd McConkey also drawing interest from opposing teams. “The Chargers also don’t like the message of giving up on the season. Calls from rival general managers on Justin Herbert, Ladd McConkey and others have received hard nos,” Schefter and Rapoport reported. Los Angeles is coming off a 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 8 , extending its losing streak to seven games. The Chargers entered the 2026 season hoping to build on their 11-6 campaign last year, which ended with a wild-card playoff loss to the New England Patriots. However, the team has struggled to find success despite adding former Miami Dolphins head coach Mike McDaniel as offensive coordinator. With the trade deadline approaching, Los Angeles appears committed to maintaining its core rather than embracing a roster overhaul. The Chargers will attempt to secure their first victory of the season against the Houston Texans (2-5) on Sunday at 1:05 p.m. PT on CBS. articles._body: Despite weeks of trade speculation surrounding Indianapolis Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor , the organization reportedly remains unlikely to move its franchise player ahead of the NFL trade deadline. According to NFL insider Tom Pelissero, Indianapolis is expected to retain Taylor unless another team presents an overwhelming offer in the coming days. Pelissero provided the latest update on Taylor’s future in his Substack newsletter Saturday, revealing that the Colts have yet to receive an offer compelling enough to consider parting ways with the 27-year-old. “After weeks of speculation, the most likely outcome for Taylor is … staying in Indianapolis. As we reported last week at The Sweep, the Colts quickly rejected an offer of a 2027 second-round pick plus another pick for Taylor. And while there were more inquiries made to the Colts this week, no team has come close to offering the type of premium capital that would persuade Indianapolis to deal him.” Although Taylor has attracted interest from several teams, Indianapolis appears comfortable maintaining its asking price rather than accepting a lesser return. Pelissero also noted that the Colts could revisit trade discussions during the offseason, particularly with significant organizational decisions approaching. “Is it possible that will change in the next few days? Of course. But Taylor is still only 27 years old. He just signed a two-year, $44 million extension in August. And barring injury, he’ll have just as much if not more trade value in March, when a new GM will be in place.” Taylor’s age and recent contract extension provide Indianapolis with flexibility as the organization evaluates its long-term direction. Colts could keep Jonathan Taylor despite ongoing roster overhaul Jeffrey Becker-Imagn Images The latest report comes as the Colts (2-6) continue navigating a disappointing season that has already prompted significant roster changes. Indianapolis recently traded All-Pro offensive guard Quenton Nelson to the Seattle Seahawks and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner to the San Francisco 49ers , raising questions about whether Taylor could become the next prominent player moved. However, Pelissero suggested that owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon’s ongoing evaluation of the organization could influence the decision to retain Taylor. “Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon is still evaluating everyone, from coach Shane Steichen and quarterback Daniel Jones on down, and that’s easier to do without stripping the roster to the studs. At this point, only a blockbuster offer for Taylor would cause the Colts to change course and move on from the face of the franchise.” Indianapolis is coming off an embarrassing 42-7 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars in Week 8 , extending its losing streak to four games. Despite the team’s struggles, Taylor remains a central figure in the Colts’ offense and could continue serving as a foundational piece while the organization determines its future. For now, Indianapolis will attempt to snap its losing streak against the Dallas Cowboys (3-5) on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on Fox, with Taylor increasingly likely to remain in a Colts uniform beyond the deadline. articles.title: The 1 trade Dolphins must make in final week before 2026 NFL trade deadline
articles.summary: The Miami Dolphins have spent most of the 2026 season working to establish a foundation for the future, but with a 1-6 record, that process is far from complete. As the November 10 NFL trade deadline approaches, general manager Jon-Eric Sullivan has another opportunity to reshape a roster that ha
articles._body: The Miami Dolphins have spent most of the 2026 season working to establish a foundation for the future, but with a 1-6 record, that process is far from complete. As the November 10 NFL trade deadline approaches, general manager Jon-Eric Sullivan has another opportunity to reshape a roster that has already seen significant changes since the offseason. In March, Miami traded Jaylen Waddle to the Denver Broncos , gaining valuable draft capital and creating opportunities for younger offensive players. This decision set an important precedent for a new front office willing to part with established talent if the return aligns with the team’s long-term plans. The Dolphins lack many veterans who could generate significant interest on the trade market, but one defender stands out as a logical trade candidate. Edge rusher Josh Uche has been productive enough to catch the attention of contenders, and with his contract set to expire, it is hard to justify keeping him without a clear plan for his future. Dolphins should trade Josh Uche to the 49ers before the NFL deadline Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Uche arrived in Miami during the offseason after spending the previous year with the Philadelphia Eagles. The former second-round pick has had an inconsistent career, moving between several teams after initially establishing himself as a promising pass rusher with the New England Patriots. His first seven appearances with the Dolphins have shown encouraging signs that he can still contribute to an NFL defensive rotation. Uche has recorded 29 tackles, two sacks, and one forced fumble, providing valuable veteran presence on a defense that has struggled to contain opposing offenses. While his statistics do not place him among the league’s elite edge defenders, they demonstrate his capability to handle meaningful responsibilities. His production is particularly relevant because Miami has given him significantly more starting opportunities than he had with Philadelphia last season. He started six of the Dolphins’ seven games, allowing the coaching staff to assess how effectively he performs with an expanded workload. The results have been respectable, even if the overall defense has faced considerable difficulties. Given the Dolphins’ rebuilding circumstances, Uche’s contractual situation is especially important. He signed a one-year deal during the offseason and is scheduled to become an unrestricted free agent after the 2026 season. They can either retain him for the remaining games, evaluate whether a new contract is warranted, and risk losing him in free agency, or they can attempt to trade him while he still has value to a team competing for a championship, and the latter option is likely appealing for the Dolphins. Uche will turn 29 next year, meaning his career timeline does not necessarily align with an organization still striving to build a competitive roster. Miami has younger defensive players who could benefit from additional playing time, including Chop Robinson, whose development is crucial for the franchise’s future. Why the 49ers would make an ideal trade partner San Francisco has established itself as one of the leading contenders in the NFC, entering Week 9 with a 6-1 record despite juggling several significant injuries. The 49ers have already shown their commitment to strengthening the roster before the trade deadline by acquiring veteran defensive lineman DeForest Buckner from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a fourth-round pick in 2027, and this transaction helped address their interior defensive line needs, but general manager John Lynch may still look to add another player who can pressure opposing quarterbacks from the outside. Nick Bosa has been recovering from a calf injury that kept him sidelined for several weeks. The former Defensive Player of the Year fully participated in practice on Friday and has been cleared to face the Las Vegas Raiders, providing a significant boost to San Francisco’s defense; his return enhances the team’s prospects, but the lengthy absence underscores the importance of having reliable depth. So, adding Uche would give defensive coordinator Raheem Morris another option for pass-rushing situations, allowing the team to rotate its edge defenders without significantly compromising their ability to attack the pocket. Uche’s most productive NFL season came in 2022 when he recorded 11.5 sacks with the New England Patriots, and although he has not matched that total in subsequent seasons, that performance showcased his capability to capitalize on favorable pass-rushing opportunities. San Francisco would not require him to be an every-down starter. Playing alongside accomplished defenders such as Bosa, Mykel Williams, and Buckner would enable Uche to focus on situations where his pass-rushing skills would be most advantageous. So, this role may suit him better than the extensive responsibilities he faced in Miami. What Miami should demand in a Josh Uche trade Mandatory Credit: Stephen R. Sylvanie-Imagn Images Uche’s contract makes him an appealing trade target because the acquiring team would not need to commit a significant amount of money. His one-year deal is valued at approximately $1.4 million, and the remaining salary would be relatively affordable for a contender looking to enhance its defensive lineup; this affordability is beneficial for the San Francisco 49ers, especially after they invested resources to acquire Buckner. Additionally, the 49ers still possess their own fifth-round pick in the 2027 draft, which makes the proposed trade compensation feasible without requiring another complex transaction. articles.title: Exclusive: Why Cardinals’ slugger Jordan Walker is so humbled to be honored by Ebony Magazine
articles.summary: It was a history-making year for St. Louis Cardinals right fielder Jordan Walker. In July, Walker won the Home Run Derby, becoming the first Cardinal to do so. Overall, he finished with a .269 batting average, 164 hits, 29 home runs, and 102 RBIs. On Monday, he will receive an illustrious honor.
articles._body: It was a history-making year for St. Louis Cardinals right fielder Jordan Walker. In July, Walker won the Home Run Derby , becoming the first Cardinal to do so. Overall, he finished with a .269 batting average, 164 hits, 29 home runs, and 102 RBIs. On Monday, he will receive an illustrious honor. Walker will be recognized as one of Ebony Magazine’s Power 100. Ebony is one of the longest-running and most respected African American magazines. Walker will join Naomi Osaka, Renne Montgomery, Nneka Owumike, Elana Meyers Taylor, Folarin Balogun, Tyshawn Jones, and the New York Knicks as the sports figures honored. The celebration will also highlight other African Americans who achieved great things this year in politics, business, and entertainment under the theme of ‘The Stories We Shape’. In an exclusive with ClutchPoints, Walker takes the honor to heart. “Being named as an EBONY Leader in Sport is awesome!” Walker said. “Ebony Magazine is a pioneer in reporting on the lives and achievements of Black people. Their commentary is well respected by millions. So, I am deeply honored that they feel my desire for wanting more Black kids in baseball is worthy of recognition. After winning the Home Run Derby, Walker expressed hope for more black players in baseball. Currently, Black players make up 6.8% of MLB, up 2% in two years, per MLB.com. Issues around access to the game, cultural shifts, systemic bias, and lack of representation still remain . Walker hopes to change that and is proudly standing on the shoulders of giants. Jordan Walker is continuing a rich history The game’s history regarding race is well documented. But the Cardinals have a unique history, fielding some of the most impactful game changers. Bob Gibson, the best fireballer of his time in the 1960s. Bill White, a power-hitting first baseman and Gold Glove Award winner who later became a famous broadcaster. Curt Flood, the man who sacrificed his career to give players the freedom to determine their destinies (Flood v. Kuhn). Lou Brock, a dynamic baserunner and consistent hitter. These trailblazers paved the way for Walker, and he feels overwhelmed to be mentioned in this group. “It is humbling to be mentioned as part of such an outstanding legacy,” he said. “The names you mentioned are giants for the Cardinals and for the history of baseball overall. Without the efforts of those guys, I would not be here today. They had to go through so much in their time – racism, bigotry, hatred – just to be able to play the game that they loved. Yet, they stood out for playing the game at the highest level possible and left records that in some cases are still to be broken. Now, I can go out and continue to carry the banner as a black player for the St. Louis Cardinals.” Walker is doing that both on and off the field. Walker is putting in the work Along with his mother, Walker set up the Walker’s Winners Foundation, an organization that helps youth achieve their dreams by promoting literacy and personal development. Additionally, Walker conducts baseball clinics in his spare time. Two passions that he intends to continue. “So, whether it is conducting baseball clinics on fields around the community, or helping with reading and math exercises with youth with Walker’s Winners, I will continue to work directly with kids to help them reach goals,” Walker said. In the end, Walker carries these honors and successes with great humility, along with a strong desire to keep growing. “I am amazed that I have had some success already,” he said. “But what drives me is that I have to continue to work hard to maintain and grow every day so I can reach my fullest potential.” The Power 100 is scheduled for Monday, November 9, at the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles. articles.title: Oilers’ Connor McDavid, Leon Draisaitl, Evan Bouchard join extremely exclusive NHL list
articles.summary: The Edmonton Oilers continue to make NHL history behind their star-studded core. Connor McDavid, Leon Draisaitl, and Evan Bouchard have reached an impressive scoring milestone, placing the three teammates in an exclusive group of players to accomplish the feat during the same season. Bouchard rea
articles._body: The Edmonton Oilers continue to make NHL history behind their star-studded core. Connor McDavid , Leon Draisaitl , and Evan Bouchard have reached an impressive scoring milestone, placing the three teammates in an exclusive group of players to accomplish the feat during the same season. Bouchard reached the 30-point mark after contributing a goal and an assist on Thursday, joining McDavid and Draisaitl as the Oilers’ third player to hit the milestone this season. McDavid led the way with four points, while Draisaitl added two in the same game. Bouchard also made history by becoming only the sixth defenseman in the NHL’s modern era, which began in 1943-44, to score at least 10 goals within his first 17 games. The trio’s production puts Edmonton in rare company. The Oilers became only the third team in the past 50 years to have three players emerge as the league’s first three outright 30-point scorers in a season. The 1995-96 Pittsburgh Penguins and the 1979-80 Los Angeles Kings are the only other teams to achieve that distinction. McDavid continues to set the pace with his outstanding playmaking and scoring ability. Draisaitl has remained a major offensive force alongside him, while Bouchard’s contributions from the blue line have given Edmonton another dangerous weapon. Their combined production has helped the Oilers maintain one of the league’s most threatening offenses. Edmonton’s power play has also played a major role in its offensive success. The team’s ability to capitalize on scoring chances, combined with the individual talent of its top players, makes it a difficult matchup for opponents. If the trio maintains this pace, the Oilers could continue rewriting the record books. articles.summary: The Texas football team got some unfortunate news with running back Hollywood Smothers, who has suffered a season-ending injury. But the Longhorns have gotten somewhat positive injury updates for a change, as both Colin Simmons and Cam Coleman are both game-time decisions to play against Missouri
articles._body: The Texas football team got some unfortunate news with running back Hollywood Smothers , who has suffered a season-ending injury. But the Longhorns have gotten somewhat positive injury updates for a change, as both Colin Simmons and Cam Coleman are both game-time decisions to play against Missouri. Simmons, in particular, is looking good to play , per College GameDay. Meanwhile, there is still some skepticism surrounding Coleman’s ability to go , per Pete Nakos of On3. ESPN’s Pete Thamel added that Coleman is not taking part in drills , which could potentially point to him not playing. Simmons has been sidelined for the last two games after suffering a high ankle sprain in their 27-24 loss to Florida. As for Coleman, he left the Longhorns’ 31-3 win over Mississippi State early and did not play in the second half. Prior to his exit, Coleman had two catches for 61 yards with a touchdown. Despite missing their star edge rusher in Simmons, the Texas defense has done a good job against opposing offenses. They gave Ole Miss’ Trinidad Chambliss a lot of trouble, picking him off three times. They also completely shut down Mississippi State’s ground game, limiting the Bulldogs to just 68 yards. On the other end, Coleman’s potential absence will be a blow to Arch Manning and the Texas offense. Coleman leads the team with seven touchdown catches this season to go along with 409 receiving yards. Luckily for the Longhorns, they have two other wideouts with over 400 yards receiving this season in Ryan Wingo (36 catches, 470 yards) and Emmett Mosley V (25 catches, 419 yards).
