articles.title: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama accomplishes impressive scoring feat in limited action vs. Kings
articles.summary: After delivering a career-best 52-point performance against the Dallas Mavericks, Victor Wembanyama continued his impressive run by shining in the San Antonio Spurs’ 124-109 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Friday. The Spurs superstar put together another outstanding performance despite playi
articles._body: After delivering a career-best 52-point performance against the Dallas Mavericks , Victor Wembanyama continued his impressive run by shining in the San Antonio Spurs’ 124-109 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Friday. The Spurs superstar put together another outstanding performance despite playing limited minutes, helping his team extend its winning streak to seven games and improve its record to 7-2. Wembanyama finished with 30 points, 14 rebounds, two blocks and two assists. He shot 10-of-18 from the field and knocked down four of his six attempts from beyond the arc. Even more impressively, the French big man produced those numbers in just 26 minutes of action. The Spurs superstar also made history with another remarkable defensive achievement. According to Novig, Wembanyama has now recorded at least two blocks in each of his first nine games this season, giving him the second-longest streak to open a season in NBA history. Only David Robinson has produced a longer run, recording at least two blocks in 14 consecutive games to begin the 1992-93 season. However, the victory also brought a moment of concern for San Antonio as Wembanyama twisted his left ankle after landing on Domantas Sabonis’ foot while attempting a three-pointer. The foul was subsequently upgraded to a Flagrant 1 against Sabonis. Fortunately for the Spurs, the next projected Wilt Chamberlain in Dylan Harper’s eyes was able to return to the game and appeared comfortable following the incident. His presence helped San Antonio protect its advantage and maintain control as Sacramento attempted to mount a comeback. Though the Kings made the game more competitive after halftime, they struggled to find consistent answers for San Antonio’s offensive production. The Spurs maintained their advantage through a balanced scoring effort, with several players stepping up alongside Wembanyama. Stephon Castle was among the team’s key contributors, finishing with 19 points and seven assists. Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell also finished with 19 points. Harrison Barnes contributed 13 points, one rebound and one steal in the win. articles.title: Benson Boone Brings Young Fan Battling Cancer Onstage at Brisbane Concert
articles.summary: “I’ve had the opportunity of meeting a 13-year-old girl who is battling her second round of cancer,” Boone told the crowd.
articles._body: Benson Boone opened the Australian leg of his Wanted Man tour with a special guest. He brought a 13-year-old fan who is battling cancer onstage to sing “Beautiful Things” with him on her birthday. The moment came at the end of Boone’s set at Brisbane Entertainment Centre on Friday (Nov. 6). The Music reported that the singer stopped to introduce the final song. “I’ve had the opportunity of meeting a 13-year-old girl who is battling her second round of cancer,” Boone told the crowd, according to the outlet. “It’s her birthday today and her birthday wish was to come on stage and sing ‘Beautiful Things.’” The fan, Kenzie Riddle, then rose from an upper platform and joined Boone on the song. According to The Music, roughly 10,000 people were in the arena. Riddle has Ewing’s sarcoma. As reported by Nine’s Today, she believed she had beaten the illness after about two and a half years of treatment, but the cancer returned and she is now facing intensive chemotherapy. Her family said they bought tickets to the show in July as her 13th birthday present. Her campaign to meet Boone took off online after a local musician, Fergus Hogan, shared an Instagram video about her story. “I love his energetic style and how he’s so over the top,” Riddle told Today before the concert. “He’s kinda crazy and I love it.” Her family also told the program: “She’s such an unbelievable inspiration to so many people… But I think even bigger than that is the community behind her.” “Beautiful Things” was Boone’s breakout single. Released in January 2024, it reached No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and became one of the most-streamed songs in the world that year. Boone followed it with his debut album Fireworks & Rollerblades that April. His second album, American Heart , arrived in 2025 and included the single “Mystical Magical.” The Brisbane show opened Boone’s Wanted Man tour of Australia . Boone has two additional Brisbane performances scheduled for Nov. 7 and 8 before the tour heads to Melbourne for three concerts at Rod Laver Arena beginning Nov. 12. The Australian leg concludes with three shows at Sydney’s Afterpay Arena from Nov. 17-19.

articles.title: 2 best Domantas Sabonis trade destinations amid rumored unhappiness with dreadful Kings
articles.summary: There have been some rumblings going around that Domantas Sabonis is unhappy with both his situation and his role with the Sacramento Kings. Tim MacMahon of ESPN said point blank that Sabonis is not happy and “wants out” of the franchise, and considering that they’ve been losing
articles._body: There have been some rumblings going around that Domantas Sabonis is unhappy with both his situation and his role with the Sacramento Kings. Tim MacMahon of ESPN said point blank that Sabonis is not happy and “wants out” of the franchise, and considering that they’ve been losing games left and right to begin the 2026-27 season, it’s not out of the realm of possibility at all for this to be the case. Domantas Sabonis is unhappy and wants out of Sacramento, per @BannedMacMahon “Quite frankly, Sabonis wants out of there, and if they can move him, they would. So he's not happy.” pic.twitter.com/YqLwiU5jAf — NBABase (@TheNBABase) November 2, 2026 In fact, there have been rumors that Sabonis does not like playing alongside rookie guard Darius Acuff Jr. since he’s becoming less of a focal point on the offensive end — reduced to being a play finisher instead of initiating the offense for his team. But these rumors have since been shot down by a few reporters, as it doesn’t look like there is in-fighting in the Kings locker room despite their rough start to this new campaign. The Kings have lost eight of their first nine games this season, and they could very well be headed for a full-scale rebuild. To that end, turning over the franchise fully into the hands of Acuff while recouping some assets for their former All-Stars in Sabonis and Zach LaVine could be the proper course of action for this team. Sabonis is only 30 years of age, and while he’s not the most adept player on the defensive end, he could be back to being his most impactful self in the right situation. But at this point, there are significant question marks that make acquiring him via trade a risky maneuver. Nonetheless, these two teams should benefit from the potential addition of Sabonis , especially when taking into consideration their goals of competing for this season. Toronto Raptors Ed Szczepanski-Imagn Images It’s been an inconsistent start to the new season for the Raptors, a team that many believed would take the next step after acquiring Kawhi Leonard in a blockbuster trade this past offseason. Leonard played in 65 games last season, and he put up nearly 29 points a night on 51/39/89 shooting splits, and some thought that he would be the missing piece for this team similar to how he got the team over the hump seven years ago. However, Leonard’s horrid injury history is rearing its ugly head once more. The Raptors star is currently dealing with some swelling in his knee, and reports came out that he would be out for at least three to four weeks. At the very least, he is beginning his process to return to the hardwood. The Raptors’ trade for Leonard suggests that they believe that the time to win is now. And as sad as it is to admit, Toronto might be in need of an upgrade at the center position. Jakob Poeltl has looked washed up through the first eight games of this season, averaging 5.2 points and 5.7 rebounds per game. He’s performed so poorly that the Raptors are now bringing him off the bench, promoting Collin Murray-Boyles in the process. Murray-Boyles is a bright young talent, but at just 6-foot-7, he doesn’t have the prototypical size at the position to handle more of the bruising players at the five. Considering how many defensive-minded players the Raptors have on the roster, it might work wonders for them to add more offensive firepower, which Sabonis brings in spades. Sabonis is an elite screen-setter, which should give the likes of Immanuel Quickley and RJ Barrett room to get downhill, and his passing acumen from the high post should make Scottie Barnes’ scoring life in the paint that much easier. Barnes is an elite defensive player, and he has the shot-blocking ability and mobility to help cover for Sabonis’ vertical and lateral deficiencies. When Leonard returns, the Raptors should have all the defensive range in the world to try and complement Sabonis’ more offensive game. Sabonis is still averaging 15 and 15 this season to go with 6.1 assists per game, and he will provide the Raptors another dimension to their offense as well as a bruiser in the paint whose shortcomings they should help mitigate. The problem is that the Kings appear to have no interest in acquiring Poeltl and the $103.6 million remaining on his contract for this year and the next three. That has suddenly become one of the worst contracts in the NBA, and it might be difficult to convince any team to take on that kind of money. The Raptors’ draft-pick situation is also a bit tricky. The Los Angeles Clippers own the right to swap first-round picks in 2027, while they also sent away their first-round selections in 2031 and 2033. Will Toronto be willing to give up their first-rounder in 2029 to try and sweeten the pot for the Kings? They surely aren’t going to involve Murray-Boyles in any trade talks, that’s for certain. To match salaries, the Raptors will also have to add RJ Barrett, which could be a non-starter as it would leave them rather thin on the wings. But at the end of the day, Sabonis is a much better player than Poeltl at this very moment, and finding a reasonable deal for the Kings big man should give them a better chance to compete in the East. Charlotte Hornets Jim Dedmon-Imagn Images All the good vibes the Hornets had built from last season’s surprisingly good campaign appear to be gone . They have the league’s worst offense heading into play on Friday against the Boston Celtics, and it sure looks like LaMelo Ball’s absence is affecting them more negatively than they had anticipated. If there’s a team that could become desperate enough to trade for Sabonis all while being a realistic suitor, it’s the Hornets. Céline Dion Plays Air Bass at Metallica’s Sphere Show
articles.summary: The singer showed off her air-bass skills during Metallica's Life Burns Faster residency at Las Vegas' Sphere.
articles._body: Céline Dion might be best known for her soaring power ballads, but the Canadian superstar proved she knows her way around a heavy metal concert, too. The “My Heart Will Go On” singer was spotted enthusiastically playing air bass during Metallica ‘s Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere in Las Vegas on Thursday (Nov. 5), with fan-filmed footage capturing her enjoying the performance from a suite inside the venue. In a video shared on Instagram by user @theordacityyy , Dion can be seen standing and mimicking the bass-playing techniques of Metallica’s Robert Trujillo, enthusiastically moving her hands as the musician performed alongside guitarist Kirk Hammett. The moment occurred during the band’s customary “Kirk and Rob Doodle,” an instrumental segment that gives Hammett and Trujillo an opportunity to jam together during the show. According to the concert’s reported setlist, the Nov. 5 installment incorporated “Motown Yo Town” and “Copenhagen.” Dion wasn’t the only famous face taking in the performance. Guns N’ Roses guitarist Slash was also reportedly spotted in the suite, while members of No Doubt were among the other musicians seen enjoying the concert. Although Dion’s enthusiasm might seem unexpected to fans more familiar with her romantic ballads, her appreciation for Metallica is hardly newEarlier this year, the five-time Grammy winner shared a selection of songs from her personal playlist , which included Metallica’s 1996 single “Until It Sleeps.” “Eddy, one of my twins, his favorite band is Metallica,” Dion said in the video, before enthusiastically attempting her own impression of frontman James Hetfield. The appearance comes amid an eventful year for Dion, who returned to full-length concerts in September after a six-year absence. Her Paris residency marked a significant milestone following her 2022 announcement that she had been diagnosed with stiff-person syndrome, a rare neurological disorder that had affected her ability to perform. Dion, whose Billboard Hot 100 history includes four No. 1 singles — “The Power of Love,” “Because You Loved Me,” “My Heart Will Go On” and her R. Kelly duet “I’m Your Angel” — completed the first leg of her Paris comeback performances in October. Meanwhile, Metallica’s Life Burns Faster residency launched at Sphere on Oct. 1, bringing the metal veterans’ No Repeat Weekend concept to the Las Vegas venue. The format, introduced during the band’s M72 World Tour, features different setlists across paired Thursday and Saturday concerts. The band concludes the 2026 portion of its Sphere residency on Saturday (Nov. 7), with performances scheduled to resume in January 2027. Watch Dion’s air-bass moment below.

articles.title: How ‘natural instincts’ nearly led Hawks’ Dyson Daniels to a triple-double vs. Wizards
articles.summary: ATLANTA – Dyson Daniels has been everywhere on the floor for the Atlanta Hawks this week. Two nights ago in their first game against the Washington Wizards, he finished with 16 rebounds, with seven of them being on the offensive end. He added eight points and eight assists, nearly finishing
articles._body: ATLANTA – Dyson Daniels has been everywhere on the floor for the Atlanta Hawks this week. Two nights ago in their first game against the Washington Wizards, he finished with 16 rebounds, with seven of them being on the offensive end. He added eight points and eight assists, nearly finishing with a triple-double. Tonight at home, he was everyone on the floor once again, and finished with 13 points, nine rebounds and 12 assists on the way to a 139-132 win for the Hawks. Daniels failed to grab a rebound in the fourth quarter, but you can’t say he didn’t try. There were several times he had his hand on the ball, but it would slip out of bounds. At the end of the game, Daniels had a clear chance for a rebound, but Onyeka Okongwu took the opportunity. “The bench was definitely in my ear about it,” Daniels said after the game . “The win is the most important thing, but I think my natural instincts throughout the game always are just to go rebound. We’re small out there on the floor, so rebounding is a big thing that I’ve been trying to do. That last quarter, I was telling them to box out so I could go grab one.” With the Hawks without Jalen Johnson , Jock Landale, Asa Newell and Mouhamed Gueye, their frontcourt was obviously shorthanded coming into the game. That meant that it had to be a collective group effort on crashing the boards, and Daniels has been doing that for the Hawks. If he isn’t on the boards, then he’s probably finding his teammates for assists, which overall led the team to 38 total in the game. “Our team, the way we play the offense that Quin’s built into us is we move the ball side to side. Everyone gets touches and when you play that way, you’re going to get assists, and we want to get out and run,” Daniels said. “We’re undersized as a team, so when we play a team like Washington, who’s really big, we want to run them up and down as much as we can. “Our offense is moving the ball side to side, breaking the paint, eyes out, and playing that way is going to get you a lot of assists and everyone gets touches.” Lu Dort was one of the players who benefitted a lot from the ball movement, finishing the game with 25 points, which is the most points he’s scored in a game since early last year with the Oklahoma City Thunder. He hit some big shots down the stretch for the Hawks as the Wizards tried to make a last-minute comeback. “I think as a team, we’re just trying our best to find the right shots in those situations,” Dort said. “When the game comes down to that, you have to try your best to just get stops and take the right shots. We just had to read the game. We got the ball moving a little bit. I was the one who was open to make those shots.” When Daniels wasn’t on the boards or making plays for his teammates, he was mostly guarding his former teammate, Trae Young, who played his first game in Atlanta since being traded last season. Young was able to finish with 23 points and 10 assists, but Daniels didn’t make it easy for him. “It’s different playing against Trae,” Daniels said. “Obviously, a super talented guy; played here for however many years. He’s a really good player. He gets his teammates involved. Our game plan was to force him left, channel the ball screens, and keep him contained that way.” Daniels has proven to be an all-around player for the Hawks, and over the last two games, it’s definitely shown on the stat sheet. articles.title: Cubs’ Pete Crow-Armstrong wins NL Platinum Glove Award
articles.summary: Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Chicago Cubs have more hardware to celebrate. Just days after helping Chicago win the National League Team Gold Glove, the Cubs’ center fielder was named the 2026 NL Platinum Glove Award winner. Rawlings announced the honor on Friday, with New York Yankees outfielder C
articles._body: Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Chicago Cubs have more hardware to celebrate. Just days after helping Chicago win the National League Team Gold Glove , the Cubs’ center fielder was named the 2026 NL Platinum Glove Award winner. Rawlings announced the honor on Friday, with New York Yankees outfielder Cody Bellinger taking home the American League Platinum Glove . The award recognizes the best overall defensive player in each league, chosen from the pool of Gold Glove winners. Crow-Armstrong earned his place in that group by winning his second straight Gold Glove in center field. It was hardly a close call at the position. He led the league with 26 Outs Above Average and 10 Defensive Runs Saved, cementing his status as one of the most dynamic defenders in baseball. What made his 2026 season even more special was what he did at the plate. Crow-Armstrong hit .280 with 45 home runs, 107 RBIs and 41 stolen bases, joining the exclusive 40/40 club . It was another big step forward for the 24-year-old, who has quickly developed into one of the brightest young stars in all of baseball. He was far from the only Cub who shined with the glove. Alex Bregman won his first Gold Glove as a member of the Cubs at third base, becoming the first Chicago third baseman to win the award since Ron Santo. Ian Happ, Dansby Swanson and Seiya Suzuki were also named finalists, giving the Cubs five Gold Glove finalists, tied with the Toronto Blue Jays for the most in the majors. As a team, the Cubs led the league with 115 Outs Above Average and 73 Defensive Runs Saved, earning their second straight NL Team Gold Glove. The Blue Jays took home the AL honor. Despite the elite defense, Chicago’s season ended earlier than hoped. The Cubs finished 89-73 and were eliminated by the San Diego Padres in the NL Wild Card Series . Still, the future looks bright on the North Side with Crow-Armstrong leading the way . With his rare combination of power, speed and elite defense, he has established himself as one of the most complete players in baseball, and the Cubs will be counting on him to lead a deeper postseason push in 2027. articles.title: Lakers’ Luka Doncic accomplishes feat not seen since Kobe Bryant
articles.summary: Luka Doncic continues to rewrite the Los Angeles Lakers’ record books, accomplishing another remarkable scoring milestone previously achieved by Kobe Bryant. The superstar guard, who recently made NBA history during a win over the Sacramento Kings, has now recorded four consecutive 40-point
articles._body: Luka Doncic continues to rewrite the Los Angeles Lakers’ record books, accomplishing another remarkable scoring milestone previously achieved by Kobe Bryant. The superstar guard, who recently made NBA history during a win over the Sacramento Kings, has now recorded four consecutive 40-point performances, joining an exclusive group of franchise legends. According to ClutchPoints NBA reporter Brett Siegel, Doncic became just the fourth Lakers player to accomplish the feat during the regular season. The achievement places Doncic alongside Bryant, Elgin Baylor, and George Mikan, three legendary figures who helped establish Los Angeles as one of basketball’s most successful franchises. For Doncic, the milestone represents another impressive chapter in his remarkable start to the 2026-27 campaign. His offensive production has consistently placed opposing defenses under pressure, with his scoring ability becoming central to the Lakers’ success. The Slovenian superstar recently delivered 40 points, nine rebounds, and seven assists against Sacramento, helping Los Angeles secure a 116-103 victory. That performance extended an extraordinary stretch of individual dominance. Doncic also became the first player in NBA history to register six consecutive games with at least 35 points, five rebounds, five assists, and five made three-pointers. His historic scoring run comes shortly after Giannis Antetokounmpo praised Doncic as one of basketball’s greatest scorers. The comparisons with Bryant carry particular significance given the late Lakers icon’s legendary scoring accomplishments throughout his career. With Doncic continuing to produce historic numbers, Los Angeles has another reason to believe its franchise centerpiece can sustain this remarkable offensive momentum throughout the current NBA season. The Los Angeles Lakers superstar continued his scorching start to the season on Friday against the Portland Trail Blazers, once again leaving fans amazed with an unbelievable play. Just before halftime, Doncic somehow connected on an incredible buzzer-beater from near the opposite three-point line, sending Lakers fans into a frenzy with a shot that immediately became one of the night’s biggest highlights. Before the game even reached its end, the Slovenian superstar had already made history by recording his fourth consecutive 40-point game. With that achievement, he joined Lakers legends Elgin Baylor, Kobe Bryant and George Mikan as the only players in franchise history to accomplish the feat during the regular season. Even head coach JJ Redick openly admitted that he would need to spend some time thinking of new ways to praise his superstar because he has already exhausted the words available to him. “Sure. I’m gonna just sit around and will gather one day, come up with more superlatives so I have more words ready. But for now, I don’t have any words,” Redick said after the win. Behind Doncic’s dominant display , the Lakers secured a 124-118 victory over the Trail Blazers on Friday night. Despite struggling to find their rhythm during the opening half, Los Angeles responded with another outstanding performance from its superstar to extend its winning streak to four games and improve its record to 8-2. articles.title: Yankees’ Cody Bellinger wins AL Platinum Glove Award
articles.summary: Cody Bellinger’s banner defensive season with the New York Yankees just got even better. Less than a week after winning a Gold Glove, the Yankees outfielder has been named the 2026 American League Platinum Glove Award winner. Rawlings announced the honor on Friday, with Chicago Cubs center fielde
articles._body: Cody Bellinger’s banner defensive season with the New York Yankees just got even better. Less than a week after winning a Gold Glove , the Yankees outfielder has been named the 2026 American League Platinum Glove Award winner. Rawlings announced the honor on Friday, with Chicago Cubs center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong taking home the National League Platinum Glove. The award goes to the best overall defensive player in each league, chosen from the pool of Gold Glove winners. Bellinger earned his spot in that group by winning the AL Gold Glove in left field on Nov. 1. It was the second Gold Glove of his career and his first since 2019, when he won it as a right fielder with the Los Angeles Dodgers during his National League MVP season. The Platinum Glove recognition comes as no surprise. Bellinger was arguably the best defensive left fielder in baseball this season, racking up 21 Defensive Runs Saved. That was well ahead of Milwaukee Brewers outfielder Jackson Chourio, who had 13 and won the NL Gold Glove at the position. Bellinger also ranked above the 90th percentile in both Fielding Run Value and Outs Above Average. The Yankees made sure to celebrate his Gold Glove win earlier in the week. “Good as Gold. Congratulations on your 2nd career @RawlingsSports Gold Glove, Belli!” the team wrote on X. Bellinger was productive at the plate as well, hitting .264 with 17 home runs, 73 RBIs, 12 stolen bases and a .768 OPS in 132 games. He also took home All-Star Game MVP honors in July after delivering a two-run single in the AL’s 4-0 win. The honors cap a strong second season in pinstripes for the 31-year-old, who re-signed with New York in January on a five-year, $162.5 million contract . The deal includes opt-outs after the second and third seasons, as well as a full no-trade clause. Unfortunately for him and the Yankees, the season did not end the way they had hoped. New York was swept by the Tampa Bay Rays in the AL Division Series. Still, Bellinger has given the Yankees plenty to look forward to. With his glove and bat both in top form, he should remain a key piece as New York looks to bounce back in 2027. articles._body: Yaxel Lendeborg has been on an absolute tear to start his NBA career , and now the Golden State Warriors rookie is sharing that success with the person who helped make it possible. In his first YouTube video, Lendeborg surprised his mom, Yissel Raposo, with a brand-new house. The video shows Lendeborg standing in front of the home with a gift box in hand as his family gathers around. Before the big reveal, he admitted he was feeling the nerves. “I’m nervous now. On behalf of everybody that came to show up, welcome home,” Lendeborg said, before inviting his mom to step inside and “test it out.” Yaxel surprises his mom with a new house in his 1st YouTube video pic.twitter.com/gmVVkRyzyf — Chef (@CurryForGame) November 7, 2026 The gesture means even more given everything his mom has done for him. Lendeborg has credited her for putting him on the path to the NBA , and he opened up about it after the Warriors selected him in June. “[My mom] pretty much put me on this path,” Lendeborg said. “She always kept that extra chip on my shoulder and extra motivation.” Raposo, a former basketball player for the Dominican Republic national team, stepped in to help get her son back on track academically when he was ineligible as a high school freshman. Lendeborg did not start playing organized basketball until his senior year of high school and had to grind through three years of junior college and two seasons at UAB before transferring to Michigan. That path led him to a national championship with the Wolverines, First-Team All-American honors and a spot as the No. 11 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft . Lendeborg has wasted no time making his mark in Golden State. The 23-year-old forward has been averaging around 21 points per game and recently joined Wilt Chamberlain in the history books with a career night against the LA Clippers. He followed that up with 17 points, eight rebounds, six assists and three steals in Thursday’s 120-100 win over the Miami Heat. His strong play has helped the Warriors rattle off six straight wins after an 0-3 start , improving to 6-3 on the season. Now, his mom has a new home to watch him from. Lendeborg and the Warriors will look to extend their winning streak when they host the Orlando Magic on Saturday. articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays may have come up empty in the individual Gold Glove races, but their defense still earned some major hardware. Toronto has been named the American League Team Gold Glove winner, while the Chicago Cubs took home the National League honor. The award recognizes the best defensi
articles._body: The Toronto Blue Jays may have come up empty in the individual Gold Glove races, but their defense still earned some major hardware. Toronto has been named the American League Team Gold Glove winner, while the Chicago Cubs took home the National League honor . The award recognize s the best defensive team in each league, and the Blue Jays made a strong case throughout the 2026 MLB season. Toronto led the American League with five Gold Glove finalists, tying the Cubs for the most in the majors. None of those finalists ended up winning , though. When the individual awards were revealed on Nov. 1, pitcher Jose Soriano lost out to Tanner Bibee of the Cleveland Guardians, and catcher Brandon Valenzuela was edged by Dillon Dingler of the Detroit Tigers. At first base, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. fell short against Christian Walker of the Houston Astros, while shortstop Andres Gimenez lost to Taylor Walls of the Tampa Bay Rays. In right field, Nathan Lukes was beaten out by Wilyer Abreu of the Boston Red Sox. The Team Gold Glove is a nice consolation prize, as several Blue Jays turned in standout seasons with the glove. Gimenez, who won three straight Gold Gloves at second base from 2022 to 2024 , made a smooth transition to shortstop, posting 19 Outs Above Average to tie Masyn Winn for second among shortstops. Lukes recorded 11 Defensive Runs Saved without committing an error in right field, and Statcast rated his arm as the most valuable among American League outfielders. Valenzuela, meanwhile, ranked among the top five catchers in Fielding Run Value, adding nine Defensive Runs Saved and eight runs from pitch framing. Guerrero also enjoyed what many considered the best defensive season of his career. Unfortunately for Toronto, the strong defense was not enough to carry the team. The Blue Jays finished below .500 and missed the playoffs, with an inconsistent offense largely to blame. That is why improving the lineup will be a top priority this offseason. MLB insider Ken Rosenthal has already identified Seiya Suzuki and Randy Arozarena as logical targets for Toronto . If the Blue Jays can add some punch to the lineup, their elite defense could help them get back into contention in 2027. articles.title: Celtics HC Joe Mazzulla gives props to Jayson Tatum for taking great shots vs. Hornets
articles.summary: Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics were firing on all cylinders against the Charlotte Hornets on Friday night, and head coach Joe Mazzulla had nothing but praise for his star forward’s shot selection. Tatum poured in 34 points in Boston’s 119-80 blowout win at Spectrum Center, and Mazzulla liked
articles._body: Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics were firing on all cylinders against the Charlotte Hornets on Friday night, and head coach Joe Mazzulla had nothing but praise for his star forward’s shot selection . Tatum poured in 34 points in Boston’s 119-80 blowout win at Spectrum Center, and Mazzulla liked everything he saw. “I thought every shot he took was a great shot,” Mazzulla said, via Mack Baltes . It is hard to argue with that assessment. Tatum was efficient from start to finish, shooting 9-of-16 from the field, 5-of-8 from deep and a perfect 11-of-11 from the free-throw line. He also stuffed the stat sheet with eight rebounds and nine assists, finishing a team-best plus-36 in the rout. Tatum was not the only one getting it done. The Celtics racked up 33 assists and knocked down 24 3-pointers on 54.5% shooting from beyond the arc. Mazzulla credited both the passers and the shooters for the ball movement. “Yeah, I mean, it’s twofold, right? You can’t have an assist unless the shot goes in. So, I like the fact that we shared it,” Mazzulla said, via Steve Reed of The Associated Press . Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla on his team having 33 assists. pic.twitter.com/S6JoIMhDyC — Steve Reed (@SteveReedAP) November 7, 2026 Boston set the tone early, racing out to a 40-20 lead after the first quarter and leading by as many as 46 points. The Celtics never trailed in the game. Derrick White added 18 points on 6-of-10 shooting, including 4-of-6 from deep , while Payton Pritchard chipped in 12 points and five assists. Boston’s bench also outscored Charlotte’s 49-47, with Luka Garza and Mitchell Robinson each grabbing seven rebounds. Charlotte, meanwhile, struggled mightily, shooting just 29.3% from the field and 22% from 3-point range. Naz Reid scored 14 points for the Hornets in the loss. The performance was another encouraging sign for Tatum, who returned from a torn Achilles tendon on March 6 of last season . He sat out Boston’s win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday for rest but looked fully refreshed against Charlotte. The win improved the Celtics to 7-2 on the season, while the Hornets fell to 3-7. Boston has now won seven of its last eight games, with the lone loss coming against the Houston Rockets. Tatum and the Celtics will look to keep rolling when they visit the Bucks on Sunday. articles.title: Skip Bayless blasts 76ers star LeBron James for poor play vs. Cavs: ‘LeBricks!’
articles.summary: During his homecoming to Cleveland, former Cavaliers superstar LeBron James endured a night he would rather forget. The Philadelphia 76ers suffered a heavy 119-95 loss to Cleveland, ending James’ impressive scoring streak in the city. His frustrating performance also drew criticism from pop
articles._body: During his homecoming to Cleveland, former Cavaliers superstar LeBron James endured a night he would rather forget. The Philadelphia 76ers suffered a heavy 119-95 loss to Cleveland, ending James’ impressive scoring streak in the city. His frustrating performance also drew criticism from popular sports analyst Skip Bayless, who took a shot at the veteran with a nickname. Following Philadelphia’s blowout loss, Bayless shared his reaction on social media, criticizing James for his shooting struggles and lack of offensive production. “Sixers shockingly blown out in LeBron’s return to Cleveland,” Bayless wrote. “Nobody could make a shot but LeBron (8 pts/6 turnovers), again slumping from 3. Last season 31.7%, 3rd worst in the NBA. This year 22% (6-27 after 0-4 tonight). LeBricks!” James began the night with his customary chalk toss in Cleveland, recreating a familiar pregame ritual as he returned to his home state of Ohio for the first time as a Sixers player. However, what initially appeared to be an emotional homecoming ultimately turned into a disappointing evening for Philadelphia. James finished his first game in Cleveland wearing a Sixers uniform with eight points, eight rebounds, three assists and six turnovers while shooting 3-of-12 from the field. It marked just the 11th time in his 1,630 career regular-season games that he finished with fewer than 10 points. James was visibly frustrated with Philadelphia’s performance throughout the night, particularly the team’s inability to generate consistent offense. After the game, the veteran took accountability for his own struggles. “Every game has its own challenges,” James said. “Offensively, as a group, our offense was not good at all, and I know I damn sure wasn’t good at all. I’m looking at the film and trying to get better from there.” Cleveland successfully defended its home court against Philadelphia while securing its first NBA Cup victory. Ultimately, Cleveland’s balanced scoring attack and defensive intensity proved too difficult for the visiting Philadelphia team to overcome. articles._body: Clemson will be without another dynamic offensive weapon when the Tigers face Syracuse on Saturday, as wide receiver Tyler Brown has officially been ruled out of the contest . The senior had been listed as questionable on Wednesday and Thursday before his status was confirmed on Friday’s ACC availability report. The specific injury was not disclosed. Brown’s absence adds to Clemson’s growing list of offensive injuries. He joins starting center Harris Sewell, running back Gideon Davidson and left guard Elyjah Thurmon on the unavailable list. Reserve wide receiver Gordon Sellars III has also been ruled out. The 21-year-old has been one of the Tigers’ leading offensive contributors this season, ranking second on the team with 36 receptions for 332 yards. He has also recorded five rushing attempts for 83 yards and a touchdown. Brown continues to flourish in Clemson’s recent games. He finished with five catches for 74 yards in last week’s 36-24 win over Florida State. He also complied eight receptions for 62 yards against Virginia Tech and hauled in 10 passes for 76 yards versus then-No. 4 Miami on October 3. His absence creates another challenge for freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds, who has relied on Brown as a dependable receiving option in recent weeks. The Tigers could turn to backup slot receiver Juju Preston, who has seven receptions for 49 yards this season. Freshman Naeem Burroughs is another possibility after logging two catches for 19 yards. Burroughs played just one snap against the Seminoles, while Preston did not appear in that game. The ramifications of Brown’s absence are amplified by the sustained excellence he has demonstrated throughout his Clemson career. After garnering 52 catches for 531 yards and four touchdowns as a freshman in 2023, injuries restricted him to six games and five receptions for 30 yards in 2024. He returned last season and amassed 22 catches for 191 yards. The Tigers enter Saturday’s encounter versus the Orange as a 2.5-point favorite. articles.title: Mavericks’ Dusty May gives props to ‘winning player’ Morez Johnson Jr. for big game vs. Jazz
articles.summary: The Dallas Mavericks dominated the struggling Utah Jazz en route to a 112-100 win in the NBA Cup. The game was a memorable one for Morez Johnson Jr., who had a breakout game as he notched the first double-double of his career with 13 points and 17 rebounds, including an impressive 10 offensive bo
articles._body: The Dallas Mavericks dominated the struggling Utah Jazz en route to a 112-100 win in the NBA Cup. The game was a memorable one for Morez Johnson Jr., who had a breakout game as he notched the first double-double of his career with 13 points and 17 rebounds, including an impressive 10 offensive boards. Mavericks head coach Dusty May, who also coached Johnson when they were at Michigan, was full of praise for the rookie . May noted that after a slow start in part due to a lower leg injury during preseason, Johnson is getting back to his best physically. “The first glimpse was in San Antonio when Naji (Marshall) threw the lob, and ‘Rez went up and got it. Even though he didn’t finish it, that was the first glimpse when the staff said, ‘Okay, his athleticism is almost back,'” May said. May also applauded the fact that Johnson can still put up big numbers despite not getting his number called on many plays. “His energy, his effort. He’s a winning player, and for a guy you don’t call any plays for, if you can get him 13 and 17 without calling any plays for him. We need those types of glue guys,” May added. Heading into the game, Johnson was averaging 7.4 points and 3.1 rebounds in eight games, all off the Mavs bench. But as his performance against Utah showed, the No. 9 pick in this year’s draft of capable of a lot more. His game figures to be a nice complement to Cooper Flagg, who has the skillset of a potential top-10 player . As Johnson continues to get back to peak fitness, he figures to provide some much-needed energy and physicality to the Mavs in the frontcourt. articles.title: LeBron James weighs in on ‘easy money’ reaction to warm Cleveland welcome from Cavs fans

Despite turning down a reunion with the Cavaliers in free agency this sum
articles._body: LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers left Cleveland with a loss on Friday night, but the four-time champion still walked away appreciating the warm welcome he received from Cavs fans in his first visit with his new team. Despite turning down a reunion with the Cavaliers in free agency this summer, James was greeted with his customary cheers when he was introduced at Rocket Arena. After the game, he was asked whether the reception pleasantly surprised him . “At the end of the day, nothing can get as worse as December 2nd, 2010 from a reception standpoint. So I’ve seen the near depths of hell when it comes to reception here all the way to the heavens above. So anything in between is easy money,” James said, via ESPN’s Kris Rhim. LeBron James on whether he was pleasantly surprised by the warm reception after choosing not to return to Cleveland in Free agency: “At the end of the day, nothing can get as worse as December 2nd, 2010 from a reception standpoint. So I've seen the near depths of hell when it… pic.twitter.com/OYYJMUpBmE — Kris Rhim (@krisrhim1) November 7, 2026 That date needs no introduction for Cleveland fans. It marked James’ first game back in Cleveland after leaving for the Miami Heat in free agency with “The Decision,” and the crowd let him have it with a barrage of boos and taunts. James responded with 38 points in just three quarters of a 118-90 Heat rout. The relationship was eventually repaired. James returned to the Cavaliers in 2014 and delivered the city’s long-awaited championship in 2016, leading Cleveland back from a 3-1 deficit against the Golden State Warriors in the NBA Finals. Since then, he has been showered with cheers on just about every trip back to Northeast Ohio, whether with the Los Angeles Lakers or now the Sixers. This summer, James admitted that going back to Cleveland was “in consideration, for sure” before he ultimately chose Philadelphia on a two-year deal. The homecoming did not go as planned on the court. T he Cavs rolled to a 119-95 win in an NBA Cup matchup , as James finished with just eight points on 3-of-12 shooting and six turnovers. The rough night snapped his streak of 396 consecutive regular-season games with double-digit scoring in Cleveland. Joel Embiid also struggled, going 0-of-9 from the field . VJ Edgecombe led Philadelphia with 19 points, while Donovan Mitchell scored 23 and Evan Mobley added 22 for the Cavs. The loss snapped the Sixers’ five-game winning streak and dropped them to 8-2. Philadelphia will look to get back on track against the Chicago Bulls on Sunday. articles.title: 76ers’ LeBron James reveals what went wrong in NBA Cup loss to Cavs
articles.summary: LeBron James had not scored fewer than 10 points in Cleveland across 396 consecutive regular-season games until Friday’s disappointing loss against the Cleveland Cavaliers. Following the loss, James opened up about Philadelphia’s struggles and explained what went wrong during the NBA
articles._body: LeBron James had not scored fewer than 10 points in Cleveland across 396 consecutive regular-season games until Friday’s disappointing loss against the Cleveland Cavaliers. Following the loss, James opened up about Philadelphia’s struggles and explained what went wrong during the NBA Cup matchup. Speaking to reporters in the locker room after the game, James weighed in on the team’s offensive shortcomings while taking responsibility for some of Philadelphia’s mistakes. “I definitely did not feel a good rhythm offensively,” James said. “We didn’t look like much offensively. We had a couple spurts. We were able to cut it, I think, to three in the third quarter, but too many turnovers on my part. I didn’t feel any rhythm offensively.” The Cavaliers’ defense completely neutralized Philadelphia’s biggest stars on Friday night. During his homecoming to Cleveland , James and Joel Embiid combined for just 14 points. Embiid finished with only six points on 0-of-9 shooting from the field, along with seven rebounds and two turnovers. James also struggled to make an offensive impact, recording eight points on 3-of-11 shooting while committing six turnovers. The atmosphere before the game was much more welcoming for James, as he received the familiar cheers from the Cleveland crowd when his name was announced in the starting lineup. LeBron also reflected on the warm reception he received from Cavaliers fans on Friday night. “At the end of the day, nothing can get as worse as December 2nd, 2010 from a reception standpoint,” he said. “So I’ve seen the near depths of hell when it comes to reception here all the way to the heavens above. So anything in between is easy money.” The loss moves Philadelphia to 8-2 on the season while bringing its five-game winning streak to an end. The Sixers will now aim to put the disappointing loss behind them and get back on track in their upcoming matchup against the Chicago Bulls. Even so, the Sixers star insists he has not lost faith in himself. Embiid went 0-of-9 from the field in Friday’s 119-95 loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers, in
articles._body: Joel Embiid and the Philadelphia 76ers had a night to forget in Cleveland , and the big man’s shooting struggles hit a new low in the process. Even so, the Sixers star insists he has not lost faith in himself. Embiid went 0-of-9 from the field in Friday’s 119-95 loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers, including 0-of-2 from beyond the arc. That dropped him to just 3-of-28 from 3-point range on the season, according to ESPN’s Dave McMenamin. All six of his points came at the free-throw line, where he went a perfect 6-of-6, and he added seven rebounds and two blocks. After the game, Embiid opened up about how tough the slump has been. “I believe in myself, but you know, when you’re in these moments and nothing is going in, whether it’s 3, big range, everything, layups, it’s hard to just not look at yourself and be down,” Embiid said, via McMenamin. “But yeah, you gotta keep going and stay up and keep walking.” Joel Embiid with some honest reflection on his shooting woes after his 3-point total dropped to 3-for-28 for the season after another 0-for-2 night: “I believe in myself but when you’re in these moments and nothing is going in … it’s hard not to look at yourself and be down” pic.twitter.com/dH94TFpgvJ — Dave McMenamin (@mcten) November 7, 2026 It is a far cry from the version of Embiid who has made the 3-pointer a real weapon over the years. He shot 33.3% from deep last season, and head coach Nick Nurse has encouraged him in the past to take more threes , not fewer. The shooting woes have become a running theme for Embiid early in the season. Just two nights earlier, he went 0-of-3 from deep in a win over the Detroit Pistons and joked afterward that it “might’ve been the last three I ever take.” He still found ways to contribute in that one, posting 26 points and 15 rebounds. Friday was a rough night for Philadelphia as a whole, as the Sixers never led by more than two points. The Sixers shot 36.5% from the field and 25% from 3-point range, while LeBron James struggled in his return to Cleveland with eight points on 3-of-12 shooting and six turnovers. VJ Edgecombe led the way with 19 points, and Tyrese Maxey added 17. Donovan Mitchell paced the Cavs with 23 points, while Evan Mobley chipped in 22. The loss snapped Philadelphia’s five-game winning streak and dropped the team to 8-2. Embiid and the Sixers will look to bounce back when they visit the Chicago Bulls on Sunday. But they didn’t come away empty-handed. Pete Crow-Armstrong is poised to win the MVP, and on Friday, they were named to the National League Gold G
articles._body: The Chicago Cubs finished the season on a sour note. They exited the playoffs early , falling to the San Diego Padres in the NL Wild Card series. But they didn’t come away empty-handed. Pete Crow-Armstrong is poised to win the MVP , and on Friday, they were named to the National League Gold Glove team, per Talkin Baseball. An honor they have now won back-to-back years. Chicago Cubs have won the National League Team Gold Glove! pic.twitter.com/1JgfS2UjeX — Talkin' Baseball (@TalkinBaseball_) November 7, 2026 A couple of individual players also won Gold Gloves. Crow-Armstrong won his second straight Gold Glove in center field, and third baseman Alex Bregman won his first as a Cub. Crow-Armstrong led the league with 26 Outs Above Average. Additionally, he finished with 10 Defensive Runs Saved. Overall, Crow-Armstrong finished with a .280 batting average, 45 home runs, 107 RBIs, and 41 stolen bases. If that wasn’t enough, Crow-Armstrong joined the 40/40 club . Bregman finished with 72 putouts, 225 assists, and only 5 errors. He also finished with a .983 field percentage. Moreover, Bregman became the first third baseman in Cubs history to win the Gold Glove since Ron Santo. Meanwhile, Ian Happ, Dansby Swanson, and Seiya Suzuki were nominated for Gold Gloves. Suzuki was a first-time finalist, and Swanson won a Gold Glove in 2023. Happ came in, winning four consecutive Gold Gloves before losing to Jackson Chourio of the champion Milwaukee Brewers. The Cubs finished the season at 89-73. After an exceptional start, they hit a mid-season slump due to injuries and pitching inconsistencies. Then, they came back later in the year. In the end, the Cubs led the league with 115 Outs Above Average and 73 Defensive Runs Saved. The post Cubs win National League Team Gold Glove appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Last-minute fantasy football streaming options for NFL Week 9: D/ST
articles.summary: Streaming defenses in fantasy football is often about identifying the right matchup rather than simply chasing the biggest names. Even a normally reliable unit can become a liability when facing an explosive offense. On the flip side, a defense coming off a disappointing performance can quickly r
articles._body: Streaming defenses in fantasy football is often about identifying the right matchup rather than simply chasing the biggest names. Even a normally reliable unit can become a liability when facing an explosive offense. On the flip side, a defense coming off a disappointing performance can quickly regain fantasy value against a more favorable opponent. Week 9 presents a few interesting situations for managers searching for a defensive edge. With sacks, turnovers, and points allowed all capable of swinging a weekly matchup, choosing the right D/ST could make a meaningful difference. Seattle Seahawks (vs. ARI) Mandatory Credit: Amber Searls-Imagn Images The Seattle Seahawks’ defense had a night to forget in Week 8. Fantasy football managers who started the unit against the Chicago Bears were probably left disappointed . Seattle recorded just one sack and recovered one fumble while surrendering 34 points. It was an uncharacteristically poor performance. The Bears managed to outplay Seattle on both sides of the ball. They put the Seahawks in a difficult position throughout the contest. Allowing 34 points is obviously not the kind of result fantasy managers want from their D/ST. Still, one difficult matchup should not erase the value of a defense that has shown it can deliver more productive performances. Fortunately, Seattle gets an opportunity to respond against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 9. This matchup could help the Seahawks restore their fantasy appeal. The Seahawks are worth considering as a streaming option, particularly for managers who need a bounce-back candidate. Their Week 8 performance was concerning, but the matchup gives them a legitimate opportunity to deliver a much better fantasy result. Do not let one ugly outing completely sour you on this defense. Houston Texans (@ LAC) The Houston Texans are a risky option for fantasy football managers heading into Week 9 , particularly with a road matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers on deck. Back in Week 7, Houston surrendered 27 points and 420 total yards while recording three sacks. Although the sack production provided some fantasy value, the overall defensive performance was far from dominant. Houston has the talent to make life difficult for opposing offenses. However, the unit has not offered enough consistency to become an automatic fantasy start. Giving up a ton of yards is particularly concerning. The Texans will need to generate consistent pressure and find ways to force turnovers if they hope to deliver a worthwhile fantasy performance. The three sacks from their previous outing offer at least some encouragement. Still, managers should not mistake that production for a guarantee of success. Things should turn a corner against the struggling 0-7 Chargers, though. Managers in deeper leagues should consider the Texans if the waiver wire is particularly thin. Denver Broncos (@ CAR) The Denver Broncos did not produce the kind of fantasy football performance managers might have expected against the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 8. However, their defensive showing deserves more credit than the numbers initially suggest. Denver allowed 24 points and 399 total yards in a 28-24 victory. They also recorded two sacks but failed to force a turnover. Patrick Mahomes still managed to throw for 321 yards and three touchdowns. That naturally limited the Broncos’ fantasy output. For managers expecting a dominant D/ST performance, the lack of turnovers was particularly frustrating. However, the final moments of the game offered a reminder of why Denver remains one of the better defensive units in football. The Broncos held the Chiefs scoreless in the fourth quarter. They ultimately stopped Kansas City at the one-yard line to preserve the victory. Denver now heads into a Week 9 matchup against the Carolina Panthers. The Broncos’ ability to make critical stops gives them a solid foundation. Yes, their recent performance was not spectacular from a fantasy perspective. That said, managers should not mistake a relatively quiet week against Kansas City for a reason to abandon this unit. New York Giants (@ PHI) Credit: John Jones-Imagn Images The New York Giants could be a sneaky streaming option heading into their Week 9 matchup against a struggling and injury-riddled Philadelphia Eagles squad. New York’s most recent defensive performance came in Week 7 against the Texans. The Giants allowed 21 points and 237 total yards while recording just one sack. The Giants also failed to force a turnover. Those numbers hardly establish New York as an elite fantasy defense. However, this week’s opponent presents a different kind of opportunity. Philadelphia has struggled to find consistency. Its growing injury concerns could make life even more difficult for its offense. That creates an opening for the Giants to generate pressure and potentially force numerous mistakes. Of course, managers should remain realistic. The Giants have not demonstrated enough consistency. They also still need to prove they can capitalize on favorable matchups. However, with Philadelphia struggling, New York is worth a look in deeper leagues and as a speculative streaming option. Final Takeaway Seattle is an intriguing bounce-back candidate against Arizona. Denver remains a viable option despite its quiet fantasy outing against Kansas City. Houston and the Giants are gambles. When choosing your Week 9 D/ST , prioritize the matchup and the potential for sacks and turnovers. articles._body: The Oklahoma City Thunder desperately needed players on the roster to step up following the injuries to Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, and Chet Holmgren. Thankfully, AJ Mitchell has come to the rescue. The third year guard out of the University of Santa Barbara had a strong second season with the Thunder in the 2025-26 season, but has taken his game to the next level with his increased opportunity in his third season. During Friday night’s contest between the Thunder and the Memphis Grizzlies atop the Western Conference, Mitchell popped off for a career-high 35 points in just over 30 minutes of play, adding in five assists while shooting 14-of-20 from the field and 4-of-7 from three. The Thunder defeated the Grizzlies, 128-97, in Memphis, as Shai Gilgeous-Alexander poured in 28 points with three rebounds and four assists while Jared McCain added 21 points, five rebounds, and four steals. It’s the fifth time in six games since becoming a full-time starter that Mitchell has recorded at least 20 points and the third time he’s scored at least 29 points. The Thunder will have a quick turnaround from this game as they travel back home to Oklahoma City, where they’ll host Trae Young, Anthony Davis, AJ Dybantsa, and the Washington Wizards on Saturday night. The Thunder have bounced back from the injuries, now boasting a 7-2 record and having won three consecutive games heading into Saturday night’s contest. Unfortunately for Timberwolves big man Joan Beringer, he was on the receiving end of the wrong kind of slam to the face. Per ClutchPoints’ Brett Siegel, Beringe
articles._body: The Minnesota Timberwolves’ NBA Cup clash against the New Orleans Pelicans featured an impressive slam from Jaden McDaniels. Unfortunately for Timberwolves big man Joan Beringer, he was on the receiving end of the wrong kind of slam to the face. Per ClutchPoints’ Brett Siegel, Beringer suffered a nasal fracture and will not return to the game. Beringer got an elbow to the face that saw him bleeding from the nose while shooting two free throws. He had to leave to clean the blood off, but upon the diagnosis of a nasal fracture, he was subsequently ruled out. He finished the game with two points and three rebounds in seven minutes of action. The Timberwolves’ first-round pick last year, Beringer has been Rudy Gobert’s primary backup at center this season after Naz Reid’s departure. He’s averaging 6.2 points and 6.9 rebounds in 17.6 minutes over nine games. It remains to be seen whether Beringer will miss significant time with his nasal injury. When he does return to the court, he will likely have to wear a mask to protect his face. If Beringer is sidelined, the Wolves will find themselves quite thin in the frontcourt. Veteran Trey Lyles will likely step in to back up Gobert. The 31-year-old, who is in his first season in Minnesota, is averaging 6.2 points and 3.1 rebounds in 17 minutes off the Wolves’ bench this season. After the Pelicans game, the Timberwolves will be back in action on Sunday to take on the struggling Utah Jazz to start a long eight-game home stand. articles.title: 76ers star LeBron James breaks 396-game streak in NBA Cup loss to Cavs
articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers’ hot winning streak came to an end on Friday following a disappointing 119-95 loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers. The loss also marked an unfortunate night for LeBron James, as the NBA legend saw a remarkable personal streak come to an end on the Cavaliers’ home fl
articles._body: The Philadelphia 76ers’ hot winning streak came to an end on Friday following a disappointing 119-95 loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers. The loss also marked an unfortunate night for LeBron James, as the NBA legend saw a remarkable personal streak come to an end on the Cavaliers’ home floor. According to ESPN’s Dave McMenamin, the performance ended an extraordinary run of consecutive double-digit scoring games for James in Cleveland. The longtime NBA superstar had maintained that streak for 396 regular-season appearances before Friday’s disappointing NBA Cup outing. “Tonight broke a streak of 396 straight regular season games in double-digit scoring in Cleveland for James. It was also his third game vs. CLE in the calendar year with 5 or fewer FGM and 5 or more turnovers,” McMenamin wrote. During his return to Cleveland as a member of the Los Angeles Lakers on December 21, 2018, James finished with 34 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists while shooting 11-of-20 from the field. King James also enjoyed a memorable homecoming with the Miami Heat on December 2, 2010. The four-time MVP recorded 38 points, five rebounds and eight assists on 15-of-25 shooting. However, his latest return to Cleveland as a 76ers star produced a completely different outcome. James managed only eight points on 3-of-12 shooting. He also added eight rebounds and three assists. The loss also brought Philadelphia’s five-game winning streak to an end, dropping the Sixers from their 8-1 start. Philadelphia’s other key players also struggled to deliver their usual production. Joel Embiid endured a difficult night, finishing with six points and seven rebounds while missing all nine of his field-goal attempts. Tyrese Maxey contributed 17 points and four assists but struggled with his shooting, going 5-of-15 from the floor. Jaylen Brown led the Sixers with 20 points, five rebounds and five assists. VJ Edgecombe provided another bright spot for Philadelphia, recording 19 points while shooting efficiently from the field. articles.title: Eagles release Dameon Pierce from IR with injury settlement
articles.summary: Dameon Pierce’s short-lived tenure with the Philadelphia Eagles has officially come to an end. After initially placing the veteran running back on injured reserve, Philadelphia has now decided to part ways with him through an injury settlement. According to NBC Sports Philadelphia’s D
articles._body: Dameon Pierce’s short-lived tenure with the Philadelphia Eagles has officially come to an end. After initially placing the veteran running back on injured reserve , Philadelphia has now decided to part ways with him through an injury settlement. According to NBC Sports Philadelphia’s Dave Zangaro, the Eagles reached an injury settlement with Pierce on Friday, officially releasing him from injured reserve and allowing him to become a free agent. “Per the NFL’s transaction wire: The Eagles reached an injury settlement with Dameon Pierce so he’s off IR and is now a free agent,” Zangaro wrote. Philadelphia’s decision comes after Pierce struggled to establish himself as a reliable contributor in the team’s backfield. Despite receiving an opportunity amid the Eagles’ growing injury concerns at the running back position, the former Houston Texans standout was unable to make a substantial impact during his brief time with the franchise. The Eagles initially signed Pierce during the offseason, expecting the former fourth-round selection to provide valuable depth behind starting running back Saquon Barkley. However, his opportunities in Philadelphia were limited to just three appearances. Pierce finished his brief Eagles tenure with 96 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 37 carries and also contributed seven receptions for 14 yards on 11 targets. Pierce delivered his most productive performance against the Dallas Cowboys in Week 7, finishing with 14 carries for 47 rushing yards and a touchdown in Philadelphia’s loss. However, his outing ended prematurely after he suffered an injury during the fourth quarter of the game, eventually forcing the Eagles to place him on injured reserve. Now, Philadelphia’s decision to reach an injury settlement provides Pierce with an opportunity to pursue a fresh start elsewhere in the league. Rather than remaining on the Eagles’ injured reserve list, the veteran is now free to explore potential opportunities with other teams. VALPARAISO TO WIN THE GAME AGAINST PURDUE AT THE BUZZER IN DOUBLE OT pic.twitter.com/V0QefICyG8 — SportsCenter (@SportsCenter) November 7, 2026 With four seconds left in the game, Valpo inbounded the ball from the opposite baseline. Purdue looked on course to get the win in the first overtime as they led by three with four seconds left. But Rakim Chaney was able to get the offensive rebound from his own missed free throw and hit a 3-pointer to force a second OT. Chaney, a true freshman, led the way for the Beacons with 35 points, eight rebounds and six assists. McNair added 17 points as Valpo improved to 2-0 on the season. For Purdue, Daniel Jacobson paced the team with 28 points and 10 rebounds. The Boilermakers struggled with their shooting all game long, going 38% from the field and 5-of-28 (18%) on 3-pointers. The Bruins found themselves ranked highly in the latest AP Top 25 Poll , but there is plenty of trepidation going on the road to face what should be a fired-up Gophers team that scored a big upset over the Michigan Wolverines earlier this year. There is a great vibe surrounding Chesney’s squad, but a very good vibe in Minneapolis which should make for an exciting, and physical, game in Big Ten country that will challenge the Bruins in a new way. articles.summary: LSU tight end Trey’Dez Green’s name surfaced on the SEC availability report Friday for the first time this week, as he was listed as questionable for Saturday’s matchup against Alabama. His late addition raises concerns after he returned from injury in the Tigers’ previous
articles._body: LSU tight end Trey’Dez Green’s name surfaced on the SEC availability report Friday for the first time this week, as he was listed as questionable for Saturday’s matchup against Alabama. His late addition raises concerns after he returned from injury in the Tigers’ previous game. The 20-year-old missed time after suffering a leg injury versus Ole Miss on September 19, when a tackler’s helmet struck his right knee. Although his ligaments were sprained rather than torn, he has continued wearing a brace around the knee. Green made his comeback in LSU’s October 24 game against the Auburn Tigers, finishing with five receptions for 50 yards and a touchdown in the 38-17 road win. He also spoke to reporters on Tuesday, indicating that he was continuing to make physical progress. Through four games this season, Green has accumulated 19 catches for 272 yards and two touchdowns. He has developed into a go-to option for quarterback Sam Leavitt, who has described the tight end as his “safety blanket.” Green is the only Tigers player listed as questionable for the upcoming contest. Linebacker Whit Weeks remains doubtful, while his younger brother, Zach Weeks, was removed from Friday’s report after previously carrying a questionable designation. Safety Dashawn Spears, wide receiver Phillip Wright and linebacker Charles Ross remain out with season-ending injuries. Freshman defensive tackle Richard Anderson is also unavailable after missing the Auburn game. The Crimson Tide, meanwhile, received encouraging updates on their injury situation. Wide receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams and starting center Racin Delgatty were upgraded to probable, alongside defensive lineman Terrance Green. Offensive lineman William Sanders, running back EJ Crowell and defensive back Zabien Brown remain questionable. Both teams enter the showdown following Week 9 byes and victories in Week 8. LSU has won two consecutive games, while Alabama defeated Texas A&M to end its two-game losing streak. Saturday’s clash is scheduled for a 3:30 p.m. ET kickoff at Tiger Stadium, with the final availability report expected 90 minutes before the game begins. He brought a gun into a training facility after an altercation with teammate JC Latham. But now, the Chicago Bears are snatching him up. On Friday, it was reported that the Bears will schedule a workout for Elliott next week, per Jordan Schutlz of The Schultz Report. Sources: The #Bears will workout former #Titans DT Jordan Elliott next week. Tennessee HC Robert Saleh has been an advocate for Elliott, who’s made 65 career starts while amassing 159 tackles, 11 TFLs and 5 sacks. https://t.co/3aHmhmdo1y pic.twitter.com/LexIrCRlXs — Jordan Schultz (@Schultz_Report) November 7, 2026 A big factor in giving Elliott a try is that the Bears need interior defensive depth. Ironically, Chicago scored big with Jeffrey Simmons , thanks to the Tennessee Titans. Overall, Elliott has started in 65 games and has 159 tackles to his name. His possibility of joining Chicago comes at a time when they are doing pretty well. They are coming off a big 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks on Monday and currently stand at 6-2. Furthermore, Chicago is right behind the Minnesota Vikings in the NFC North. Plus, Caleb Williams is coming back strong after a recent hamstring injury scare. On the flip side, the Titans are severely struggling with a 1-7 record and dead last in the AFC South. Overall, Elliott finishes his time with the Titans with two tackles and nine assists. He previously played for the Cleveland Browns from 2020 to 2023. Afterward, he was with the San Francisco 49ers from 2024 to 2025. The impressive play of Zion Williamson has been key to the Pelicans’ recent success. Williamson is usually on the business end of highlight reel slam dunks. But against the Minneso
articles._body: The New Orleans Pelicans are rolling at the moment , winning four games in a row after losing their first four. The impressive play of Zion Williamson has been key to the Pelicans’ recent success. Williamson is usually on the business end of highlight reel slam dunks. But against the Minnesota Timberwolves, Zion turned provider for Trey Murphy III as the two combined on an impressive halfcourt alley-oop . Zion Williamson with a HALF-COURT alley oop to Trey Murphy for the slam pic.twitter.com/5XtCQd5ORe — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) November 7, 2026 While bringing the ball up the court, Zion spotted an open Murphy heading toward the rim. He then produced a perfect pass to his Pelicans teammate, who skied up and unleashed a fierce throwdown that Zion would be proud of. Williamson came into the game averaging a team-leading 21.5 points and 5.1 rebounds per game while shooting 61% from the field. However, he’s averaging just 2.6 assists per game, his lowest total since his rookie year. But he already surpassed his average against the Wolves with three assists by halftime. Murphy, on the other hand, has gotten off to a somewhat disappointing start. After back-to-back seasons averaging over 21 points per game, he is scoring only 15 points per game over his first seven appearances this season. Granted, he has been listed on the team’s injury report in recent games, including for this game against Minnesota. Moreover, the return of Dejounte Murray after missing most of last season has taken up some of those shot attempts. With the Pelicans finally at full strength, this is their chance to show what they can really do. Williamson will be crucial in leading the charge, and so far at least, he is rising up to the occasion. Flo Milli Wins Dismissal of Copyright Lawsuit Over ‘Never Lose Me’ Beat Sample
articles.summary: A judge ruled that the man who brought the claims did not technically own a beat sampled in the 2023 hit.
articles._body: A judge threw out copyright claims over Flo Milli ’s 2023 hit “Never Lose Me” after ruling that the man bringing the lawsuit does not technically own a beat sampled in the track. The Friday (Nov. 6) court ruling, obtained and first reported by Billboard , dismissed the lawsuit without any opportunity to amend. But the case is not over for good; an attorney for the plaintiff said they intend to appeal. Related Flo Milli Hit With Copyright Lawsuit Over Hit Single ‘Never Lose Me’ Michael Sanft, Attorney Who Represented Keffe D in 2Pac Murder Trial, Dies at 54 Kenny MacPherson, Veteran Music Publisher and Big Deal Music Co-Founder, Dies at 71 The case was brought last year by Shamar Deal, a Baltimore-based artist who purchased a beat called “Youu” on the rap instrumental marketplace Traktrain in 2019. Deal said that after he paid $200 for a 10-year exclusive license, producer Gerreaux Katana wrongly turned around and relicensed the beat to Babyface Ray and 42 Dugg for their 2023 song “Ron Artest.” Flo Milli then sampled “Ron Artest” on “Never Lose Me,” which peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard Hot 100. Deal sued all three rappers for copyright infringement. On Friday, however, Judge André Birotte Jr. found that Deal does not actually own the rights to “Youu.” That’s because copyright law requires all exclusive licenses to be signed by both parties — and Traktrain never got Katana’s signature to sell the beat to Deal. According to Deal, the fact that Katana uploaded the beat to Traktrain and accepted his $200 should be enough to validate the license. But Judge Birotte said there’s no room for ambiguity here. He quoted a decades-old appellate ruling on the topic: “The rule is really quite simple: If the copyright holder agrees to transfer ownership to another party, that party must get the copyright holder to sign a piece of paper saying so.” Related Buying Beats Online Is Common, Convenient and Risky The ruling highlights a potential pitfall of online instrumental marketplaces, which have become a common source of beats for aspiring rappers in recent years. As experts have previously told Billboard , casual licensing arrangements can later come back to haunt artists and producers in a business that relies on proper legal paperwork. Deal’s attorney, Larry Zerner , cited the prevalence of the online beat economy when telling Billboard on Friday that they “respectfully disagree” with Judge Birotte’s decision and plan to appeal it. “Shamar Deal paid for an exclusive license to this beat,” said Zerner. “The producer listed it for sale as an exclusive, set the price, took the money, and confirmed the sale in his own emails. Shamar also has a contract with the producer that confirms all of these facts. That’s how thousands of independent artists buy beats online every single day, and they deserve to know that the licenses they pay for will hold up. We’re confident the Ninth Circuit will see it that way.” David Given , a lawyer representing Babyface Ray and his distributor EMPIRE, told Billboard on Friday, “Our clients are grateful for the court’s carefully reasoned decision dismissing the case for copyright infringement against them.” Reps for Flo Milli and 42 Dugg did not immediately return requests for comment on the ruling.
