Last-minute fantasy football streaming options for NFL Week 9: Tight End
articles.summary: Finding a reliable tight end on the waiver wire can be one of the toughest challenges in fantasy football, especially this late in the season. With so few players at the position delivering consistent production, managers often have to balance recent performances, target volume, and favorable mat
articles._body: Finding a reliable tight end on the waiver wire can be one of the toughest challenges in fantasy football, especially this late in the season. With so few players at the position delivering consistent production, managers often have to balance recent performances, target volume, and favorable matchups when making their streaming decisions. Week 9 offers a few intriguing possibilities , including a couple of players whose recent struggles make them difficult to trust. Whether you need a temporary starter or are simply searching for some upside, these four tight ends deserve consideration before setting your lineup. Mike Gesicki, CIN (@ ATL) Sam Greene/The Enquirer / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Mike Gesicki delivered one of his most productive performances of the season in Week 8. He caught four of six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown during Cincinnati’s thrilling overtime victory over the Tennessee Titans. His production was particularly encouraging because it came in the Bengals’ first game since losing Erick All to a torn ACL. With All sidelined, Gesicki has an opportunity to occupy a more prominent role. His latest performance suggests he could capitalize on the increased responsibility. Gesicki has now found the end zone in all six games he has played this season. That kind of consistency is difficult to overlook. Of course, his four receptions against Tennessee do not necessarily guarantee a major increase in weekly volume. His Week 9 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons makes him an appealing option for managers searching for a tight end with some upside. Gesicki’s touchdown streak and expanded opportunity give him a reasonable floor for a streamer. Consider him a high-end TE2 with the potential to outperform. Juwan Johnson, NO (vs. CLE) Juwan Johnson is a considerably tougher sell heading into Week 9. After opening the season with promising production, he has experienced a significant downturn. He caught just one of three targets for seven yards in New Orleans’ loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 7. That continued a frustrating stretch that has made him increasingly difficult to trust in fantasy football lineups. Johnson has managed just five receptions for 23 yards over his last three games. His production has been almost nonexistent in two of those contests. That level of inconsistency is difficult to justify. The matchup against the Cleveland Browns could offer some hope. Still, Johnson needs to see more targets before fantasy managers can confidently consider him a viable streaming option. With Jordyn Tyson expected to return, Johnson could also face additional competition for opportunities in the Saints’ offense. Greg Dulcich, MIA (vs. DET) Greg Dulcich is quietly becoming an intriguing streaming candidate. That’s even if his Week 8 numbers were not particularly spectacular. He caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Miami’s loss to the Patriots. He matched Caleb Douglas’ receiving line exactly. The game also featured 43 total points, while Miami’s top four receivers averaged 43 receiving yards apiece. It was an unusual collection of coincidences. The more important takeaway, though, is that Dulcich continues to earn opportunities. He has recorded at least five targets and 37 receiving yards in each of his last three games. That consistency matters at tight end. Dulcich also gets an appealing matchup against the Detroit Lions in Week 9. Detroit has been one of the best matchups for opposing tight ends this season. He is not guaranteed to deliver a breakout outing, but his combination of steady targets and favorable opposition makes him one of the more attractive streaming options this week. Eli Raridon, NE (vs. GB) Eli Raridon had a frustrating afternoon in New England’s victory over the Miami Dolphins. he caught just one of four targets for five yards. The lack of production was disappointing. There is, however, one interesting detail worth monitoring. Setting aside throwaways, Raridon was the intended target on all of Drake Maye’s incompletions against Miami. That does suggest Raridon was involved in the quarterback’s progressions. More importantly for fantasy purposes, he has received at least four targets in three of his last four games. That kind of volume offers a reason not to completely dismiss him. A player consistently earning opportunities can eventually turn those chances into a more useful fantasy football performance. New England faces Green Bay in Week 9. He is worth monitoring in deeper leagues, but managers in standard formats should probably prioritize more established options. Final Takeaway Andrew Nelles-USA TODAY Network via Imagn Images Gesicki offers the clearest touchdown upside. Dulcich might be the most intriguing option based on recent target volume and matchup. Raridon and Johnson are deeper-league gambles. If you need a Week 9 tight end streamer , prioritize opportunity over reputation. articles.title: Hornets’ Brandon Miller exits Celtics clash with groin soreness
articles.summary: The Charlotte Hornets were already without Kon Knueppel against the Boston Celtics amid a hamstring problem. And the Hornets’ frontcourt got even thinner after Brandon Miller also went down during the game. Per ClutchPoints’ Brett Siegel, Miller will not return to the game after exiti
articles._body: The Charlotte Hornets were already without Kon Knueppel against the Boston Celtics amid a hamstring problem. And the Hornets’ frontcourt got even thinner after Brandon Miller also went down during the game. Per ClutchPoints’ Brett Siegel, Miller will not return to the game after exiting early due to right groin soreness. Miller left to the locker room midway through the second quarter with the Hornets already down big to Boston, 47-23. Prior to exiting, Miller had scored eight points on 3-of-10 shooting with two rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block in 14 minutes of action. Miller had been having a decent start to the season. He is averaging 22 points and 5.3 rebounds per game, both career-bests. However, he is in the midst of a significant shooting slump, hitting just 36% of his shots from the field and 26.7% on 3-pointers. With both Miller and Knueppel out, the Hornets are now down to Royce O’NEale, Tidjane Salaun and rookie Hannes Steinbach as their forwards. This groin issue is another unfortunate setback for Miller, who has had his share of injury concerns during his four-year NBA career. He has already undergone surgery to repair injuries in his right wrist and left shoulder. Nevertheless, the Hornets still signed Miller to a five-year, $209 million contract extension . They view him as one of their core pieces along with Knueppel to build around after trading away LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves. Hopefully for the 3-6 Hornets, Miller’s groin problem doesn’t end up being too serious and he can return to the lineup relatively soon. articles._body: One NFL insider didn’t hold back on the Dallas Cowboys trading Micah Parsons to the Green Bay Packers in 2025 given their ongoing struggles in the 2026 season. Dallas turned heads after taking a different direction with the star defender, sending him to Green Bay in exchange for Kenny Clark. The team ultimately failed to make the playoffs, even though Parsons missed most of the 2025 season due to injury. Insider Brian Baldinger made an appearance on Pardon My Take on Friday. He was critical of the holes in Dallas’ defense as he called them out for trading away Parsons, who played a big role in their past success of being in firm playoff contention when healthy. “They’re giving up these tremendous plays, these big plays outside of Quinnen Williams. You’re not getting any pass rush. Like they still miss Micah Parsons. Like it was still the dumbest thing they’ve ever done as an organization. Not after the second year, they should have just signed him up for a lifetime contract and not let them out of the building because you can go trade for all these guys: Rashawn Gary, draft Malachi Lawrence. You can do all this stuff. None of them are Micah Parsons,” Baldinger said. “They still miss Micah Parsons. It was the dumbest thing they’ve ever done as an organization” Baldy on the Cowboys still having defensive issues that can’t be fixed pic.twitter.com/l4EPbKNP8V — Pardon My Take (@PardonMyTake) November 6, 2026 What lies ahead for Cowboys this season The Cowboys have issues to address on the defensive side of the ball. If they want to make the playoffs, they must hash them in their upcoming games before this season turns into a disastrous one. Dallas has a 3-5 record this season, sitting at second place in the NFC East Division standings. They are above the Washington Commanders and the Philadelphia Eagles while trailing the New York Giants. In terms of the conference standings, they are 13th place. They lead over the Commanders and the New Orleans Saints while being under the Arizona Cardinals and the Atlanta Falcons. The Cowboys will continue preparations for their upcoming matchup this weekend, being on the road. They take on the Indianapolis Colts in Week 9 as kickoff commences on Nov. 8 at 1 p.m. ET. articles._body: The No. 10 Ole Miss football team is set to take on No. 2 Georgia in a big top-10 SEC showdown. However, the Rebels defense could be missing two key pieces against Georgia. Per Pete Nakos of On3, edge rusher Kam Franklin and linebacker Keaton Thomas are both game-time decisions. Franklin is third on the team with two sacks on the season along with 25 total tackles. Meanwhile, Thomas is the team’s leading tackler with 52 this season. Ole Miss’ defense is coming off a tremendous performance in their 45-15 win over Auburn. The Rebels run defense limited the Tigers to just 63 rushing yards on 2.3 yards per carry. This was a big bounce-back performance after getting torched for 207 yards on the ground in their 34-27 loss to Texas. Thomas was a tackling machine in that game, with eight total tackles (six solo). His potential absence would be a big blow for the Rebels defense against a Georgia ground game that is one of the most prolific in the nation. The Bulldogs are top 25 in both rushing yards per game (200.1, 24th) and rushing touchdowns (20, T-19) this season. Their top three running backs, Dwight Phillips Jr., Nate Frazier, and Bo Walker, are all averaging over six yards per carry this season. On the other side, Ole Miss will already be without leading rusher Kewan Lacy due to injury. The junior running back has not played since their loss to Texas. He has rushed for 388 yards with five touchdowns this season. The combination of Shekai Mills-Knight and Makhi Frazier made up for Lacy’s absence with a combined 127 yards on 33 carries. articles.title: Mariner’s Jason Kanzler hiring questioned by analysts
articles.summary: The Seattle Mariners went in a bold direction with their new manager, and not everyone is sold on the hire. Jason Kanzler has never managed at any level, and that lack of experience has some analysts questioning whether he is the right man for the job. At his introductory press conference this we
articles._body: The Seattle Mariners went in a bold direction with their new manager, and not everyone is sold on the hire. Jason Kanzler has never managed at any level, and that lack of experience has some analysts questioning whether he is the right man for the job. At his introductory press conference this week, the 36-year-old laid out his vision. “The brand of baseball that I’d like to see and be manifest in this identity is something akin to step on their throats. We want to win. We want to beat the other team,” Kanzler said. On “The Chris Rose Rotation,” former MLB infielder Trevor Plouffe weighed in on the hire, and he was not fully convinced. “I think this guy’s fantastic. A good baseball mind should be in the organization. I’d want him on my staff. Here’s my take. I don’t want young guys as a manager. I don’t. There’s a tendency for a young guy, and I deal with this myself. Maybe I’m projecting, but I do think it’s the truth. There’s a tendency to want to be friends with the guys,” Plouffe said. Mariners should have hired a manager with some experience Presented by @amazon pic.twitter.com/V67dWcp4lR — Chris Rose Sports (@ChrisRoseSports) November 6, 2026 “The Mariners, to me, don’t need a buddy-buddy. They need a, hey, man, let’s get this s**t right. It’s hard for a first-year guy to come in there and do that. I am in my veteran manager era. Give me a guy who’s going to just hold people accountable. We just saw it with Pat Murphy, dude.” That was a nod to the Milwaukee Brewers manager, who just won the World Series . “I’m not going to say that it can’t work because anything can work, but I’ll be more surprised if it works than if it doesn’t,” Rose said. Kanzler was most recently the Chicago Cubs’ director of player development. Before that, he spent five seasons with the Houston Astros , serving as a hitting coach on the 2022 World Series champions. His playing career topped out at High-A in the Minnesota Twins organization. The Mariners hired Kanzler to replace Dan Wilson after a 76-86 season , one of the most disappointing in franchise history. Former Astros manager Joe Espada was also a finalist for the job. Kanzler will have plenty of doubters to prove wrong when the 2027 season gets underway. The post Mariner’s Jason Kanzler hiring questioned by analysts appeared first on ClutchPoints .

He was a key retention for Lane Kiffin ahead of his first season at LSU and immediately made an impact in his first game back from injury last time out. Green did not appear on the Wednesday or Thursday availability reports prior to LSU’s Week 10 showdown against Alabama. He is the only Tigers player listed as questionable for the Tigers, while linebacker Whit Weeks came in as doubtful. articles.title: Bears’ stadium relocation gets more clarity after Roger Goodell meeting
articles.summary: The Chicago Bears have been in pursuit of a new stadium for years and they may finally be getting close to a positive resolution that meets their needs. Illinois governor J.B. Pritzker met with NFL commissioner Roger Goodell as well as Bears officials Kevin Warren and George McCaskey regarding a
articles._body: The Chicago Bears have been in pursuit of a new stadium for years and they may finally be getting close to a positive resolution that meets their needs. Illinois governor J.B. Pritzker met with NFL commissioner Roger Goodell as well as Bears officials Kevin Warren and George McCaskey regarding a path towards building a new stadium in Arlington Heights, a Chicago suburb in Illinois. The Bears have already scouted out two parcels of land and come to a contingency with Hammond, Indiana, but the goal has always been to build a new stadium in Illinois. If the Illinois legislature votes to approve a stadium authority quickly, that could give the Bears the impetus that is needed to build the new facility in Illinois. If it is approved, the project would be exempt from property taxes. It would also ensure that Illinois taxpayers would only help pay for infrastructure, such as roads but not the stadium itself. That would be paid for by the Bears and the NFL. The Bears are still giving strong consideration to two different sites in Hammond, and it is becoming clear that the Bears would turn to Indiana if the Illinois politicians fail to approve the project. While it appears that Pritzker is in favor of this project, it does not mean that Illinois politicians would follow suit. However, Pritzker was re-elected to his position Tuesday by landslide proportions, and that could help the Bears meet their goals One of the keys is how soon the project could be approved by the state of Illinois. Further delays could shift the likelihood of the stadium project back to Indiana. The post Bears’ stadium relocation gets more clarity after Roger Goodell meeting appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: How Cavs fans greeted LeBron James in his first visit to Cleveland with 76ers
articles.summary: LeBron James made his first trip back to Cleveland as a member of the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday night, and Cavs fans made sure he still felt the love at Rocket Arena. James was greeted with his customary cheers from the Cleveland crowd when he was announced in the starting lineup as a visiting
articles._body: LeBron James made his first trip back to Cleveland as a member of the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday night, and Cavs fans made sure he still felt the love at Rocket Arena. James was greeted with his customary cheers from the Cleveland crowd when he was announced in the starting lineup as a visiting Sixers player for the first time, according to ESPN’s Dave McMenamin. The warm reception was a familiar one for the Akron native, who has been showered with cheers in Cleveland on past visits with the Los Angeles Lakers. LeBron James greeted by his customary cheers from the Cleveland crowd when announced in the starting lineup as a visiting Philadelphia 76ers player for the first time pic.twitter.com/y0SFp1Kohd — Dave McMenamin (@mcten) November 7, 2026 It is not hard to understand why. James spent 11 seasons across two stints with the Cavaliers after being selected with the first overall pick in the 2003 NBA Draft. During his second run, he delivered the city’s first major professional sports championship in 52 years, leading Cleveland back from a 3-1 deficit against the Golden State Warriors in the 2016 NBA Finals. This homecoming carried a little extra intrigue, too. James revealed last month that reuniting with the Cavaliers was a real option for him during free agency this summer before he ultimately signed with Philadelphia. “ But it was in consideration, for sure,” James said. The NBA all-time scoring leader explained that he was “trying to decide where I wanted to go with the rest of my career.” He chose the Sixers over the Cavs, Warriors, Miami Heat and Minnesota Timberwolves, signing a two-year deal . The move has paid off so far, with James teaming up with Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown to form one of the league’s most talented cores. Philadelphia entered Friday’s game with an 8-1 record, the best in the Eastern Conference, and the team’s last game against Cleveland was one to remember. In the Sixers’ home opener on Oct. 22, Philadelphia erased a 29-point deficit to beat the Cavaliers 114-106 , outscoring Cleveland 69-37 over the final two quarters. It was the largest comeback win of James’ career, and he chipped in 17 points and 10 rebounds. The Cavaliers, meanwhile, came into the rematch at 4-4 after back-to-back losses to the Oklahoma City Thunder. No matter what jersey he wears, James remains a beloved figure in Cleveland, and Friday’s reception was proof that his legacy in Northeast Ohio is not going anywhere. articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers boast one of the most recognizable NFL rosters from a names perspective and wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk, who spoke to media on Friday, November 6, is certainly one of them. Christian McCaffrey and Nick Bosa are expected to be back for Week 9, while the 2023 Second Team All
articles._body: The San Francisco 49ers boast one of the most recognizable NFL rosters from a names perspective and wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk, who spoke to media on Friday , November 6, is certainly one of them. Christian McCaffrey and Nick Bosa are expected to be back for Week 9 , while the 2023 Second Team All-Pro receiver Aiyuk has been working to be reinstated to the NFL after a high profile parting of ways with the 49ers. Aiyuk hasn’t played since the 2024-25 NFL season. He suffered a serious knee injury and missed team meetings leading to the voiding of about $27 million of his contract and Aiyuk’s subsequent public trolling of the 49ers franchise. Jeremy Fowler of ESPN chimed in on the situation as Aiyuk and agent Drew Rosenhaus spoke to media. Fowler is not bullish on Aiyuk’s chances of being reinstated this season. “Aiyuk wants to get reinstated to play in the NFL. His prospects in the short term are not promising, assuming he becomes a free agent eventually,” Fowler said. The 49ers are moving forward with a Brock Purdy-led passing game that has been beset by injuries lately. Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel aren’t expected to play against the Raiders in Week 9. Purdy commented on the Aiyuk situation recently , painting the picture of a team that likes what it has in the locker room right now with little plans of changing much. Aiyuk has a long way to go toward restoring goodwill in the NFL, even with a huge body of work behind him in the league. He is one of the better receivers the 49ers have seen in the last decade, but it appears as if his time with GM John Lynch’s team is coming to a close. articles.title: Cavs’ Jarrett Allen ruled out for NBA Cup showdown with LeBron James’ 76ers
articles.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers entered the new season with no fanfare, as analysts and fans latched onto other Eastern Conference squads like the Philadelphia 76ers and Toronto Raptors. A 4-4 start has only reinforced the lack of enthusiasm surrounding the Cavs. Building momentum and silencing the noise
articles._body: The Cleveland Cavaliers entered the new season with no fanfare, as analysts and fans latched onto other Eastern Conference squads like the Philadelphia 76ers and Toronto Raptors. A 4-4 start has only reinforced the lack of enthusiasm surrounding the Cavs. Building momentum and silencing the noise could be quite difficult with a diminished presence inside . Jarrett Allen is not playing in Friday night’s NBA Cup matchup versus the Sixers, per Kyle Neubeck of PHLY Sports. The 10th-year center suffered a right knee contusion in Wednesday’s 124-116 loss to the Oklahoma City Thunder. Hopefully, he just needs a game or two to shake off the injury. The Cavaliers’ continuity, save for a couple of changes, should be one of their main strengths. As usual, though, health is a vital component of any winning formula. Allen missed 26 games last season due to knee and finger injuries, so the idea of another lengthy absence would surely be distressing. The 2021-22 All-Star was listed questionable for this NBA Cup contest, which is an indication that he will not be sidelined for a long period of time. Still, the Cavs do not want to replace starters when facing marquee competition during an in-season tournament. Jarrett ranks second on Cleveland with 7.8 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game, and he is also averaging 13.3 points a night this year. Evan Mobley and Peyton Watson will have to shoulder even more defensively, while Donovan Mitchell and James Harden comprise an offensive-minded backcourt. The Cavaliers already fell to the Sixers once this season and just dropped two in a row to OKC. It is obviously early, but they will need to eventually raise their level against championship contenders. The NBA Cup is a good time to start. articles.title: Michael Sanft, Attorney Who Represented Keffe D in 2Pac Murder Trial, Dies at 54
articles.summary: Sanft put together a team and took on Davis' case pro bono.
articles._body: Michael Sanft, the defense attorney who represented Duane “Keffe D” Davis during the 2Pac murder trial , has died, FOX5 Las Vegas reported. He was 54 years old. Sanft put together a team and took on Davis’ case pro bono while serving as the lead trial attorney for the Vegas-based SOS Injury Lawyers, where he has tried more than 150 cases. After the highly publicized trial, he told FOX5 Las Vegas that he didn’t have any regrets. “Maybe if I had a psychic sitting next to me to help discern who should be on the jury,” he told the outlet. “We had the best team possible in this case, from the motion practice work on this appeal to our investigator to our firm here at SOS Injury. We all did our part. I don’t see what I could’ve done differently.” Thirty years after the 25-year-old Tupac Shakur was killed in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas following a Mike Tyson fight, the now-63-year-old Keffe D was found guilty for his role in orchestrating the killing and sentenced to 40 years in prison. “You don’t get to take a man from his family, you don’t get to take his very life, his whole future from him and just walk away from it. Especially when that man is Tupac Shakur,” Judge Carli Kierny told Davis as she handed down his sentencing. “It took us 30 years, but at this time you are going to face justice for what you did on Sept. 7, 1996.” Sanft reportedly died on Thursday night in Las Vegas. No cause of death has been confirmed as the details surrounding his passing have been limited so far.

Browns rumors: Week 9 is not be a trade showcase for Shedeur Sanders
articles.summary: Coach Todd Monken’s Cleveland Browns are preparing to face the New Orleans Saints with QB DeShaun Watson back for practice and Shedeur Sanders expected to start. Watson is working through concussion protocol while Sanders’ draft tumble got an attention-grabbing Skip Bayless take. ESPN
articles._body: Coach Todd Monken’s Cleveland Browns are preparing to face the New Orleans Saints with QB DeShaun Watson back for practice and Shedeur Sanders expected to start. Watson is working through concussion protocol while Sanders’ draft tumble got an attention-grabbing Skip Bayless take . ESPN’s Daniel Oyefusi described the situation in a message to Browns fans. “One thing to keep in mind: This is not a trade showcase. The Browns have no plans to deal Sanders at the deadline.” Sanders played in eight games last season and started seven of them. The son of former NFL legend and current Colorado Buffaloes head coach Deion Sanders passed for 1,400 yards on less than 57% completions. He also tossed 10 interceptions along with seven touchdown passes, while playing in a difficult situation for former coach Kevin Stefanski’s team. The Browns’ passing game is currently averaging just over 204 yards per game under coordinator Travis Switzer with Watson leading the way. It’s been a passing game by committee approach with Harold Fannin Jr. leading the team with 411 receiving yards and Denzel Boston next at 409 yards. Sanders, who hired an agent ahead of his Week 9 start , could do better than last year with a year of experience under his belt and a more versatile group of receivers to throw to in Monken’s system. The Browns seem more well organized and smarter as a whole this season, two factors that could work in Sanders’ favor as he prepares to resume his odyssey as an NFL contributor during game time. The Browns will have their hands full against Tyler Shough and the Saints, but Monken’s team has enough bullets in the chamber to take them down, even with Sanders as its starter. articles.title: How Ajay Mitchell has settled into his role as Thunder’s second-leading scorer next to Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
articles.summary: OKLAHOMA CITY — Amid the early stages of the 2026-27 season, the Oklahoma City Thunder’s untimely injuries to three starters — Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, and Chet Holmgren — has controlled most of the narrative surrounding the team, while two-time MVP Shai Gilgeous-Ale
articles._body: OKLAHOMA CITY — Amid the early stages of the 2026-27 season, the Oklahoma City Thunder’s untimely injuries to three starters — Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, and Chet Holmgren — has controlled most of the narrative surrounding the team, while two-time MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and Ajay Mitchell continue to thrive as a beacon of hope. Mitchell is averaging 17.8 points on 50.5% shooting, 4.0 rebounds, 3.5 assists, and 1.4 steals per game. Gilgeous-Alexander combined for a whopping 85 points in the Thunder’s most recent wins against the Cleveland Cavs this week. Mitchell has tallied 20+ points in four of Oklahoma City’s previous five outings, including a career-high 30 points in a 125-114 blowout win against the Phoenix Suns last week. Thunder head coach Mark Daigneault noticed Mitchell’s gains since September, of which he explained started with his physique, and has progressed onto the court, helping lead his team amidst devastating injuries to the Thunder’s core. “He’s awesome, obviously. He did a great job with his body. His game continues to season. He’s always been a really good player, but he’s tightening up,” Daigneault said. “One of the things that the really, really good players learn is that there’s going to be ups and downs in a 48-minute game. There’s going to be ups and downs in a season, and you just continue to bet on your work. You continue to bet on your game. You continue to bet on your talent. I think that’s one of Shai’s superpowers. But it’s hard for young players to do that.” Thunder’s third-year guard Ajay Mitchell, who was a second-round pick in the 2024 draft, never played a game in the G League. Mitchell proved himself as an NBA-ready product from the jump, as Daigneault has seen how his fearless approach grow into the player he is today. “You just gotta keep betting on it and let your talent rise to the surface,” Daigneault added. “I think Ajay’s taken a step there. He understands that not every quarter is going to be perfect. Not every game is going to be perfect. But he stays aggressive. He stays inside of his game. He’s been very impressive with so far this season.” Finding the balance between not forcing his offense and not hiding is the ideal sweet spot, especially for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and the Thunder, who lost to of their three best scorers for the foreseeable future. And it’s what has unlocked Mitchell’s consistent offensive production. “Just reading the game, seeing what’s available, and just flowing with our offense,” Mitchell said after beating the Cavs. “I just try to be aggressive in every possession — offense and defense — and then, just read the game. Going out there without worrying about mistakes — just going out there to play basketball.” The Thunder will face the Memphis Grizzlies in an NBA Cup matchup on Friday. articles.title: Brandon Aiyuk breaks silence before meeting with 49ers
articles.summary: Brandon Aiyuk has been in a saga with the San Francisco 49ers for over a year now. With the relationship between the wide receiver and the organization essentially tarnished, Aiyuk and his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, visited the facility on Friday to speak with the organization. Before entering the bu
articles._body: Brandon Aiyuk has been in a saga with the San Francisco 49ers for over a year now. With the relationship between the wide receiver and the organization essentially tarnished, Aiyuk and his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, visited the facility on Friday to speak with the organization. Before entering the building, the 28-year-old spoke with media members after Rosenhaus shared a few words himself. Aiyuk didn’t provide much information and really only claimed that he hopes to be reinstated into the league. “Nice to see ya’ll,” Aiyuk said to media members. “Oh yeah. I’m feeling great. Feeling healthy. Going through the recovery process. A long rehab process. I’m back to 100 percent and looking to get reinstated into the National Football League.” Brandon Aiyuk arrives for meeting with the 49ers after 2 years away from the game. Helicopters and police surround Levi’s stadium as he makes his arrival. (via @LombardiHimself ) pic.twitter.com/nYTBNsR5lk — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) November 6, 2026 Helicopters and police were present for Aiyuk’s arrival at the 49ers’ facilities. The five-year veteran has an active warrant out for his arrest for allegedly posting a video of himself driving over 100 mph past Levi’s Stadium back in February 2026. However, that is a separate matter from what Aiyuk is working out with the organization on Friday, as he is seemingly attempting to make his NFL comeback. While Aiyuk appears happy to at least speak with the franchise, 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan felt the opposite . Shanahan informed media members that he simply does not care how things play out for the disgruntled wideout. The 46-year-old is seemingly more concerned with navigating the Week 9 bye before returning to action in Week 10. Brandon Aiyuk has not played a single game since the 2024-25 campaign after suffering a severe knee injury that season. After skipping out on several mandatory meetings with the organization, the club ended up voiding about $27 million of guaranteed money from Aiyuk’s contract. In the meantime, the former first-round pick has posted several viral videos calling out and trolling the 49ers franchise. Aiyuk has played 69 games in his career (67 starts). He’s accumulated 294 receptions, 4,305 yards, and 25 touchdowns in that span. We’ll see if he’s able to build upon that career at some point, but it will depend on how the 49ers address the situation. articles._body: It is too early to say whether the New Jersey Devils’ decision to acquire goaltender Connor Hellebuyck will be a success, but the early returns on the deal represent a win for both the team and the goaltender. Hellebuyck was in net Thursday night for New Jersey’s 5-4 victory over the St. Louis Blues in overtime. Hellebuyck has improved his has a 4-0 record in his first four games in a New Jersey uniform and he has allowed 10 goals. He has a 2.44 goals against average with an .891 save percentage. Hellebuyck is the second goaltender in New Jersey franchise history to start his career with the team by winning his first four games with the team. The former Winnipeg Jets goaltender has joined John Vanbiesbrouck, who started his career in the Garden State by winning four straight games in the 2000-01 season. The Devils have won their last six home games, and they have had only one home winning streak longer than that in the last 15 years. The Devils have high aspirations for the 2026-27 season and believe they can compete for the Stanley Cup this season. The acquisition of Hellebuyck gives them a goaltender who has won the Vezina Trophy as the NHL’s top goaltender three times and he also won the Hart Trophy as the league’s Most Valuable Player in the 2024-25 season. The four-time NHL All-Star famously backstopped the U.S. Olympic hockey team to the gold medal in the 2026 Winter Olympics. The U.S. earned the title with a victory in overtime over Canada on a goal by Jack Hughes, who is now Hellebuyck’s teammate on the Devils.   The post Devils’ Connor Hellebuyck joins impressive franchise club with only 1 other goaltender appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Lasso Breaks Down 5 Essential Tracks From His New Album ‘Objetos Frágiles en Ambientes Hostiles’
articles.summary: "It’s a dedication to anyone who’s trying to achieve their dreams," the Venezuelan singer/songwriter tells Billboard Español.
articles._body: In his new studio album, Objetos Frágiles en Ambientes Hostiles , Venezuelan singer/songwriter Lasso delves into themes such as love, heartbreak and the contradictions of human relationships through 11 tracks that showcase an artistic evolution within his pop sound. Released on Friday (Nov. 6) by Lasso Party under exclusive license from Interscope Records, the set includes previously released singles like “p0rn0grafía,” “superpoder,” “Tu Lunar” and “¡¡¡FELIZ ANIVERSARIO!!!,” alongside new tracks such as “preguntas que me hago,” “Perdóname por esta canción” and “PESADILLAS.” It also features two notable collaborations: the focus track “Borracho Otra Vez” with Ana Mena, and “Ojalá Que No Te Quiera Nadie” with Nina. Produced by Manuel Lara, the album is rich in nuances, with new textures and arrangements that expand Lasso’s sound, catchy lyrics and his sweet, raspy pop-rock voice. It also marks his first release after parting ways with Universal Music Mexico, the label behind previous projects of his like Eva (2023) and Malcriado (2025). “I’ve been writing [ Objetos Frágiles en Ambientes Hostiles ] for two years,” the Latin Grammy-winning artist tells Billboard Español . “I wrote about 200 songs; I’d never written so much before. But this album also comes from a period where I couldn’t release music — I was leaving a record label, and there’s a cool-off period during which you can’t release anything — so all I did was write, write, write. There were moments when I was very sad, and others when I was very happy.” Out of those 200 songs, he selected the 20 best and, with the help of friends and colleagues, finalized the ones that would make the tracklist. The oldest among the 11 is “PESADILLAS,” while the newest is “¡¡¡FELIZ ANIVERSARIO!!!.” Regarding the album title, which means “Fragile Objects in Hostile Environments,” Lasso explains that “it’s a dedication to anyone who’s trying to achieve their dreams.” “The fragile objects are the dreams, and the hostile environment is the world that receives them, telling you, ‘You can’t do it, you’re not good enough, there are already too many like you, or there are too few like you,’ depending on what you’re doing,” he elaborates. “And it’s about that daily struggle of saying, ‘What I’m doing is amazing, and I’m going to convince you, no matter how hard it is.’” Below, Lasso breaks down five essential tracks from Objetos Frágiles en Ambientes Hostiles .

articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers (8-1) own the best record in the early portion of the NBA campaign, thriving despite all the mouths they have to feed. They must preserve their core, though, especially superstar center Joel Embiid. The former MVP has played in seven of the team’s nine games so far, b
articles._body: The Philadelphia 76ers (8-1) own the best record in the early portion of the NBA campaign, thriving despite all the mouths they have to feed. They must preserve their core, though, especially superstar center Joel Embiid. The former MVP has played in seven of the team’s nine games so far, but head coach Nick Nurse needs a competent backup center to share in the responsibilities. Adem Bona is typically that guy for head coach Nick Nurse, but he won’t be tonight. The Nigerian center has been downgraded to out with a cervical spine sprain ahead of Friday’s NBA Cup East Group B battle versus the Cleveland Cavaliers, per Derek Bodner of PHLY Sports. Bona has been an unheralded part of the Sixers’ sensational start, averaging 3.9 rebounds and 1.0 block in 14.2 minutes per contest. This will mark the first game he misses this season. Given the plethora of talent that lines the roster, the 2024 Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Year is unlikely to stand out on most nights. Make no mistake, though. He is incredibly important to this squad. Embiid has played in a combined 96 games over the last three seasons, and Ariel Hukporti suffered a torn Achilles in October, leaving Nurse with few viable options to man frontcourt duties. The 76ers could seek reinforcements on the trade or free agency markets later in the campaign, but for now, Adem Bona is their primary backup. It will be worth monitoring how his absence affects Joel Embiid and Philly in Rocket Arena. The Sixers and Cavs (4-4) square off at 7:30. p.m. ET. articles.title: Lincoln Celebrated the Art of Rejuvenation at Billboard Latin Music Week
articles.summary: From wellness retreats to sensory experiences, Lincoln invited attendees to recharge amid the excitement of Miami
articles._body: Miami doesn’t exactly do quiet—especially during Billboard Latin Music Week, when the city comes alive with music, industry conversations and nonstop events. But amid the excitement, Lincoln offered attendees something unexpected: a moment to slow down and recharge. Throughout the week at Faena Forum, the luxury automotive brand brought its signature approach to comfort, design and rejuvenation to life through immersive experiences that offered a glimpse into the thoughtful details behind Lincoln’s latest innovations. Brandon Todd Between back-to-back panels, a little downtime went a long way. Lincoln’s Rejuvenation Pod invited attendees to step away from the bustle and settle into a moment of calm. Inspired by the Lincoln Rejuvenate feature available in the Nautilus and Navigator, the experience offered a taste of relaxation designed to be enjoyed behind the wheel. Brandon Todd Just a few steps away, the Lincoln Navigator turned heads in a specialty exterior color, Frosted Fig. Guests explored the SUV’s luxurious interior, complete with an expansive panoramic sunroof and a sweeping digital display across the dashboard. And because Miami’s sunshine rarely takes a day off, Lincoln offered ice pops to help guests beat the heat. Brandon Todd Inside Faena Forum, the experience continued with opportunities to indulge the senses. A lush floral installation became a picture-perfect backdrop for attendees capturing memories from the week, while a nearby scent discovery station invited guests to explore the fragrance options available through the Digital Scent feature. Together, the installations offered a reminder that luxury isn’t always about what catches the eye and sometimes, it’s about how a space makes you feel. Brandon Todd The Lincoln experience extended beyond Faena Forum on Monday evening, as Billboard’s Latin Power Players celebration brought together some of the industry’s most influential names. Select honorees enjoyed courtesy rides in Lincoln vehicles to the awards ceremony, arriving in style for a night celebrating those shaping Latin music’s global impact. Across a week defined by music, movement and milestone moments, Lincoln made the spaces in between feel just as memorable. From discovering new scents to exploring luxurious interiors and finding a few minutes to recharge, each experience reflected the pleasure of being present. And in a city that rarely slows its rhythm, Lincoln made a compelling case for enjoying the pause.

articles._body: The Philadelphia Eagles are scheduled to take on the New York Giants on Sunday for a Week 9 NFC East clash. However, Philly is dealing with a string of injury woes, as the latest report reveals the statuses for Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, and Dontayvion Wicks, amongst others. It’s said that Barkley is good to go for the contest against the Giants. Meanwhile, both Smith and Wicks have been ruled out . The Eagles’ injury report reveals six total players have been ruled out, while one is questionable. 13 players are deemed available, which includes the 29-year-old running back. Friday's Injury Report #NYGvsPHI pic.twitter.com/XMbBMJMCSP — Philadelphia Eagles (@Eagles) November 6, 2026 Barkley has been dealing with hamstring and back issues through much of the 2026-27 campaign. However, the nine-year veteran has still managed to play in six of the Eagles’ eight games heading into Week 9. It’s been a bit of a down year for him and the offense in general, as Barkley has rushed for 274 yards and two touchdowns on 56 attempts in his six appearances. Smith, on the other hand, is dealing with a hamstring injury. He hasn’t played since the 25-14 Week 6 loss to the Carolina Panthers. With A.J. Brown out of the picture, the hope was for Smith to step up as the WR1 in Philadelphia. But in four games played so far this season, the six-year veteran has recorded 26 receptions for 310 yards and two touchdowns. His 77.5 yards-per-game average is the highest in his career. Meanwhile, Wicks is ruled out with an ankle injury. His last performance was also against the Panthers, however, the newly acquired wideout has appeared in six games instead of four. He’ll sit out Week 9 with a 19-reception, 284-yard, and one-touchdown statline. articles.title: Why Stephen A. Smith questions Lamar Jackson’s future in Baltimore
articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens added Jacoby Brissett after injury news hit Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley, casting a huge shadow on the rest of their season. Trade rumors have swirled around running back Derrick Henry while Jackson’s future Super Bowl prospects with Baltimore have been questioned. F
articles._body: The Baltimore Ravens added Jacoby Brissett after injury news hit Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley, casting a huge shadow on the rest of their season. Trade rumors have swirled around running back Derrick Henry while Jackson’s future Super Bowl prospects with Baltimore have been questioned. Famous sports pundit Stephen A. Smith took aim at the Jackson situation on his show on Friday, November 6, giving fans something to think about as the situation continued to be discussed. “You payin’ him? Are you payin’ Lamar Jackson? Because we all know that as mercurial as he is, as much of a talent as he is, what it all comes down to is availability…It’s all about what have you done lately. Are you payin’ him? Are you payin’ Lamar Jackson?” Jackson’s contract runs through 2028 after which he will be an unrestricted free agent at age 31. He has played in five of the Ravens’ nine games this season with Huntley and Joe Fagnano filling in as his backup during the games he hasn’t been able to give it a go. Now at 4-5 on the season and last place in the AFC North, it’s safe to say that Baltimore would be in a much better spot with Jackson at the controls of coach Jesse Minter’s offense. The Ravens’ fortunes rest strongly on Jackson’s shoulders as its most dynamic playmaker, and the guy who opens up the running game for Henry and his teammates to thrive. If his injury woes continue deep into next year, Minter and company could look to move in a different direction. The post Why Stephen A. articles._body: So far into its debut, New Balance's all-new TL900 sneaker has appeared in stylish, earthy colorways that speak directly to its outdoorsy personality. Next, the brand is turning the lights off on the model for a classic all-black spin. New Balance's street-savvy hiking shoe keeps its outdoor-coded details , like the chunky rubber soles, rugged protection around the toe and heel, and cozy padded uppers. It's now washed in this "Black Cement" colorway, which creates a near-total blackout of the model (with some small silver metal details throughout). Again, we've seen the TL900 in mostly earth-toned color options with blacked-out soles, which have been admittedly very good. However, an all-black pair changes the game. It goes with more outfits and has even more everyday appeal. All we need next is a New Balance Grey iteration. Then, the TL900 will be truly official in the brand's signature color. For now, we're getting these cool black hiking sneakers, which, by the way, are set to release on November 12 on Asphaltgold's website for 159 €, or around $177. articles.title: Rams’ Terrance Ferguson ruled out vs. Commanders with ankle, hamstring injuries
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams are operating with some uncertainty in their offense right now, as they figure out how to manufacture secondary pass-catching production in Davante Adams’ absence. Terrance Ferguson can potentially help on that front. After missing the last five games with a medial ankl
articles._body: The Los Angeles Rams are operating with some uncertainty in their offense right now, as they figure out how to manufacture secondary pass-catching production in Davante Adams’ absence . Terrance Ferguson can potentially help on that front. After missing the last five games with a medial ankle sprain , the 23-year-old tight end appeared ready to return for Sunday’s road matchup versus the Washington Commanders. He reportedly had no injury designation heading into this NFC showdown. That is no longer the case. Ferguson sustained a hamstring injury in Friday’s practice and has now been ruled out , per ESPN’s Dan Graziano. Following an offseason that seemed to come unbelievably easy, the supposedly invincible Rams have trudged through mounds of adversity during the 2026 campaign. Non-LA fans are not going to show sympathy, especially with game-wrecking pass-rusher Myles Garrett due to return, but the Ferguson setback is obviously rough news for a 4-4 squad that is trying to climb the standings. The No. 46 overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft recorded seven receptions for 63 yards and one touchdown in his first three games, with a six-catch Week 2 showing versus the New York Giants serving as his top performance thus far. Since Adams still has a long recovery ahead, Ferguson should command a healthy target share once he returns. But when will that be? Overcoming a lingering ankle injury is hard enough. Now, the former Oregon Ducks standout is hampered with a hamstring issue that puts his immediate status in serious doubt. Terrance Ferguson will process this bad news, regroup and watch his teammates duke it out with the Commanders on Sunday afternoon. Opening kickoff is at 1 p.m. ET. articles._body: The latest Jordan DMSN 95 sneaker looks like Bottega Veneta came and took it for a spin. However, the Italian luxury label doesn't have its own Jordan sneaker (that would be nice, though). Bottega Veneta doesn't have a shoe with any sneaker brand right now. But there quite a few Bottega-coded sneakers are out, from wonderfully woven pairs to bright green steppers. The Jordan DMSN 95 checks the latter box. The Air Max-style Jumpman model lands in this "Green Noise" colorway, complete with patent leather overlays and hairy suede underlays. The result is this almost tonal green sneaker with plenty of texture. Although the inspiration behind the Jordans is unknown, the sneakers certainly have Bottega-ish flavor. The color scheme alone echoes Bottega Veneta's signature vibrant green. Interestingly, the Jordan DMSN also features a varsity-style "J" on the tongue. And now, that I think about it, the fuzzy uppers do remind me of a letterman jacket. It's not the only greened-out Jordan sneaker to come out recently, either. The Jordan Brand's 2026 Space Jam collection features a "Green Screen" Air Jordan 11 . Funny enough, the Jordan DMSN's design is heavily inspired by the AJ11. Now, there's a "Green Noise" DMSN 95 on top of a "Green Screen" Jordan 11. Again, no clue what was on the DMSN's moodboard. But here's what I do know: the latest pair looks nice, has impeccable timing, and is quite Bottega-coded. Speaking of which, the Jordan DMSN 95 "Green Noise" sneakers are available on Nike's website for $145. articles._body: A man in his 20s showed up to a UK hospital with the hilt of a knife sticking out of his face. The 15 mm-wide blade hidden within went completely through his right eye and through his brain, with the tip of the blade hitting the top of his skull. Despite the ghastly injury, the man was alive and conscious when he arrived. He could still talk and move all four limbs. His doctors described him as being in a state of agitation. On the Glasgow Coma Scale, he scored a 12 (E3 V4 M5) , indicating a "moderate" brain injury, just one point above "mild." He could open his left eye when told, but otherwise kept it closed (E3 score); he could talk and answer questions, but was confused (V4); and he intentionally moved away when pressure was applied to his body (M5). In a report published Friday in BMJ Case Report, his doctors said they were concerned that in his confused, agitated state he may try to pull the knife out on his own. So, they swiftly sedated and intubated him. They put him on prophylactic treatments for bacterial infections, including tetanus. Then they used images to see what was going on in his head. This Is Nike's Most Italian Air Max Yet
articles.summary: One Block Down's Nike Air Max 95 Lux sneakers come in four Italy-inspired colorways, complete with Italian leather uppers.
articles._body: One Block Down's Nike Air Max 95 Lux sneaker is even more, well, luxe than we initially thought. There were murmurs about whether this particular collaboration would be Italian-made, like the Supreme linkup . And they technically are. According to One Block Down, the Air Max 95's leather was "prepared and finished in Italy," while the rest was produced in Vietnam. Sounds like an Italian Nike to me. Really, the Italian roots go deep with this collab. For one, a Milan brand designed. The Air Max 95 Lux sneakers also in four colorways total inspired by Italy's flag colors. We've seen the black, but the brand finally revealed the green, red, and white pair. They all feature one-piece puffer leather uppers (from Italy, in case you forgot), plus faux mesh accents and shiny silver hangtags. Supreme did its thing with its own "Made in Italy" pairs. But One Block Down's collaborative effort is Italian to the bone (and sole). The Air Max sneakers are joined by a clothing capsule, which includes soccer-coded technical jackets, roomy track pants, a training T-shirt, and skull caps. One Block Down's black Nike Air Max 95 Lux sneakers will drop on November 13 on the brand's website , then on Nike's website on November 19. Meanwhile, the green, red, and white colorways will release only at One Block Down's Milan store. If you haven't booked the flight to Milan yet, you're already behind schedule. articles.title: In Canada: Faouzia to Accept the Breakthrough Award at Billboard Canada Women in Music 2026
articles.summary: Also up north this week: Angine de Poitrine reveals a third member at a Toronto concert and SOCAN joins GEMA's live music royalty network.
articles._body: Faouzia ‘s music is taking off in a big way, and the Moroccan-Canadian artist is about to receive a major honour in recognition of that momentum: the Breakthrough Award Presented by FACTOR at Billboard Canada Women In Music 2026. The singer, born Faouzia Ouihya, debuted on the Billboard Canadian Hot 100 two months ago with “Unethical,” a single that dropped over a year ago and has gone viral in a big way.  Related In Canada: Summer Walker, Bebe Rexha to Accept Awards at Billboard Canada Women in Music 2026 Michael Sanft, Attorney Who Represented Keffe D in 2Pac Murder Trial, Dies at 54 Kenny MacPherson, Veteran Music Publisher and Big Deal Music Co-Founder, Dies at 71 “Unethical” became the singer’s first song to receive over a million Spotify daily streams in September, which Faouzia said she was “forever grateful” for. The song has reached 150 million global streams and become her second most-streamed single. It continues to climb the charts, with a new peak in each of its eight weeks on the chart. It is also climbing the Billboard Global 200 with streaming momentum in countries including the U.K., South Africa, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, UAE and more.  The song is reportedly inspired by an ultimatum Faouzia received from an ex who asked her to prioritize their relationship over her singing career. Her virtuosic vocal delivery and emotion have turned it into a viral TikTok clip, with “Unethical” live performance clips circling across social media. Some fans have even tried their hand at singing the song. The official “Unethical” sound plays in over 44,000 Instagram Reels and over 533,000 TikTok posts . The orchestral pop ballad was one of the first tastes of her debut album, Film Noir , released in 2025, followed by a deluxe edition in June. Following its release, it received much acclaim, with Faouzia now sitting at over 10 million monthly listeners on Spotify. The project was followed by a highly anticipated deluxe version, Film Noir (fin), in June, with three additional tracks. What makes the achievement even more impressive is that she’s done it as an independent artist. Two years ago, Faouzia announced that she was “now an independent artist for the first time in 6+ years” after parting ways with her former label, Atlantic Records/Warner Music Canada, where she released her first two EPs, Stripped and Citizens . It’s been a slow and steady ascent for Faouzia that is now paying off. Faouzia has worked with some of the biggest acts across multiple genres, including David Guetta, Galantis, John Legend and Martin Solveig. She is even credited as a co-writer on Ye and Ty Dolla $ign’s “Beg Forgiveness,” released in 2024. Faouzia will accept the Breakthrough Award Presented by FACTOR at this year’s third edition of Billboard Canada Women In Music, hosted by Leandra Earl and Kylie Miller of The Beaches. She’ll be honoured alongside the first-ever Global Woman of the Year, Cardi B , Global Hitmaker Bebe Rexha , Rising Star Chxrry , Global Visionary Summer Walker , Trailblazer Tia Wood , Innovator Blond:ish , Executive of the Year, Live Nation Canada’s Melissa Bubb-Clarke and Impact Award recipient, MusiCounts/The Juno Awards’ Kristy Fletcher . Billboard Canada Women In Music 2026 will be held on Nov. 24 at Rebel in Toronto. Tickets are available here . Read more here . — Billboard Canada Angine de Poitrine Surprises History Toronto Crowd with a Third Member Angine de Poitrine have returned to Canada, and they didn’t come alone. The viral Quebec math rock pair and Billboard Canada cover stars returned to Toronto last night (Nov. 5) to play a sold-out show at History and surprised the crowd with new music, and even a new member. Joining Khn and Klek de Poitrine onstage was a new polka-dotted alien with a cube-shaped head, a long nose similar to Khn’s and two horns in the shape of the signature yellow triangle featured on the group’s usual attire. He held up his triangle as the crowd cheered before one much-anticipated “ding” of the triangle. Related In Canada: The Inside Story Behind Angine de Poitrine’s Unprecedented Global Breakthrough Angine de Poitrine debuted an upbeat new track with a percussion break, during which their latest member delivered a high-energy (and somewhat tongue-in-cheek) triangle solo before clanging along with the original two members. It’s the second taste of new music the group have given fans in less than two months, after debuting the summery “Zugzegk” on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in September, a track whose title refers to the band’s wild “success” over the past year. Their History show kicks off their latest North American run and marks their return to Toronto for the first time since their packed debut in the city in July, which included a trio of Mod Club shows and an opening stint for Jack White at RBC Amphitheatre and an appearance at FIFA Fan Fest. They also performed at the Polaris Music Prize gala . The band will play its two next dates on home turf, with a show at Quebec City’s Impérial Bell tonight (Nov. 6) and a return to Montreal’s Club Soda on Nov. 16 — the same venue where they launched their Billboard -charting breakthrough LP, Vol. II . Their homecoming coincides with some major recent accolades, including a Polaris double win in September and four wins at the Premier Gala ADISQ this week (Nov. 4). After racking up a staggering 11 nominations, they are still vying for several of the top honours at the main ADISQ Gala (celebrating Quebec music), which takes place in Montreal on Sunday (Nov. 8). articles._body: A few days back I posted here asking about how people were using AI / doing agentic coding (see: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50366117 ). Needless to say, I was overwhelmed by the response! The one challenge I found, however, was that the comments were almost impossible to parse: some users answered my questions in the format I provided, others answered in any order, but either way it was really hard to get a picture of who was using what from that thread alone. So, I spent last night building an interactive site out of people's answers. I used Claude to pull the tools, models and plans out of each comment, with every number linked back to the original comments it came from. The website covers subscriptions, models, harnesses, orchestration and agent platforms, what people liked and disliked about each tool, and some of the better stories from the thread. articles.title: Sandro Mamukelashvili upgraded on Lakers’ injury report for NBA Cup game vs. Blazers
articles.summary: LOS ANGELES – The Los Angeles Lakers come into their NBA Cup matchup against the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday riding a three-game win streak. And they’ll have as close to a healthy rotation as they can get. Forward Sandro Mamukelashvili was initially listed as questionable on the Lakers
articles._body: LOS ANGELES – The Los Angeles Lakers come into their NBA Cup matchup against the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday riding a three-game win streak. And they’ll have as close to a healthy rotation as they can get . Forward Sandro Mamukelashvili was initially listed as questionable on the Lakers’ injury report due to an illness, but was later upgraded to available . As far as the rest of the Lakers’ injury report, second-year forward Adou Thiero is cleared to make his season debut after rehabbing a knee issue, while Bronny James and Cameron Carr are both out due to G League assignment. Signed in the offseason as part of the Lakers’ roster revamp around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves, Sandro Mamukelashvili has been one of the team’s most consistent players to begin the year. He’s been singled out by head coach JJ Redick as one of the most versatile players on the roster capable of playing what he calls the ‘point-five.’ “I think he’s even better than I thought he was just from being around him every day. He’s obviously also a fantastic human being. But the size, the skill, I was just actually with him before our team meeting and I was talking to him about some stuff, but one of the things I said to him is like, he’s a really rare offensive player,” Redick told reporters during his pregame press conference before the Lakers faced off against the Toronto Raptors on Nov. 1. “He’s an advantage creator in some ways. So if he’s guarded by a five, he can pick and pop into space. That’s an advantage creation. He’s really good at follows and touch rolls, roller behind. That’s an advantage creation. So he’s an advantage creator. And then his point-five decision-making and his shooting ability and finishing ability, he’s an advantage finisher. He’s also a connector. There’s very few offensive players that are all three of those things, and he is.” Thus far, Mamukelashvili has appeared in all nine games of the Lakers as they’ve gotten off to a 7-2 start. He’s playing a little over 23 minutes per game while averaging 9.0 points, 4.6 rebounds and 1.7 assists. The former Seton Hall standout is shooting 46.9 percent from the field, 31 percent from the 3-point line and 75 percent from the free-throw line. The Lakers are 0-1 so far in the NBA Cup standings after losing to the Golden State Warriors last week. With Mamukelashvili available, the Lakers will try to grab a win and keep pace in the cup standings. articles.title: Andrew Wiggins gets real on rough start to Heat season
articles.summary: As the Miami Heat are off to an ugly 3-6 start to the season after the 120-100 loss to the Golden State Warriors, it was a reunion for two specific players on the team. While the Heat’s Klay Thompson and Andrew Wiggins returned to take on the Warriors, it was another disappointing game for
articles._body: As the Miami Heat are off to an ugly 3-6 start to the season after the 120-100 loss to the Golden State Warriors, it was a reunion for two specific players on the team. While the Heat’s Klay Thompson and Andrew Wiggins returned to take on the Warriors , it was another disappointing game for the latter, as he spoke honestly about his rough start to the season. Wiggins had a productive preseason with the new-look Miami team led by Giannis Antetokounmpo, as he averaged 14.3 points per game on 60.6 percent shooting from the field and 46.7 percent (seven of 15) shooting from beyond the arc. However, through nine games, Wiggins is averaging 8.6 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 1.7 assists per game while shooting 40.8 percent from the field and 29.7 percent from three-point range. Also disappointing on the defensive side of the ball, where he finds himself guarding the opposing team’s top wing player, it has been pedestrian. Dallas Mavericks’ Cooper Flagg shot six of eight from the field when guarded by Wiggins on Oct. 26, and Luka Doncic shot five of six from the field against Wiggins last Monday, as the veteran candidly expressed that he has to “figure a couple of things out.” “Just keep focusing on the little things, and everything else will fall in line after that,” Wiggins said, according to The Miami Herald. Heat’s Bam Adebayo comes to the defense of Andrew Wiggins One teammate who defended Wiggins was Heat captain Bam Adebayo, who got off to a slow start of his own and has been playing better, as he expressed that the 31-year-old is working through a “new role.” “I don’t want to say it’s early anymore, but it takes time,” Adebayo said. “Especially when you got to go into a new role and figure out your way…So for him, I’m always trying to keep him positive. I’m always one of the people that’s like the tables will turn, and he’ll have his moment.” At any rate, Wiggins continues to work through the rough patches with the next game on Saturday against the Sacramento Kings. articles.title: The killer mistake Bills must avoid at 2026 NFL trade deadline
articles.summary: The Buffalo Bills (6-1) are bound and determined to rule the AFC this year. After losing the AFC East division title to the upstart New England Patriots last year, the Bills are not going to let any team sneak past them again. New England could accomplish the feat this season, but it will be the
articles._body: The Buffalo Bills (6-1) are bound and determined to rule the AFC this year. After losing the AFC East division title to the upstart New England Patriots last year, the Bills are not going to let any team sneak past them again. New England could accomplish the feat this season, but it will be the result of having a better team and proving it over the course of the season while playing a much more challenging schedule. In addition to the Patriots, the Bills have to be concerned with the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs and Cincinnati Bengals. The biggest threat may be the Bengals, because it appears that QB Joe Burrow has returned to his best form after several seasons on injury-related or mistake-prone play. If the Bills get to the top of the AFC mountain and can return to the Super Bowl for the first time since the glory years of Marv Levy, Jim Kelly and Bruce Smith, it will be the result of having the best offense in the NFL. The Bills are averaging a league-high 33.3 points per game because Josh Allen is directing an attack that can light up the scoreboard. He has one of the strongest arms in the league and is unafraid to show it off by firing laser-like passes into tight windows. He is also the best running quarterback in the game, and he will step into the breech any time the Bills need key yards on the ground or need an alternative to get into the end zone. Defensive issues could thwart their plans However, their offensive skill and drive may not be enough. The weak spot for this team has always been defense, and the hiring of Joe Brady as head coach has not changed this a bit. The Bills rank 30th in pass defense and are in the bottom 25 percent as a scoring defense. The Bills should address their defensive needs at the trade deadline, but it would be a killer mistake to go after LB-edge rusher Khalil Mack of the winless Los Angeles Chargers. Mack has been mentioned as one of the most prominent names available prior to the Nov. 10 trade deadline, and that would have been a correct assessment three seasons ago. However, Mack is not the same player he was when he had 17.0 sacks for the Chargers in the 2023 season. Mack, 35, appears to have slowed down by at least a step at this point in his 13-year career. While the idea of playing for a legitimate Super Bowl contender would certainly amp up his emotional edge and perhaps improve his focus, Mack is simply not the effective player he was in his prime. The Bills would be making a key mistake by trading high draft picks or effective role players just to acquire his services. Through 7 games, Mack has 21 tackles, 3.0 sacks and 6 quarterback hits. Quarterbacks and running backs can easily get out of range when Mack is trying to reel them in. He is not as effective as he once was, and even if he had one or two good games after the Bills acquire him, Mack would not be able to sustain any kind of long-term success. Arizona Edge Josh Sweat could be the answer Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images While it appears that Mack no longer has the first step to cause havoc for opposing quarterbacks, that is not the case for Josh Sweat of the Cardinals. The 29-year-old Sweat is in his 9th season and he is coming off a 12.0-sack season a year ago in the desert. He also had 30 tackles, 4 forced fumbles, 2 fumble recoveries and 17 QB hits. The numbers this season have not been as impressive, but Sweat has 22 tackles, 3.0 sacks and 5 QB hits. He could make a big difference for the Bills, who are getting maximum production from Greg Rousseau, but little else from any of his defensive mates. Rousseau has 7.0 sacks, 9 tackles for loss and 7 passes batted down along with 3 forced fumbles and 24 tackles. However, no other Buffalo defensive player has more than 1.5 sacks, and that means any team that can shut down Rousseau can have an easy time protecting its quarterback. The Cardinals are in last place in the NFC West, and while they have not given up, it seems unlikely that they can pass the Los Angeles Rams, Seattle Seahawks or San Francisco 49ers. This is a team that needs to build for the future, and they could get multiple mid- or late-round draft choices in a trade for Sweat. He has the ability to play either side of the defensive line and he will be a free agent at the end of the season. The Bills might be able to get away somewhat cheaply by explaining the deal as a pure rental. The combination of Rousseau and Sweat could give the Buffalo defense more bite than it has now. The Bills need to improve on the defensive side of the ball, and acquiring Sweat would provide significant help.   The post The killer mistake Bills must avoid at 2026 NFL trade deadline appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan’s San Francisco 49ers are 6-1 on the season and seeking home field throughout the playoffs during a time when John Lynch commented on the “unique” status of Brandon Aiyuk. Teammate Trent Williams also commented on the “uncomfortable” situation ahe
articles._body: Coach Kyle Shanahan’s San Francisco 49ers are 6-1 on the season and seeking home field throughout the playoffs during a time when John Lynch commented on the “unique” status of Brandon Aiyuk . Teammate Trent Williams also commented on the “uncomfortable” situation ahead of a huge range of injury updates. Nick Wagoner of ESPN broke the news on four key players ahead of the Raiders game at Levi’s Stadium in the Bay Area. “DE Nick Bosa and RB Christian McCaffrey have no injury designations and are good to go Sunday against the Raiders. Kyle Shanahan says WR Demarcus Robinson will most likely be activated for Sunday. Not sure yet on DB Nate Hobbs.” Wagoner also noted earlier that WR Mike Evans (Achilles), WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring) and WR Christian Kirk (knee) were also ruled out. McCaffrey has played in all seven of the 49ers’ games this season and has compiled 84 carries for 389 yards and eight touchdowns on the ground. He’s also added 251 receiving yards on 34 catches making him one of the NFL’s most versatile and deadly offensive weapons. Bosa has played in just two games this season after playing in just three games last season. He’s made it to five Pro Bowls over the course of his NFL career but has been greatly limited because of injury lately. Bosa has been dealing with a calf strain in recent weeks but his comments foreshadowed a return that is now set to come to fruition. The 49ers will be a decided favorite against the Raiders with two of their biggest stars back in the fold. Coach Shanahan’s team has Super Bowl aspirations, and Bosa and McCaffrey are a big part of them. articles.title: The Seven Best adidas Sneaker Releases This Week
articles.summary: This week was so chock-full of adidas standouts, we picked... seven of them.
articles._body: The world of sneakers is like a cartoon race. One brand surges ahead, then the other catapults past them, then a new one joins the race and takes the lead. Or, it used to be. In recent years, there’s been one consistent leader, and they’re wearing full adidas kit. While most other footwear brands are hellbent on designing the newest, cutting-edge technology, adidas comfortably stays digging through archive crates and resurfacing its seemingly endless supply of incredible retro silhouettes. That’s the thrust of it, anyway. But it’s not the whole truth. While adidas’ extensive archive is key to the Three Stripes’ success, it’s worth noting that designs like the adidas EVO SL keep the brand firmly in the modern rotation, too. Combine that with a considered eye for on-the-money collaborations — Wales Bonner, SFTM, Simone Rocha, to name a few — and you’ve got the blueprint for winning the footwear race. From a croc-covered Wales Bonner Karintha, to an oddball moc-toe terrace Spzl Sneaker: Dive in to the seven best adidas sneakers of the week below! Shop this week's best adidas sneaker releases below Wales Bonner Karintha Croc Shoes Release Date: Available Now Editor's Notes: Grace Wales Bonner’s Karintha has gone from sequins to this: a croc-effect upper in chocolate brown with gold-tone eyelets. adidas calls it “heritage meets contemporary flair,” and it’s one of the few sneakers that works with tailoring. The regular fit and textile lining keep it comfortable, and adidas suggests wearing it to the office. This is a Wales Bonner shoe for people who show up for a Monday morning meeting. ALBRECHT II SPZL Shoes Release Date: November 6 Editor's Notes: The Spezial line has been mining adidas’s archive of oddball terrace and handball trainers for years, and the Albrecht II is the latest to come out of it. It has a premium leather upper and lining in Dusky Bronze, on a rubber outsole. It’s a low-key, earthy pair that works with jeans or shorts, and in this brown palette its a weird, like something you’d find digging in a vintage shop, and cool like a Grandparent. SUPERSTAR ADV X WELCOME Shoes Release Date: Available Now Editor's Notes: The Superstar has been a skate shoe since long before adidas gave it the ADV treatment, and this collab with Welcome Skateboards is a reminder of that. The shell-toe silhouette comes in a black leather upper with a textile lining and a rubber outsole. adidas describes it as a celebration of skateboarding heritage, this a blend of the Welcome's signature weirdness, while respecting a skateboarding icon. HAWAII SPZL Shoes Release Date: November 6 Editor's Notes: Spezial pairs lean on archive shapes, and the Hawaii follows a familiar template: a leather upper in Collegiate Green on a Gum outsole. adidas says the Spezial branding “adds a distinctive edge.” The green-on-gum combination is a classic for a reason, and it’s also available in Shadow Brown if green isn’t your thing. A familiar terrace title, perfect for any away day. WETHERLAM SPZL Shoes Release Date: November 6 Editor's Notes: The Wetherlam is the most expensive of this week’s Spezial drops, and it looks like the most considered. The upper mixes premium leather and textile in Sand Green, with Utility Black and Mesa details, and it sits on a low-profile rubber outsole. adidas describes it as “heritage inspiration with a modern, fashion-forward edge.” It’s quiet and wearable, and the colorway reads more as a hiking shoe than a terrace trainer. CRAZY ENERGY+ BAPE Shoes Release Date: November 6 Editor's Notes: The Crazy Energy+ has become one of adidas’s quietly cool basketball revivals, and BAPE has given it the full metallic treatment for the Golden Era collection. The all-silver upper is flexible synthetic, with a LightstrikePro midsole that adidas calls super-light. It blends basketball heritage with street culture, which is exactly BAPE’s territory. It’s a chrome sneaker for a very bright future, but it won’t be easy to get. SL 72 PRO Shoes Release Date: Available Now Editor's Notes: The SL 72 is one of adidas’s best retro runners, and the Pro is the upgrade: a nylon upper with suede overlays on the eyestay, toe and heel, and a Lightstrike+ midsole for a lighter, more responsive ride. The Earth Strata brown is in line with this week’s palette. It comes in four colorways, this is adidas' answer to the retro runner revival. articles.title: Ships loiter near subsea cables amid Iran's warnings to Trump
articles.summary: Iran threatened to attack subsea cables if US escalates military strikes again.
articles._body: Several tanker ships linked to Iran have been loitering over subsea Internet cables in the Gulf of Oman near the Strait of Hormuz—a possible indication that the Iranian government is preparing to attack such undersea infrastructure in response to any renewed US and Israeli strikes. The movements of three sanctioned tankers and an Iranian fishing boat have been tracked near major undersea cables by the maritime intelligence firm Windward in October, according to the Financial Times . Six active cables currently cross through the contested Strait of Hormuz, linking the Middle East to Europe, Africa and Asia, with two more cables having segments under construction in the region. Four countries, including Iraq, Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar, depend entirely upon such subsea telecommunications connections running through the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint to link with the outside world. But other countries also depend heavily on the region's undersea cable network—one third of India’s westbound Internet traffic goes through the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
