articles.title: Justin Timberlake Crowns This ‘FutureSex/LoveSounds’ Hit as the Best Song He’s Ever Made: ‘Written in Damn Near 20 Minutes’
articles.summary: The Timbaland and Danja co-produced anthem topped the Billboard Hot 100 in 2007.
articles._body: Justin Timberlake has countless hits on his résumé, 39 Billboard Hot 100 entries as a solo artist and 13 more as a part of *NSYNC. JT sat down with Complex on Thursday (Nov. 5) to reminisce on his decorated catalog and rank the best songs of his career, and he ultimately went with “What Goes Around…/… Comes Around,” which topped the Billboard Hot 100 in March 2007 and landed on Timberlake’s FutureSex/LoveSounds album. “I would put this at No. 1 or No. 2,” he said. “It’s the first song I wrote for FutureSex/LoveSounds . Maybe I should dispel a rumor at this point, which has gone around forever, which it’s not a personal story of mine; it’s actually a personal story from a friend.” Timberlake continued: “He was going through it and telling me what had happened. I said, ‘Do you mind if I write about this?’ And I quote, my friend said, ‘Yeah, torch that bi—. What goes around comes around.’ I was like, ‘I have to go. Thank you, I have to go.'” It has long been rumored that “What Goes Around…/…Comes Around” was inspired by his close friend Juan “Trace” Ayala’s fractured relationship with The Girl Next Door actress Elisha Cuthbert. “I just went in and again, this song was written in damn near 20 minutes,” JT added. “It was just flowing. The interlude that goes with it and then you put the video with it,” he said, referencing the Scarlett Johansson-starring clip. “We shot a 10-minute video we shot for it. This just hit on all cylinders for me.” Timberlake gave “What Goes Around” the nod over “Mirrors,” “My Love,” “SexyBack” and “Cry Me a River” to round out his personal top five. Elsewhere in the interview, Timberlake opened up about how Ye told him that “SexyBack” inspired him to make “Stronger,” which saw West bring in Timbaland to get the drums correct on his Graduation smash. “You could probably find it, Kanye came to one of the shows on the FutureSex/LoveShow Tour. I had him come up and we did ‘Stronger’ together,” JT recalled. “He showed up and was suited up like I was. It was a moment. I remember talking a lot about that song.” As for the future, Timberlake revealed that he worked on a few songs with Don Toliver after popping out at the “Can’t Say” rapper’s Miami tour stop in August. Toliver sampled JT’s “Rock Your Body” on his OCTANE standout “BODY.” “I was like, ‘Don’t you have a studio on the road?’ He was like, ‘Yeah.’ I was like, ‘Cool, take a shower. Let’s work.’ We stayed at the arena for a couple hours. We did a few ideas,” he teased. Watch Justin Timberlake’s full appearance on Complex ‘s Re-Rank below.

Williams guided Chicago’s 34-17 stunner over the Seattle Seahawks by tossing 247 yards and throwing one touchdown. Yet one past Lincoln Riley message from Williams’ USC football days continues to play in his mind. Williams spoke of the “be decisive” message that Riley instilled in him on Thursday, during his first press conference following the Seattle romp. Caleb Williams talks about his mindset coming back from injury and wanting to be more decisive with the football: pic.twitter.com/KxAtTk69IL — CHGO Bears (@CHGO_Bears) November 5, 2026 Williams is best known as Riley’s last Heisman Trophy winning quarterback. He thrived with the Trojans during the 2022 season by tossing 42 touchdowns compared to just five interceptions. Now this Bears team elevated to 6-2 overall after dismantling the ‘Hawks. It now marks the second time in Williams’ young NFL career that he’s led a win over the defending Super Bowl champ. articles._body: Daniel Jones is not letting the growing speculation about his starting job change his approach heading into the Indianapolis Colts’ matchup against the Dallas Cowboys. With questions surrounding his performance and whether Anthony Richardson could get another opportunity under center, Jones is facing added pressure to deliver. However, the veteran quarterback remains confident in his preparation and believes he is ready to play his usual style of football on Sunday. #Colts QB Daniel Jones on what it’ll take for his preparation — which HC Shane Steichen praises — to match is production: “I have built up a routine over a number of years and feel like I prepare well.” That’ll help him “cut it loose Sunday,” which is his usual approach. pic.twitter.com/k9lAhVWW6I — James Boyd (@RomeovilleKid) November 5, 2026 “I have built up a routine over a number of years and feel like I prepare well,” Jones said. Jones added that his preparation will allow him to “cut it loose Sunday,” which has been his usual approach throughout his career. That mindset will be important against a Cowboys team that presents an opportunity for Indianapolis to get back on track. The Colts have a winnable matchup ahead, but Jones needs to take advantage of it. Another disappointing performance would only add to the questions about whether he is the right quarterback to lead the team moving forward. Indianapolis has Richardson waiting behind him, and the former first-round pick could become part of the conversation if Jones continues to struggle. There is no guarantee that the Colts will make a quarterback change , but the pressure is clearly building. Jones says he is prepared to play freely, but he needs to turn that confidence into production. If he struggles again in a game the Colts have a chance to win, the rumors surrounding Richardson could become even louder. Callaway Claims No Sales Hit From Good Good Driver Ad Controversy
articles.summary: Joseph Cress-USA TODAY Sports
articles._body: Callaway did not suffer a significant sales hit after backlash to its controversial co-branded driver ad with Good Good Golf, the company said on its Q3 earnings call on Thursday. But the brand’s public image did take a noticeable hit, Callaway’s top executive admitted. “Needless to say that that whole incident was a serious one for us. It was a tough two weeks for our team and our brand,” president and CEO Chip Brewer said on the earnings call. “Fortunately, we didn’t see a material financial impact. There were really no discernible changes in sales trends, even during the event.” Callaway ended its partnership with Good Good (which dated back to 2023) due to the ad, which was released online on Aug. 20—and then quickly deleted. The ad included a scene in which a co-founder of the content creator group, Garrett Clark, shoved colleague Alexis Miestowski to the ground. Callaway stopped selling the driver, which started at $650, on its website. But Good Good is still selling two editions of the Callaway driver on its online store. Major retailers, including Dick’s Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, and PGA Tour Superstore, all pulled Good Good merchandise from their stores but not any non-Good Good-affiliated Callaway products. At the time, Callaway said it was committing $1 million to “support organizations working to prevent violence against women.” Callaway’s sales were actually down 5.6% in Q3 (July 1–Sept. 30) and golf equipment sales specifically were down 7.9%. But the company said the dip was expected due to a delayed launch of a new collection of irons. Callaway raised its full-year outlook to an estimated $2.065 billion to $2.078 billion in net sales, up from $2.045 billion to $2.07 billion. While Callaway said it did not feel a financial impact of the Good Good situation, the company’s image did temporarily suffer. “We do regularly monitor our brand rating and consumer sentiment online, and that did decline during the event,” Brewer said. “But it quickly recovered to the same strong levels it was prior.” Callaway ultimately fired director of content and production Alex Upegui, who approved the driver ad on behalf of the company. Last month, Callaway hired a new senior VP and chief brand officer, Harry Arnett, who was previously the company’s head of global brand and marketing from 2012 to 2019. “In the end, we made a mistake,” Brewer said of the Good Good saga. “We took the matter seriously. We took responsibility. We apologized. And then, more importantly, we addressed our internal deficiencies and updated our processes to make sure that doesn’t reoccur. As a company, a brand, I’m confident we’re going to come out of this even stronger. We’ve been a long-term leader in women’s golf, and we’re committed to continuing to be. And we appreciate everyone that supported us during that time, and we’ll work hard to earn that trust going forward.” No other Callaway employees are known to have been fired because of the ad. Good Good’s CEO, Matt Kendrick, and president, Joe Flannery, eventually stepped down in the wake of the backlash. Now Good Good and Kendrick are being sued by the company’s former VP of brand and marketing, Jeffrey Lefkovits, who was fired in the ad’s aftermath. Lefkovits is seeking more than $1 million in the defamation suit. The post Callaway Claims No Sales Hit From Good Good Driver Ad Controversy appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles._body: With the showdown between the LSU football team and the Alabama Crimson Tide coming this Saturday, the former has been dealing with a key injury for the last handful of weeks that could shift the prospects of the marquee matchup. However, while LSU football defensive star Whit Weeks was listed as doubtful for the Alabama game, the latest update puts his status to bed. According to college football insider Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports, the Tigers are “expected to be without” Weeks for Saturday’s outing against the Crimson Tide. There was initially “hope” that Weeks could return, but the feeling could be that “he’s not ready to return yet.” “LSU is expected to be without star linebacker Whit Weeks against Alabama Saturday as he continues to work back from his late September leg injury, sources tell [CBS Sports],” Zenitz wrote on X, formerly Twitter. “There had been hope he’d be able to get back for this matchup, but sounds like he’s not ready to return yet.” Weeks has missed the past four games of the LSU football program, suffering the leg fracture during Sept. 26’s win against the Texas A&M, 35-6. While Weeks missed the last four games, the star linebacker also got extra time with the Tigers’ bye week this past weekend, but the recovery process will still have to be completed for the senior to return to game action. Playing in four games this season, Weeks has recorded 23 tackles, as one could argue that it makes sense for head coach Lane Kiffin and the rest of the LSU football team not to rush back a pivotal player with the chance of re-injury. At any rate, the next chance for Weeks to return will be on Nov. 14 against the Texas Longhorns. articles.title: Patriots’ Josh McDaniels is all smiles after Drake Maye wins ‘deserved’ award for scorching October
articles.summary: Drake Maye and the New England Patriots had a slow start to their 2026 NFL season, losing two of their first three games. But Maye and the reigning AFC champions have seemingly turned it around since, thanks in large part to a solid October showing from the quarterback. After leading the Patriots
articles._body: Drake Maye and the New England Patriots had a slow start to their 2026 NFL season, losing two of their first three games. But Maye and the reigning AFC champions have seemingly turned it around since, thanks in large part to a solid October showing from the quarterback. After leading the Patriots to a 3-1 record in October, the former North Carolina Tar Heels star signal-caller was awarded the AFC offensive player of the month. Of course, New England offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels is loving it . “Certainly deserving of it,” the 50-year-old McDaniels told the media on Thursday, via Mark Daniels of MassLive. “A lot of credit to him for improving.” Maye was picked off a total of six times during the Patriots’ 1-2 start to the campaign, but did not let that set the tone for him in October. Last month, he threw for a total of 1,199 passing yards and 12 touchdowns against only two interceptions, while completing 67.2 percent of his throws. The offensive line also helped Maye a lot, as he was sacked just four times for a loss of 21 yards over the same stretch. In addition, Maye had 129 rushing yards and a couple of touchdowns on 23 carries across four games against the Buffalo Bills, Las Vegas Raiders, New York Jets and Chicago Bears. Of those games, the Patriots only lost the meeting with Caleb Williams and the Bears in Week 7 at Soldier Field in Chicago. Maye and the 5-3 Patriots will look to keep it going on Sunday , when they play a prime-time game against Jordan Love and the visiting Green Bay Packers at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough. articles._body: With the San Francisco 49ers taking on the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday afternoon , the team has been dealing with key injuries ahead of the contest, such as to wide receiver Mike Evans. As 49ers fans have been waiting for any injury updates , general manager John Lynch would give a key one regarding not just Evans, but also wide receiver Deebo Samuel. According to Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports, Lynch would say that “it’s likely” that Evans and Samuel are not going to be active for Sunday’s game against the Raiders. “GM John Lynch on KNBR: It’s likely Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel will not be available Sunday against the Raiders,” Maiocco wrote on X, formerly Twitter. “But the 49ers are getting back Demarcus Robinson and KhaDarel Hodge — two players who were among the six active wide receivers for Week 1.” Evans would re-aggravate his Achilles tendinitis on Oct. 19 in the 23-17 win over the Washington Commanders, which was the last game he played in. Lynch would speak about Evans in his weekly appearance on KNBR, saying that he is hoping to get the star back “in the coming weeks,” leading to the follow-up question about his availability on Sunday. “That’s probably likely that he won’t be out there Sunday,” Lynch said. “What we’re really trying to do there — he’s got that tendinitis that flared up — and I think you learn from the history. (Running back) Christian (McCaffrey) had this situation and — every player’s different, every situation’s different — but you don’t want it to become something that really lingers.” At any rate, it remains to be seen how Evans progresses as San Francisco looks to keep the ship afloat on Sunday against the Raiders. articles.title: What blew Dennis Allen away about coaching Jeffery Simmons in Bears debut
articles.summary: The Chicago Bears handed Jeffery Simmons the game ball after a dominating debut against the Seattle Seahawks Monday. Simmons altered the pass rush moving forward for defensive coordinator Dennis Allen. Even the veteran coach became amazed by Simmons’ Bears start. Allen told reporters on Thu
articles._body: The Chicago Bears handed Jeffery Simmons the game ball after a dominating debut against the Seattle Seahawks Monday . Simmons altered the pass rush moving forward for defensive coordinator Dennis Allen. Even the veteran coach became amazed by Simmons’ Bears start. Allen told reporters on Thursday what stood out the most from Simmons’ outing. “I really don’t feel like we were handcuffed very much in terms of what we could do and what we could call,” Allen said to the media. “This guy is the consummate professional. I mean, he was on his stuff, knew exactly what to do.” So Simmons sounds like he immediately absorbed the defense quick following the huge pre-NFL trade deadline move. Simmons ended an illustrious Tennessee Titans run that featured four Pro Bowls following the trade. But Allen plugged him along the defensive line right away. Simmons responded by tying for the team lead with six total tackles and grabbing one sack of quarterback Sam Darnold. His presence helped spearhead the 34-17 rout of the defending Super Bowl champs at Lumen Field . Landing Simmons adds further proof of Chicago’s vision under general manager Ryan Poles and head coach Ben Johnson. The Bears have recreated “a Super Bowl or bust” mindset and now sit at 6-2 overall. Pummeling the champs inside, arguably, the loudest venue in the league shines a light on the Bears’ championship desire. Now the Bears still have the Minnesota Vikings to catch in the NFC North, with the latter sitting at 6-1 overall. Yet the Detroit Lions (5-2) and Green Bay Packers (5-3) aren’t far behind. Allen, though, takes comfort in knowing that Chicago lured in a cerebral, and disruptive, trench defender. articles.title: Show HN: Stenvakt, a server hardening and patching tool
articles.summary:
I run a couple of VPSes, some are for clients and some for my own internal projects. Now the problem is when a big vulnerability/exploit happens in a service or an app i use, I need to lose about a day of work to patch all of the servers, and it's always a mess, so I built stenvakt.

Stenvakt is
articles._body: I run a couple of VPSes, some are for clients and some for my own internal projects. Now the problem is when a big vulnerability/exploit happens in a service or an app i use, I need to lose about a day of work to patch all of the servers, and it's always a mess, so I built stenvakt. Stenvakt is a mac app that connects to your servers over SSH, it's used for updating, patching, hardening, watching and reviewing servers. Database backups, shutting down ports, coolify integration. It's also very handy when setting up a fresh new server. I also loved the idea of getting a notification either to your email or inside the stenvakt app. Safe mode stops you accidentally locking yourself out of the server, it automatically rolls back to the previous saved settings in case you make a big mistake. Before a big firewall or SSH change, the server saves the files that could lock you out and starts a rollback timer on the server itself. Limits: macOS only for now (Apple silicon, macOS 14+). Tested on Ubuntu and Debian. It’s not notarized yet, so macOS asks you to click “Open Anyway” once. The app is closed source, but everything it runs on the server is plain bash you can read before it runs. Free covers everything you need to secure a server yourself, on any number of servers. Pro (€4.99/month) does the repetitive part for you: watching logs and patching all your servers at once. Let me know what you think. articles.title: 25 NBA Stars Most Likely Gone By The 2027 NBA Trade Deadline
articles.summary: The 2026-27 NBA season is in full swing. And early on, some teams have impressed, while others have disappointed. After getting their feet wet, it seems like some teams are already looking to make some roster adjustments to prepare for postseason action or to rebuild for the next chapter. As a re
articles._body: The 2026-27 NBA season is in full swing. And early on, some teams have impressed, while others have disappointed. After getting their feet wet, it seems like some teams are already looking to make some roster adjustments to prepare for postseason action or to rebuild for the next chapter. As a result, a handful of NBA stars might be changing jerseys soon. For this piece, let’s take a look at 25 NBA stars most likely gone by the 2027 NBA trade deadline. Jrue Holiday It’s safe to say that the Portland Trail Blazers have a lot of guards. With a stacked backcourt of Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Deni Avdija, and Jrue Holiday, the team can easily round up a security force. As a backup guard, Holiday is averaging 13.2 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 4.8 assists per game, helping the team race to a solid 6-1 start. However at 36, he isn’t getting any younger. His two-way play and championship experience could make him a valuable asset for a championship contender. With a younger Henderson expected to fill that role in the years to come, shipping away the two time All-Star for younger pieces might benefit the Blazers. Kristaps Porzingis For quite some time, the Golden State Warriors have been craving for a solid center. As a result during the offseason, they acquired former All-Star Kristaps Porzingis. The Latvian big man was expected to raise the ceiling for a franchise desiring to recapture their golden days by maximizing the window of Stephen Curry. However, Porzingis’ POTS condition has prevented him from showing up for Golden State. In fact, the team has been withholding his paychecks , as the front office explores the market for trade options. Draymond Green Speaking of the Warriors, another big man who could be moved is four time NBA champion Draymond Green. During their championship runs, Green has been the heart-and-soul for the Warriors. While he signed a one-year deal to return to Golden State earlier this year, Green’s expiring deal coupled with Curry’s closing window could force the hand of the front office. Jimmy Butler Aside from Green and Porzingis, Jimmy Butler is also seen as a potential trade candidate that can boost the Warriors’ roster. Last year, the Warriors’ title hopes took a hit when Butler went down with an ACL injury that kept him out for the rest of the year. With the six time All-Star expected to miss time coupled with an expiring deal, the Golden State might be tempted to go after some younger and healthier bodies to chase at least one more chip. Domantas Sabonis It’s no secret that Domantas Sabonis wants out of Sacramento. It doesn’t seem like the Lithuanian big man’s future no longer aligns with the organization’s plans, especially if the team is developing Maxime Raynaud. The Kings would probably want to maximize everything they can get out of the All-Star big man. Given that several teams are looking to bolster their frontcourt, Sabonis should be an enticing asset for the likes of the Chicago Bulls, Phoenix Suns, and the Charlotte Hornets. Zach LaVine Like Domantas Sabonis, Zach LaVine no longer makes sense in what the Sacramento Kings are trying to do. With the Kings leaning towards their youth coupled with LaVine’s expiring contract, a trade involving the two time All-Star could be on the horizon. Although Sacramento didn’t get to trade him in the offseason, his assets could be valuable elsewhere. In fact, the Kings’ front office are willing to put their hands on deck to find him a new home. Zion Williamson Speaking of big men, another high profile big man that could be on the move is New Orleans Pelicans’ former first overall pick, Zion Williamson. The burly forward, when healthy, is as great as advertised. However, his availability has always been a question mark, throughout his career. And with his incompatible pairing with Derik Queen, the Pelicans might finally convince themselves to fully move on. Norman Powell Norman Powell is coming off a breakout 2025-26 season that saw him earn his first All-Star Game selection. Although he has been a clear silver lining for the Chicago Bulls, the team is going nowhere. In fact, as early as the start of the 2026-27 season, the Bulls are already open to taking offers for the former NBA champion. Kyrie Irving After drafting Cooper Flagg with the first overall pick at the 2025 NBA Draft, the Dallas Mavericks have been fully invested in making him their franchise cornerstone. However, this makes a 34-year old Kyrie Irving an interesting piece for the Mavs. The former NBA champion isn’t getting younger and his availability is always in question. However, he’s still one of the premiere guards in the NBA. As a result, don’t be surprised if Dallas finds an offer for Irving that would make it hard to resist. Bam Adebayo It hasn’t been a smooth start in the South Beach, despite landing Giannis Antetokounmpo in the offseason. The Miami Heat have started the 2025-26 season with a 3-5 record, and his pairing with Bam Adebayo has been forgettable. Adebayo, who scored 83 points in a game just last season, has been limited to just 16.3 points per game this year. Furthermore, spacing issues have been exposed early on. If Bam continues to be a terrible fit alongside the Greek Freak, the Heat might have to bite the bullet should their biggest acquisition grow unhappy in Miami. The clock is ticking given that Giannis has the option to bolt out of free agency next year. Andrew Wiggins In relation to the Miami Heat, Andrew Wiggins hasn’t really been a positive factor for the team. The former All-Star forward is putting up just 10.3 points per game. Without much spacing and an expiring contract, Wiggins has been rendered ineffective. articles.summary: Karpathy posted hackertube.org 5 days ago, and mentioned that it took him 2 hours to build. A day after another fellow posted hackerbooks.org https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50326821, and made it to the top of HN. Some hours after s
articles._body: Karpathy posted hackertube.org 5 days ago, and mentioned that it took him 2 hours to build. A day after another fellow posted hackerbooks.org https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50326821 , and made it to the top of HN. Some hours after someone else made it to the top of HN with the same for wikis: https://wikihack.netlify.app/ I found particularly interesting the "Trends" section on https://hackerbooks.org/ That night, I set out to build something similar but for Repos. So I built https://HackerRepos.fyi . There are 57,316 repositories and 667,508 mentions indexed. I originally made three main sections: Top of all time, Most Recommended, and Trends - per HackerBooks inspiration. It looked/felt good, so I wanted to take it further. I am a big fan of https://github.com/trending , and frequent it often, looking for inspiration. So I built the "Trending now section" https://hackerrepos.fyi/#/trending section. Trending now gives in a quick colour-coded sentiment snapshot of the repos trending on HN, using a grid/map in the style of https://finviz.com/ . When you click on a repo, it gives you a summary of the chatter, a colour-coder tag (Favorable, Critical, Debated, Informational), a graph of the mentions over time and the comments below the graph. I also added a section on every repo called "Where it’s used", to showcase real world use cases. I realized populating this section could be costly, so I placed it behind a paywall for those that care for it. Pro users can click "Find real-world uses", and the app goes and finds a real-world use case. I am working on a few other features I want to ship, but they are not ready yet. For example, I want to build a reverse product-to-stack exploration feature, where a user could enter or describe a product, and the app could provide a set of stacks to fit it, and perhaps, supporting comments. Also, I want to build task-based comparisons. I have a task, and I am debating between some repos to use. I could describe the task and enter the repos I have in mind to solve for the task, and have the app suggest the better one. But I am glad I stopped and I am posting this now, because it has been a long time since I have finally managed to actually ship something from start to finish. I have a folder full of projects I started and did not ship. As I was struggling with this yesterday, whether I should make this public now or keep fiddling with it, I went to Mass and the gospel was Luke 14:25-33. The following part struck me: "And indeed, which of you here, intending to build a tower, would not first sit down and work out the cost to see if he had enough to complete it? Otherwise, if he laid the foundation and then found himself unable to finish the work, anyone who saw it would start making fun of him and saying, Here is someone who started to build and was unable to finish." So here it is. I finished this little tower. I hope you enjoy it, find it helpful, and if you care for it, sponsor it. articles._body: New West Records has named Brad Turcotte as general manager. The label’s artist roster includes Billy Joe Shaver , Amos Lee, American Aquarium , 49 Winchester and All Them Witches . Most recently, Turcotte has served in roles including artist manager at Vector Management, senior vp at Australia-based live entertainment promoter TEG Live and partner at marketing agency 615 Leverage + Strategy. Related Veteran Label Exec Jeff Burroughs Joins Jonny Shipes’ GoodTalk as President Kenny MacPherson, Veteran Music Publisher and Big Deal Music Co-Founder, Dies at 71 Diddy Moved From New Jersey Prison to Similar Facility in Pennsylvania Turcotte has also previously held leadership roles at major labels including UMG Nashville (now MCA) and Big Machine Label Group. Along the way, he’s worked with artists including Taylor Swift , Chris Stapleton , Keith Urban , Luke Bryan and Carrie Underwood . The move to New West Records marks a return to Turcotte’s indie label roots, which began with his founding of Houston-based Compadre Records in 2001. “This year has brought a few unexpected detours for me professionally, but I truly feel like the road has ended at the best home possible,” Turcotte said in a statement. “I can’t thank John Allen and George Fontaine Sr. enough for trusting me with this role. Many moons ago, when I opened Compadre Records in Houston, one of our main competitors was another young independent label just down the road in Austin called New West Records. We were both trying to build something meaningful, champion great artists and make our mark on the music business. To now have the opportunity to help lead New West feels like an incredible full-circle moment.” Turcotte also serves on the board of directors for the nonprofit music education program Music Will, which aids music education in the U.S. public school system.

Nabers did not appear on Wednesday’s injury report, adding a new concern as the Giants prepare for the divisional road mat
articles._body: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers addressed concerns about his knee Thursday after missing practice ahead of Sunday’s Week 9 matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles. Nabers did not appear on Wednesday’s injury report, adding a new concern as the Giants prepare for the divisional road matchup. He worked on the side with a trainer at the Quest Diagnostics Training Center. An initial practice report listed a question mark beside the receiver’s name rather than identifying an injury. The subsequent injury report designated Nabers as a nonparticipant because of his knee. Thursday marked the Giants’ third of four practices before their trip to Philadelphia, leaving one session before the team issues game designations for Sunday’s divisional matchup. ESPN’s Jordan Raanan shared Nabers’ response Thursday on X, formerly Twitter, adding the receiver’s brief assessment to his earlier practice report. “I’ll be good.” The update came on the same day Nabers received NFC Offensive Player of the Month honors for October. He earned the award after recording four consecutive 100-yard games, establishing his importance to New York’s passing attack. The Giants enter the matchup at 4-2-1, while the Eagles sit at 2-6. Despite Philadelphia’s struggles this season, the venue presents a longstanding challenge for New York. The Giants have lost 12 consecutive games at Lincoln Financial Field and have not won there since 2013. Nabers is a little over a year removed from the ACL and meniscus tears he suffered in Week 4 of the 2025 season. The available information does not establish whether the current issue relates to those injuries or specify its severity. His personal assessment also differs from an official clearance to play. Sunday’s game kicks off at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT. Nabers has expressed confidence about his availability, while the Giants will provide their official game designation Friday. Offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel will continue calling plays , but he is making a change to where he will operate during games. McDaniel revealed Thursday that he plans to move from the sideline to the coaches’ booth ahead of the Chargers’ Week 9 matchup against the Houston Texans. The decision comes after Los Angeles fell to 0-7, leaving the team desperate for answers after another disappointing start to the season. #Chargers OC Mike McDaniel says he’s making a change this week, moving from the sideline to the booth to call plays: “I think we’re going to try that this week. Seems like a good action to take based on how things have gone this year.” pic.twitter.com/zWVj8Jx6PN — Ari Meirov (@MySportsUpdate) November 5, 2026 “I want to see adjustments for myself and communicate to the position coaches appropriately. Things we can focus on between series,” McDaniel said Thursday. Moving to the booth could give McDaniel a better view of how opposing defenses are attacking the Chargers and help him identify adjustments between drives. It is a reasonable change to make when the offense has struggled to find any consistency, but the bigger issue is whether the adjustments will translate into better results on the field. The Chargers have yet to find a reliable formula, and the lack of production has put even more pressure on McDaniel to figure things out. Injuries and a lack of available weapons have made his job harder, but those issues cannot continue to serve as the only explanation for the team’s problems. Los Angeles faces a difficult test against Houston, and another loss would drop the Chargers to 0-8. At that point, questions about McDaniel’s future would become even louder. The move to the booth might help McDaniel see the game differently, but the Chargers need more than a change in scenery. They need points and an offense capable of helping the team compete. If those improvements do not come soon, it will be difficult to see how McDaniel keeps his current role. articles.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
articles.summary: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.
articles._body: Devices running some configurations of Alpine Linux, and possibly other distributions, are affected by a decade-old vulnerability that allows attackers to log into devices with no password. The vulnerability exists in the interaction between OpenSSH, the code library implementing SSH connections, and musl, a lightweight alternative to the libc library that, unlike most other Linux distributions, is used in Alpine. Further, OpenSSH using musl (pronounced muscle) must not use PAM (pluggable authentication modules), a framework that handles user authentication and account-access checks. Alpine is a lightweight, widely used Linux distribution. Other platforms may be affected if they use the same configurations. One connection, works every time, needs no retries There are two other conditions necessary for successful exploitation. First, a system must have at least one user account that’s accessible using a password that is hashed using the SHA256 or SHA512 functions. Second, the target system account must be configured to be passwordless, by way of specifying a "*" in the password field in /etc/shadow, the Linux file where password hashes are stored. Passwordless accounts are commonly used for accounts that use certificate-based authentication. This setting is common for certain types of accounts. Read full article Comments

articles.title: Show HN: Open-world text adventure played through AI agents
articles.summary:
Hey HN,

I am building Eremoterra, this experiment of trying to make a game out of an MCP (to learn MCP stuff, but also had a lot fun designing the game).

You play in your own agent. The server returns a fact sheet for the place you are. The world is like real Earth, but empty (until the playe
articles._body: Hey HN, I am building Eremoterra, this experiment of trying to make a game out of an MCP (to learn MCP stuff, but also had a lot fun designing the game). You play in your own agent. The server returns a fact sheet for the place you are. The world is like real Earth, but empty (until the players start to arrive) and only the natural wold (as humanity never existed). The agent narrates the sheet and can write what you confirm in a sort of lore book, typed events and fixed templates, so the model cannot become the source of truth. I added some NPCs that, i hope, bring some interesting emergent behaviour. Within the game there are also "journeys", which is more like traditional text adventures of trying to find something and bringing it home. The world is one Rust process and one RocksDB. The Earth is 233,280,000 parcels of one arcminute. Geography is a memory-mapped atlas of about 1.9 GB, built from public natural-state data. Light, weather, and tide are a function of that atlas, the coordinates, and the clock. The world game runs the real time clock. I would love to have some beta testers for it. https://eremoterra.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50385803 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles.title: Enhanced Group Acquires Controlling Interest in German Promoter DEAG Deutsche Entertainment
articles.summary: The promotion company, which operates festivals and venues across Europe, is valued at $115 million.
articles._body: Enhanced Group announced Thursday (Nov. 5) that it has acquired approximately a 77% controlling interest in the Berlin-based promotion and ticketing company DEAG Deutsche Entertainment AG. Enhanced Group will purchase its interest in the German live entertainment company for $8 per share, in a deal that values DEAG at $115 million. The new issues are subject to a lock-up period lasting for up to 12 months, with staggered release dates. Enhanced Group and DEAG expect the transaction to close in the first quarter of 2027. Related The 13 Biggest Music Business Deals of 2026 So Far Kenny MacPherson, Veteran Music Publisher and Big Deal Music Co-Founder, Dies at 71 Diddy Moved From New Jersey Prison to Similar Facility in Pennsylvania “I believe one of the most significant long-term consequences of AI and robotics will be a gradual reduction in the need for human labor,” Maximilian Martin , co-founder and CEO of Enhanced, said in a statement. “And I believe people will mostly allocate this free time to shared, real life human experiences. This creates scarcity, as sports and live experiences cannot be automated or replicated by AI. A live game, a concert, a record broken in front of a crowd — all those moments create goosebumps and become more valuable as everything else becomes digitally abundant. We believe the winners will be the companies that own the content, the stage and the ticket. With DEAG, Enhanced will have all three: owned sports and live IP, a broad promoter and venue network, and proprietary ticketing. And we believe we are acquiring it at a very attractive valuation.” According to a press release, Enhanced plans to evaluate its options for increasing ownership, “potentially up to 100%.” DEAG has locations in Germany, the U.K., Ireland, Switzerland, Denmark, Spain and Italy, and organizes more than 6,000 live events per year, according to the company’s website . Companies operated under DEAG’s portfolio include DEAG Classics, which focuses on classical music performances; DEAG Concerts GmbH, which has worked with The Rolling Stones ; and KBK, which serves as a concert and artist agency serving touring acts including Deep Purple , Lenny Kravitz and Alice Cooper , as well as promoting the W-Festival in Frankfurt, Germany. The promoter operates festivals including Barcelona’s Rock Fest and AIRBEAT ONE Dance Festival and Indian Spirit Festival, both in Germany. It also owns three venues throughout Europe, including myticket Jahrhunderthalle in Frankfurt, Germany; Salle Métropole in Lausanne, Switzerland; and Arches London Bridge in London. Incoming CEO Markus Breitenecker will lead DEAG, which Enhanced Group says will continue operating under the existing management team. Additional reporting by Elizabeth Dilts Marshall .

As the brutally honest truth is that Lupoi’s time with the Califor
articles._body: With the California football program led by first-time head coach Tosh Lupoi , the results this season have been underwhelming, to say the least, with the team at a 3-6 record ahead of Saturday against the Virginia Cavaliers. As the brutally honest truth is that Lupoi’s time with the California football team has been disappointing so far, general manager Ron Rivera would keep it real about this season. Speaking to KNBR’s “Murph & Markus” morning show, which he does a weekly appearance on, he realizes that the expectations were “very high” coming into the season. Rivera wouldn’t hold back on Lupoi’s time to start, saying that he has “bumped his head a lot,” looking for the head coach to improve with the team in the remaining games of the season. “We have talked a lot, tried to give him a lot of advice, point him in the right direction. Some of it, he’s been very receptive, and other portions of it, he hasn’t. And it’s those things that sometimes you’ve gotta learn for yourself before you think, ‘Oh wow, this is it.’ But I’d like to continue to stress that this is a guy that’s learning, growing,” Rivera said, via SF Gate. “But now it’s time,” Rivera continued. “These last three games, hopefully four, the trajectory has to be going north. We have to show that we are growing; there has been some growth and development of our players, our team, and the culture is getting stronger. Those are all things that you have to have going forward.” At any rate, the Golden Bears are 3-6, 2-4 in conference play, as they look to get back in the winning column on Saturday against the Cavaliers. articles.title: Tim Hardin Song Catalog Acquired by Raleigh Music Publishing & ICM Crescendo
articles.summary: The deal for the "If I Were a Carpenter" singer-songwriter's works marks the companies’ first acquisition since forming a joint venture.
articles._body: The U.S. rights and certain foreign rights for nearly the entire Tim Hardin song catalog have been acquired by Raleigh Music Publishing and ICM Crescendo. The catalog includes such songs as “If I Were a Carpenter” and “Reason to Believe.” Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The catalog was bought from the heirs of Hardin, who died in 1980. According to the announcement, the deal marks the first acquisition completed under the Raleigh and ICM Crescendo joint venture created earlier this year . As part of the deal, Raleigh Music will administer the catalog and lead its royalty collection, synchronization licensing and promotion efforts. Related Raleigh Music Publishing Forms Joint Venture With ICM Crescendo Music Royalty Fund Kenny MacPherson, Veteran Music Publisher and Big Deal Music Co-Founder, Dies at 71 Diddy Moved From New Jersey Prison to Similar Facility in Pennsylvania “When we formed this joint venture, we said we expected to move quickly on the right opportunities,” Raleigh co-president Steven Storch said in a statement. “The Tim Hardin catalog is exactly the kind of iconic, enduring body of work we set out to acquire, and it shows what the partnership can do. ‘If I Were a Carpenter’ and ‘Reason to Believe’ are as moving today as when he wrote them, and there is a whole songbook behind them waiting to be rediscovered.” SecondHandSongs, which tracks cover versions of songs, counts nearly 200 for Hardin’s “If I Were A Carpenter.” Johnny Cash & June Carter , Dolly Parton , Robert Plant , Sheryl Crow and Willie Nelson are among the artists who’ve covered the song, which is also featured in the Bobby Darin musical Just In Time , currently playing on Broadway. Meanwhile, SecondHandSongs counts nearly 125 cover versions of “Reason to Believe,” with the most well-known coming from Rod Stewart . “The Tim Hardin catalog combines cultural significance with a long record of covers and licensing activity,” ICM Asset Management president and portfolio manager David Vankka said in a statement. “It is a strong first transaction for our joint venture with Raleigh, and we look forward to building on it together.” Other songs in the catalog include “Misty Roses,” “Lady Came From Baltimore,” “Hang on to a Dream” and “Black Sheep Boy,” which have a combined count of around 120 cover versions, according to SecondHandSongs. “Tim Hardin wrote songs that other great artists couldn’t resist,” Raleigh Music Publishing co-president Peter Raleigh said in a statement. We’re honored to be the stewards of this catalog, and there could be no better first acquisition for our partnership with ICM Crescendo.”

articles.title: Eagles’ Tanner McKee shares humbling reaction to getting benched for Joe Milton
articles.summary: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee addressed his benching Thursday as Joe Milton prepares to take over against the New York Giants in Week 9. The change comes with Philadelphia at 2-6 after six consecutive losses. McKee started the last three games, with the Eagles falling to the Caroli
articles._body: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee addressed his benching Thursday as Joe Milton prepares to take over against the New York Giants in Week 9. The change comes with Philadelphia at 2-6 after six consecutive losses. McKee started the last three games, with the Eagles falling to the Carolina Panthers, Dallas Cowboys and Washington Commanders. SPORTSRADIO 94WIP’s Dave Uram shared footage Thursday on X, formerly Twitter, of McKee discussing his reaction with reporters ahead of Sunday’s matchup. “What was my reaction? Obviously, as a competitor, would love to be out there as much as I can. I think when things happen that are unfortunate, you got to control what you can control, and you have to look inward, think of you know what what can I do moving forward to better myself, better the team, and so that’s that’s the approach that I’m going to have, and that’s the approach that I took.” Eagles quarterback Tanner McKee shares his mindset after getting benched. @SportsRadioWIP @KYWNewsradio pic.twitter.com/kz0B957E8b — Dave Uram (@MrUram) November 5, 2026 McKee completed 72 of 114 passes for 638 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions across his three starts. Philadelphia scored 45 combined points in those games, averaging 15 per contest. The 26-year-old became the starter after Jalen Hurts was lost for the season with blood clots. The Eagles selected McKee in the sixth round out of Stanford in 2023. McKee acknowledged that he wants to play but said he would focus on what he can control, including improving his own performance and helping the Eagles. Milton joined the Eagles on October 16 when the Eagles signed him off Dallas’ practice squad. The New England Patriots originally drafted him in the sixth round in 2024. If he throws a pass Sunday, Milton would become Philadelphia’s fourth passer this season, following Hurts, Andy Dalton and McKee. Milton will start vs. the Giants , while McKee focuses on improving his game and helping the Eagles through the quarterback change. articles._body: The Minnesota Vikings will be facing the Buffalo Bills this week, and they could be without some of their key players for the matchup. There was already doubt surrounding Kyler Murray’s status for the game, as he suffered a hamstring injury in their last game, and Carson Wentz is set to be QB1 against the Bills. Now, the Vikings may be down without one of their wide receivers, as Jauan Jennings has popped up on the injury report with a calf injury. The good news is that he was limited on the first day of practice, and he still has two more days to show that he can play. Jennings hasn’t been very productive for the Vikings this season, as he only has 54 receiving yards. There was a chance that Jennings was going to be in a trade that sent him back to the San Francisco 49ers, but after a conversation with head coach Kyle Shanahan, they didn’t pursue the deal . “We love Jauan,” Shanahan said via ESPN’s Nick Wagoner. “We have such a good relationship with Jauan and know him real well, and we didn’t want to do it without talking to him first. So, we had to agree on some things to at least make it close enough to be able to talk to him. And when we got on a FaceTime with JJ, it went well. “We talked about a lot of stuff, and he ended up saying that he was happy with where he was. It wasn’t just like a definite no at first, but he was like, ‘Man, Kyle, I’m pretty happy here and liking stuff.'” It’s no surprise that Jennings didn’t want to get traded, especially with the Vikings playing some of the best football in the league. articles.title: How Trinidad Chambliss can reclaim 2027 NFL Draft QB1 status with bounce-back game vs. Georgia
articles.summary: Ole Miss football quarterback Trinidad Chambliss became honest with himself after Halloween. Chambliss acknowledged the “unacceptable” performance by his standards against Texas, knocking the Rebels out of their No. 7 slot. Now a more daunting foe comes next in No. 2 Georgia on Saturd
articles._body: Ole Miss football quarterback Trinidad Chambliss became honest with himself after Halloween. Chambliss acknowledged the “unacceptable” performance by his standards against Texas , knocking the Rebels out of their No. 7 slot. Now a more daunting foe comes next in No. 2 Georgia on Saturday. Yet the home game serves as a chance for Chambliss to reignite himself. And reclaim his past title of potential QB1 for the 2027 NFL Draft class. Chambliss is currently projected to land at No. 14 to the Cleveland Browns per ClutchPoints’ mock draft . But he’s still placed behind Texas QB Arch Manning, Oklahoma State star Drew Mestemaker and the current QB1, Miami’s Darian Mensah. So here’s how Chambliss can redeem himself with the home crowd on his side at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium. Trinidad Chambliss can take better care of the football Petre Thomas-Imagn Images Chambliss watched his completion percentage dip drastically in Austin to 48.1%, now his worst mark of 2026. He managed to lift it higher at 64.7% against Auburn, but there’s another notable statistical flaw linked to him. Chambliss has thrown a combined four interceptions the last two games. All after going interception-less against No. 13 Missouri on Oct. 17. Texas handed him a brutal three-interception night. Ironically, the Longhorns and defensive coordinator Will Muschamp didn’t even roll out an aggressive game plan against him. Muschamp trusted the front four on the defensive line way more than blitzing, pressuring Chambliss on 18.2% of his dropbacks per 247Sports. Kicker was, Muschamp’s scheme focused more on clogging Chambliss’s escape routes with his legs. That philosophy forced Chambliss to play inside the pocket, but hope his blocking would hold up. The QB still hit 47.8% of his completions with a clean pocket, though. Georgia’s front line presents a far different animal compared to what Texas threw across the line. Georgia defensive front mirrors past Bulldog lines Georgia and coach Kirby Smart annually know how to reload in the trenches. And this unit features new stars coming out of the line of scrimmage in Athens. Defensive tackle Elijah Griffin brings a 6-foot-4, 310-pound frame in the middle. Pass rushing rises as his biggest strength with a wicked first snap explosion. But he’s not the only defender who stresses out offensive linemen and quarterbacks. Fellow tackles Anthony Lonon Jr. and Josh Horton have a combined four sacks. The former gets upfield with his own snap explosion, while the latter is a taller option at 6-foot-4, 300-pounds with long arms that creates bull rushing advantages for him. This interior defensive line rotation will test Chambliss and Ole Miss. But here’s where the Rebels quarterback can exploit the Bulldogs. Trinidad Chambliss can turn back to this element Saturday in Oxford rises as a perfect chance for Chambliss to pivot back to a past element of his: Mobility. That’s how Auburn’s Byrum Brown hurt the Bulldogs in the Tigers’ upset earlier in October, racking up 192 rushing yards. Brown especially made Georgia pay when the Bulldogs brought an extra rusher, as he took advantage of the intermediate opening the defense created. But Georgia saw bad edge containment that game too. So Chambliss and Ole Miss offensive coordinator John David Baker can run right at the outsides to test the Bulldogs defense. Chambliss likely will face a far different defensive approach compared to the Sugar Bowl outing won by Ole Miss. He trusted his arm more than his legs there. But he’s the kind of quarterback who hurts defenses with either or element. He can certainly turn his legs loose for this one, and re-catapult himself into the top QB of the draft conversation. articles._body: Dak Prescott just dropped a candid quote hinting at how things are going on the offensive side of the ball for the Dallas Cowboys . Asked on Thursday about the identity of the Cowboys on offense, Prescott responded with an intriguing line. “Yeah sure, I mean, is it one we’re proud of? I don’t know,” the former Mississippi State Bulldogs star quarterback replied, via Calvin Watkins of the Dallas Morning News. The Cowboys have one of the most prolific offenses in the league through eight weeks of action in the 2026 NFL season. They enter Week 9 seventh in the league with 27.4 points per game. However, they are just 13th with an average of 342.0 total yards per contest. Prescott didn’t seem to reveal what exactly the identity was he was talking about, but there surely is a lot to be improved on the team’s attack. For one, the Cowboys are averaging only 94.1 rushing yards per game. Only seven teams average fewer yards on the ground this season than Dallas, but it’s also worth noting that the Cowboys are fifth with 1.25 rushing scores per outing. The Cowboys are coming off an extremely disappointing loss in Week 8 to Gardner Minshew II and the Arizona Cardinals in Arlington. Dallas wasted a 14-point lead in the fourth quarter in a 33-30 overtime defeat to the visiting Cardinals, with the Cowboys unable to score in their overtime drive. Prescott and the 3-5 Cowboys will look to bounce back on Sunday, when they play the careening Indianapolis Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. articles.title: Least-known NBA records that will shock you
articles.summary: Basketball is such a popular sport, largely because of the massive numbers put up in the games on a frequent basis. The nature of the sport leads to high-scoring affairs, constant action, back-and-forth contests, and tons of last-second heroics. Of course, it is the superstars who make the bigges
articles._body: Basketball is such a popular sport, largely because of the massive numbers put up in the games on a frequent basis. The nature of the sport leads to high-scoring affairs, constant action, back-and-forth contests, and tons of last-second heroics. Of course, it is the superstars who make the biggest impact, and said players often explode for statistical performances that seem like they are out of a video game. In the NBA, there are lots of well-known records, some of which are being broken because of how the modern game is played. For example, LeBron James just extended his NBA career scoring record with his 16,000th career point . Other famous records are truly unbreakable . Some records, meanwhile, just aren’t common knowledge. So, what are the most shocking records in NBA history? 15. Most assists in a game: Scott Skiles, 30 The big three of statistics in the NBA are points, rebounds, and assists. A lot of fans know the records associated with those statistics. For example, it is common knowledge that Wilt Chamberlain scored a record-breaking 100 points in a game. Chamberlain has the record for single-game rebounds with 55, too. The NBA’s single-game assists record is relatively niche, though. Scott Skiles passed to his teammates on plays that led to scores 30 times with the Orlando Magic on Dec. 30, 1990. Not only is Skiles a little-known player, but that 30-assist threshold is jaw-dropping. After all, anything above 10 assists in a game is considered pretty elite, and Skiles had triple that while facilitating to the likes of Nick Anderson and Dennis Scott. Skiles was a carer 6.5-assist-per-game playmaker. The 1990 season was a breakout season for the point guard that can be described as a one-season wonder. He won the Most Improved Player of the Year award after averaging 17.2 points and 8.4 assists per game. His numbers the rest of his career were not nearly as lofty. 14. Quadruple-double w/o blocks: Alvin Robertson Triple-doubles are becoming more commonplace in the NBA. The NBA’s all-time leader in triple-doubles, Russell Westbrook , had 209 throughout his career before retiring this very offseason . His former teammate, Nikola Jokic, is already at 201 and will likely surpass Westbrook in the coming months. Active players like LeBron James, Luka Doncic, James Harden, and Domantas Sabonis are all in the top 10, too. However, quadruple-doubles still remain a rarity. There have only been four in NBA history, none of which have happened this century. Nate Thurmond had 22 points, 13 assists, 14 rebounds, and 12 blocks in 1974, Hakeem Olajuwon had 18 points, 10 assists, 16 rebounds, and 11 blocks in 1990, and David Robinson had 34 points, 10 assists, 10 rebounds, and 10 blocks in 1994. Those three players all share a few similarities. They were all versatile centers who particularly thrived as rim protectors. The fourth quadruple-double ever came from a guard who only averaged 0.4 blocks per game for his career, though. That would be Alvin Robertson, who remains the only player ever with a quadruple-double that didn’t feature blocks. He had 20 points, 10 assists, 11 rebounds, and 10 steals on Feb. 18, 1986. Getting 10 steals alone is impressive, but adding double-digit scoring, assisting, and rebounding numbers on top of that is unfathomable. 13. Technical fouls in a single season: Rasheed Wallace, 41 A lot of records are great and are something that players could only dream of accomplishing. Other records aren’t so pleasant. The single-season technical fouls record fits the latter description. A technical foul is a non-contact penalty assessed to a player who is out of line when speaking or reacting to referees or fellow players. Rasheed Wallace was notorious for getting them. The big man was skilled, but he had a temper and a poor reputation with refs. The 2000-01 season was his second making the All-Star team, but he was also T’d up 41 times. That is exactly half of the games in the regular season, and more than half that he played in, considering Wallace was active for 77 games. It should come as no surprise that Wallace is also the all-time ejections leader , having been tossed from games 29 times. Two technicals results in an automatic disqualification. 12. Most minutes per game in a single season: Wilt Chamberlain, 48.5 There are 48 minutes in an NBA game. During that time, players do their best to put up big numbers and help their team win the game. Of course, no player has more records than Wilt Chamberlain. He has the aforementioned single-game scoring record (100), but his resume is littered with other video game-like records. Among those is also single-season points per game (50.4), rebounds in a game (55), and times fouling out of a game (0). One record that just doesn’t make any sense comes from 1961-62 when The Stilt played 48.5 minutes per game. Yes, he averaged more time on the court in each game than there is in standard play. In order to accomplish this feat, Chamberlain’s Philadelphia Warriors had to go to overtime seven times. He didn’t sub out during a single game, and only had his 48 minutes cut short once, when he was ejected after receiving two technicals with eight minutes left. 11. Highest scoring game: Pistons vs. Nuggets, 370 points Doug Moe’s Denver Nuggets in the ’80s were all about scoring, and they couldn’t give a care about defense. A number of the highest-scoring affairs ever included the team with the skyline rainbow on their jerseys. The highest-scoring game ever occurred on Dec. 13, 1983. In that game, the Nuggets and Detroit Pistons combined for 370 points, with the Pistons coming out victorious by a score of 186-184. It took three overtimes for the game to conclude, but amazingly, each team only made one shot from beyond the arc. Denver’s Alex English and Kiki Vandeweghe combined for 98 points with 47 and 51 a piece. 10. Most 3-point misses by a player in a game: Damon St

articles.title: Mets hire co-hitting coach who was previously with Braves
articles.summary: The New York Mets have hired Johnny Washington as a co-hitting coach alongside returning hitting coach Troy Snitker, according to multiple reports on Thursday. Washington spent the 2026 season with the Atlanta Braves as their minor-league hitting coordinator, working with hitters throughout the o
articles._body: The New York Mets have hired Johnny Washington as a co-hitting coach alongside returning hitting coach Troy Snitker, according to multiple reports on Thursday. Washington spent the 2026 season with the Atlanta Braves as their minor-league hitting coordinator, working with hitters throughout the organization’s farm system. He will now join manager Andy Green’s staff in New York. The appointment reunites Washington with Green, whom he previously worked under during their time with the San Diego Padres. Washington joined San Diego as a first-base coach in 2017 before moving into the hitting coach position for the 2019 season. Green managed the Padres from 2016 through 2019. Washington began his coaching career in the Los Angeles Dodgers’ minor-league system before moving to San Diego. Following his time with the Padres, the 42-year-old spent the 2021 season coaching the Hanwha Eagles in South Korea’s KBO League. He returned to MLB in 2022 as an assistant hitting coach with the Chicago Cubs, a position he held through 2023. Washington subsequently became the Los Angeles Angels’ hitting coach, serving in that capacity during the 2024 and 2025 seasons before joining the Braves. During his time with the Cubs, he also worked with current Mets player Jared Young, while he previously crossed paths with Luis Torrens in San Diego. Washington’s arrival comes after New York explored other options for its hitting department. Kevin Long and John Mallee were among the candidates linked to the organization, but neither ultimately joined the coaching staff. The Mets decided to retain Snitker, who will work alongside Washington, while Rafael Fernandez is also returning as an assistant hitting coach. New York parted ways with director of major-league hitting Jeff Albert after just one season, leaving an opening within the department that Washington’s appointment helps address. The Mets finished tied for 23rd in OPS and tied for 20th in runs during the 2026 season. Washington is also one of several coaching additions under Green. New York hired former major-league catcher AJ Ellis as their major-league strategy coordinator and promoted Mariano Duncan from their minor-league staff to an assistant coaching position. Ellis replaces Danny Barnes, while Green’s staff also experienced other changes following the departures of Albert and batting practice pitcher Kevin Mahoney. With Washington joining Snitker and Fernandez, the Mets have finalized their major-league coaching staff while continuing to address other organizational positions, including the search for a farm director to replace Green. articles._body: CeeDee Lamb got brutally honest about the Dallas Cowboys’ underwhelming results on the offensive side of the ball halfway through the 2026 NFL season. Lamb has been playing in the league since 2020, going through his seventh season with the Cowboys. He shines as one of the best wide receivers in the entire league, torching defenders with his speed and catching talents. Dallas thought this season to be a promising one, especially with the offense it boasts. With Dak Prescott at quarterback, they have Javonte Williams leading the run game while Lamb and George Pickens stand out as elite stars in the receiving corps. However, the Cowboys’ start to the season has been tough. They have lost a majority of their games, and when it comes to the matchups they could have won, they suffered lapses down the stretch that resulted in them collapsing in disappointing fashion. Lamb reflected on the team’s struggles with media on Thursday, per reporter Jon Machota. He didn’t mince words, stating an expletive while showing his frustration towards recent results. “We stop ourselves. That sh*t is frustrating. It’s annoying. I hate it,” Lamb said. What lies ahead for CeeDee Lamb, Cowboys The Cowboys definitely have a ceiling for the playoffs with the talent they have, including CeeDee Lamb. However, they must resolve their issues and make big plays in critical moments to get back on the right track. Lamb has enjoyed a relatively healthy start to the season. He has caught 60 passes for 709 yards and six touchdowns so far. Dallas has a 3-5 record this season, sitting at second place in the NFC East Division standings. They are above the Washington Commanders and the Philadelphia Eagles while trailing the New York Giants. In terms of the conference standings, they are 13th place. They lead over the Commanders and the New Orleans Saints while being under the Arizona Cardinals and the Atlanta Falcons.The Cowboys will continue preparations for their upcoming matchup this weekend, being on the road. They take on the Indianapolis Colts in Week 9 as kickoff commences on Nov. 8 at 1 p.m. ET. articles.title: DeMarcus Lawrence takes all the blame for Seahawks’ shocking red-zone woes
articles.summary: With the drubbing of the Seattle Seahawks by the hands of the Chicago Bears on Monday night, 34-17, the defense had a hard time of stopping the opposing offense in the red zone. After the Seahawks’ loss to the Bears, defensive star DeMarcus Lawrence would take accountability for the team
articles._body: With the drubbing of the Seattle Seahawks by the hands of the Chicago Bears on Monday night, 34-17, the defense had a hard time of stopping the opposing offense in the red zone. After the Seahawks’ loss to the Bears , defensive star DeMarcus Lawrence would take accountability for the team’s woes on that side of the ball. Seattle reporter Brady Henderson of ESPN would note that the defense for the Seahawks has largely been effective, “allowing the fifth-fewest points in the NFL,” but the red zone numbers say a completely different story. Henderson notes that Seattle is actually “last in red zone efficiency,” solidified by the team allowing the Bears to score touchdowns on every single time Chicago had the ball inside the 20-yard line. “The Seahawks’ defense is allowing the fifth-fewest points in the NFL, but they’re last in red zone efficiency after allowing the Bears to score touchdowns on all four of their trips inside the 20. When asked about that issue today, DeMarcus Lawrence put it on his shoulders,” Henderson wrote on X, formerly Twitter. As Henderson said, Lawrence took blame for the performance, saying that it is his “responsibility to make sure it doesn’t happen.” “I see they’re attacking my C gap. I have to heighten my awareness and play better football down there in the red zone. I’m man enough to sit up here and tell the world that I understand what’s going on … It’s my responsibility to make sure it doesn’t happen,” Lawrence said, via Henderson. At any rate, it remains to be seen how the Seahawks will improve as the team looks to bounce back, as the team has lost three of its last four games. Seattle looks to change momentum as they take on the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday. The post DeMarcus Lawrence takes all the blame for Seahawks’ shocking red-zone woes appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Why Do Brands Keep Returning to Fashion's Favorite Florist?
articles.summary: A "Cecilie Bahnsen flower" is the indie Danish brand's signature, giving it an easily adaptable motif for collabs at UNIQLO, The North Face, and ASICS.
articles._body: The phrase “florals for spring” may (deservedly) elicit a Munchian scream, but what about florals for winter, or summer, or fall? For Danish fashion designer Cecilie Bahnsen, there’s never been a wrong season for slapping flowers onto fabric. Since launching her brand a little over a decade ago, Bahnsen has made this motif a cornerstone of her brand, alongside a specific flavor of avant-garde femininity. Establishing this easily adaptable signature early has paid off. Her flower, like its real-world counterpart, is uber-adaptable; compared to Bahnsen's other staples, like her voluminous babydoll dresses, it slots cleanly into any product category. You can spot a bloom of “Bahnsen florals” in her own wares, sure, but you’re just as likely to see some flowery thing from her sold at a far more mass-market brand: this past week, she unveiled her second UNIQLO collection and dropped her fourth with The North Face. She’s also released girlishly updated takes on ASICS silhouettes since 2023, and softened up Alpha Industries bomber jackets in January. All these far larger brands get a lot from these simple florals, and it’s easy to see why. Each collaboration carries the credibility of a designer who trained under the likes of John Galliano and Erdem, made the LVMH Prize finals in 2017, and counts BLACKPINK’s Jennie as a fan. For Bahnsen, the partnerships also serve as proof of concept: her brand is built on the dual belief that couture-level quality can be applied to your everyday wardrobe, and that feminine touches can infiltrate any space — be it sportswear or military outerwear. When a few simple flowers turn a fleece, a Nuptse, or a sneaker into “a Bahnsen” that actually sells, brands will keep coming back for that as long as it works. articles.summary: The New York Mets couldn’t have had a worse season in 2026, finishing in last place in the National League East. Owner Steve Cohen has designs on his team winning World Series titles and demonstrating that the Mets are a perennial contender, but the team had a brutal start to the season and
articles._body: The New York Mets couldn’t have had a worse season in 2026, finishing in last place in the National League East. Owner Steve Cohen has designs on his team winning World Series titles and demonstrating that the Mets are a perennial contender, but the team had a brutal start to the season and was never able to turn things around. If no Tarik Skubal, would you take four years of Michael King or two years of Clay Holmes? @PSLToFlushing and @sal_licata discuss on The Mets Pod FULL EPISODE: https://t.co/LW7Cj2ZnHa pic.twitter.com/YceHM3bOIl — SNY Mets (@SNY_Mets) November 5, 2026 One thing Mets fans believe they can count on is that Cohen will keep trying to put a championship team on the field. The owner’s contribution includes going after the most valuable — and usually expensive — free agents that hit the market. As free agency gets underway, the best free agent available will be dominant pitcher Tarik Skubal. The Detroit Tigers traded him prior to the MLB deadline last season to the Los Angeles Dodgers. Many expected that move to help the Dodgers win their third straight World Series. That did not happen as the small-market Milwaukee Brewers dominated the postseason, swept the Dodgers and won the World Series. The Mets are expected to go after Skubal and hope to bring him to Citi Field. However, if the Mets are not successful, the Mets may try to address their pitching needs by going after a couple of other free agents. The question was addressed on the Mets Podcast, hosted by Joe DeMayo and Sal Licata, and the participants discussed the possibility of signing Michael King or Clay Holmes. Both hosts favored Holmes because they were more familiar with his work with the Yankees, Mets and Cubs, and they liked his consistency on the mound. However, high marks were also given to King for his strong postseason with the Padres. articles.summary: The Buffalo Bills are coming off a win against the Baltimore Ravens, but they could have some problems heading into their Monday night matchup against the Minnesota Vikings. Buffalo opened its practice week Thursday with several important players missing from the field, including offensive lineme
articles._body: The Buffalo Bills are coming off a win against the Baltimore Ravens, but they could have some problems heading into their Monday night matchup against the Minnesota Vikings . Buffalo opened its practice week Thursday with several important players missing from the field, including offensive linemen Dion Dawkins and Alec Anderson. Alec Anderson and Dion Dawkins both non participants Wednesday as well as Joshua Palmer & Ty Johnson, who had an illness. Dee Alford back full while Spencer Brown was limited. #Bills #BillsMafia pic.twitter.com/MGmaELm8k1 — Chris Brown (@ChrisBrownBills) November 5, 2026 The Bills have a lengthy injury report to manage, and losing multiple starters along the offensive line would be a concern against Minnesota’s defense. Josh Allen is capable of making plays under pressure, but facing Brian Flores’ aggressive defensive scheme without a fully healthy offensive line could make his job much more difficult. Flores is known for bringing pressure from different angles and keeping opposing quarterbacks guessing. The Vikings frequently use blitz packages to disrupt the pocket, which could create problems for an offensive line dealing with multiple injuries. Dawkins and Anderson were not the only Bills players who missed Thursday’s practice. Wide receiver Josh Palmer, running back Ty Johnson and defensive tackle Greg Gaines were out. Meanwhile, Dalton Kincaid, DJ Moore, Keon Coleman and Spencer Brown were among the players who were limited. There are still several days before Buffalo travels to Minnesota, giving the team time to get some of its players back on the field. However, the Bills will need to monitor their offensive line closely, especially with the challenge Flores presents. Monday night should be a compelling matchup between two teams with Super Bowl aspirations. Both the Bills and Vikings have established themselves as contenders in their respective conferences, and this game could have major implications moving forward. Buffalo has the talent to come away with another win, but Allen could have his hands full if the offensive line cannot get healthy in time.
